news.Title: 英國央行警告，AI一旦泡沫恐外溢，美股、英債與信用市場承壓
news.Content:
【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，英國央行的分析顯示，如果人工智能(AI)股票泡沫破裂，衝擊可能蔓延至英國，波及股價、英國國債殖利率和企業信用市場。英國央行工作人員在一篇部落格文章中表示，如果美國大型科技公司的盈利令人失望，投資者可能會將其視為美國未來生產率前景被下調，並因此撤出美國資產，而不是向美國資產尋求避險。這可能導致美元走弱，並削弱過去在金融市場承壓時對英國等經濟體形成緩衝的一項因素。

英國央行全球分析部門的Daniel Ostry、Roger Vicquery和Emilio Zaratiegui在文章中寫道，如果人工智能推動生產率提升的預期落空，投資者可能同時撤出美國債券和股票市場。

英國央行的這些人員在文章中表示，這將與2008年全球金融危機等典型壓力情景形成鮮明反差，當時，投資者尋求避險資產推動美元走強。這對英國起到了一定支持作用，一方面提升了英國出口競爭力，另一方面也提高了美元計價持倉的英鎊價值。

美國科技公司估值的飆升已經引發了其股價大幅回調可能產生波及影響，進而損害英國經濟的擔憂，儘管沒有一家大型AI公司在倫敦上市。

7月份，英國央行警告稱，美股估值已愈發偏高，越來越多AI公司透過舉借債務來為巨額投資籌措資金。英國央行行長貝利(Andrew Bailey)7月時曾表示，AI泡沫破裂的經濟影響可能會促使央行以利率做出反應。

英國央行員工基於2000年以來「科技七巨頭」的盈利公告和股價變動進行分析，估算顯示，如果盈利出現1%的負面衝擊，美元將走弱，而英鎊按有效匯率計算，可能在大約一週內升值約0.5%。

分析還估計，富時100指數可能在兩天內下跌約1%。衝擊發生九天後，10年期英國國債殖利率可能下降約6.5個基點；英國信用利差則可能在兩週內擴大約10個基點。

報告作者總結稱，這些衝擊表明，源自大型科技公司的影響不會僅局限於大型科技公司本身。

news.Title: 那斯達克全球交易延至23小時 分析師：亞股資金爭奪更強烈
news.Content:
美國 那斯達克 交易所(Nasdaq)「全球交易時間」制度將於12月6日啟動每日高達23小時的超長交易時段，不僅牽動台灣券商複委託業務，亞洲投資人在白天也能參與美股交易。國內分析師認為，近2、3年愈來愈多亞洲投資人進行美股交易，那斯達克全球交易時間幾乎「無空窗」，亞洲股市資金爭奪將更為強烈。

美股那斯達克目前依循傳統交易時段，分為盤前、正常與盤後交易。以台灣時間為例，正常開盤時間為晚上9時30分至次日凌晨4時。不過，那斯達克已宣布將於今年12月6日正式啟動全新的「全球交易時間」，未來將提供每週5天、每天高達23小時的交易服務，台灣時間上午8時至9時暫停交易1個小時進行系統維護。

由於亞洲以及台灣投資人近幾年熱衷包括美股等海外投資，複委託業務已成國內券商的重要業務之一。統計顯示，台灣今年上半年複委託累計成交金額近新台幣10兆，全台開戶數突破820萬戶、等於每4位國人就有1人擁有複委託帳戶，且當中近8成資金交易集中於美股。

那斯達克全球交易新制上路後，是否對於亞股和台股產生虹吸效應，引發關注。證期雙照分析師翁偉捷分析，目前亞洲股市開市時，都會看美股期貨盤的情況，但無法掌握全部資金流向，因此也會讓市場觀望氣氛較為濃厚，如今那斯達克全球交易時間幾乎是「無空窗」，亞洲投資人在白天也能參與美股交易，亞洲股市資金爭奪將更為強烈。翁偉捷說：『(原音)就是散戶跟一般投資人之間的虹吸效應一定會有資金被爭奪的問題 。交易時間被延長，原先的這些資金直接在這個交易時段就可以達成，所以變成說交易狀況在亞洲盤的時間點也會比較熱絡 。』

翁偉捷也指出，過往美股收盤後若發生重大事件，接下來開盤的亞洲股市首當其衝，一直到晚上才會傳遞至美股；那斯達克交易時間延長，將可以更快速因應事件發生當下的資金流動，避免流動性風險。

至於美股有道瓊、S&P以及費城半導體4大指數交易，為何獨選那斯達克延長交易時間？翁偉捷表示，費城半導體多集中於半導體產業，道瓊又多在金融、傳產等消費性零售業，那斯達克指數的成分股反應美股結構最為完整。

news.Title: 8月台股ETF交投熱！這4檔日均量突破20萬張 00685L挾量價雙優勢
news.Content:
台股 ETF 投資熱潮不減，統計目前已來到 94 檔，大盤 8 月以來累計反彈 6.73%，也讓人氣回到台股 ETF，統計8月以來所有台股ETF日均量表現，其中，群益臺灣加權正2(00685L-TW)、主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)等日均量皆超過 20 萬張，這 4 檔交投最為熱絡，00685L 量能及績效雙雙奪下冠軍。

此外，包括主動復華未來50(00991A-TW)、元大台灣50(0050-TW)、凱基台灣TOP50(009816-TW)、元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)等，共計8檔日均量超過十萬張以上，其中群益臺灣加權正2(00685L-TW)以日均量25.6萬張居台股ETF成交王，再以今年來績效表現來看，00685L上漲121.38%最亮眼，堪稱台股ETF中的價量齊揚績效人氣王。

群益投信台股ETF研究團隊表示，投資台股ETF，除了選擇適合自己的投資屬性主題以及價格外，還必須學會觀察「成交量」，在金融市場中，成交量是指某一特定資產在一段時間內交易的數量，是市場活動和流動性的觀察重要指標，透過分析成交量，可以看出整體市場動能的強弱，相對也減少被下市的風險。台股類股輪動快速、個股波動性大，預期台股指數傾向高檔震盪，建議投資人可以台股ETF參與台股未來上漲契機。

群益臺灣加權正2 ETF經理人洪祥益表示，市場短期雜音不改長線多頭格局，投資人應秉持謹慎樂觀態度審慎應對。不過，台股正2 ETF的運作機制為每日重新平衡，當市場上漲或下跌時，資產增減的幅度也會被加倍放大，投資人須考量自身理財目標與投資屬性，控制好投資風險。對於台股後市，中長線而言，台股基本面有支撐，指數熱度有望延續，因此若盤勢有回檔建議可採取逢低買進策略。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】南亞漲停華碩攻克千元　台股盤中區間震盪
news.Content:
（中央社記者鍾榮峰台北2026年08月14日電）台股走勢震盪，早盤勁揚逾380點後回檔，聯發科揚升，南亞漲停帶動塑化族群表態，緯穎、華碩、仁寶等代工廠強勢，台股盤中於平盤上下遊走，呈現區間震盪整理格局。

到10時48分，加權指數達46167.7點，上漲146.22點，漲幅0.32%，成交值約新台幣6357.68億元，電子指數漲0.26%，金融指數翻黑跌0.16%。

權王台積電盤中跌10元至2425元，主要電子權值股聯發科勁揚逾1%，台達電、鴻海整理，日月光投控、聯電跌逾1%。被動元件大廠國巨挫跌5%，記憶體族群南亞科跌1%，華邦電勁揚3%，力積電揚升約5%。

股價超過千元的高價股漲跌互見，華碩 (2357) 大漲逾7%攻上千元大關，旭隼 (6409) 、均華 (6640) 重返千元，勤誠 (8210) 千元近關情怯，高價股增至「52千金」。

啟發投顧副總經理容逸燊表示，台股盤中小漲格局、類股輪動，美股晟碟（SanDisk）財報佳，帶動韓股和台股記憶體族群一度勁揚，被動元件類股相對回檔，近期台股揚升，主要是美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）走緩，通膨數據降溫，市場對升息疑慮減低。

展望台股後市，容逸燊預期台股在46000點至48000點區間震盪整理，待時間消化賣壓，再向上測試高點，後續關注月底輝達（NVIDIA）財報及對人工智慧（AI）產業最新看法。

news.Title: 台股衝破4萬6煞不住？分析師見1指標突喊「用力過猛」　PCB這2檔噴逾6成：先下車小心變臉
news.Content:
台股昨（13日）展現多頭反攻氣勢，大漲503點，站上4萬6千點大關，成交量也放大到1兆元以上，今日一度再勁揚約400點，但盤中漲勢收斂。資深分析師李永年指出，短線指數已出現「用力過猛」的技術性訊號，建議投資人適時調節，他特別點名PCB族群的金居(8358)和健鼎(3044)漲幅已高，可先行獲利了結，為「第二批」潛力股進場做準備。李永年也提醒，美伊臨時和平協議限期下周即將到來，受到國際政治因素影響，需留意台股出現利空洗盤。

外資大舉回補 期現貨同步作多

資深分析師李永年在「李永年YT頻道」分析指出，台股昨日大漲503點站上4萬6，盤後顯示籌碼變化，主要來自三大法人同步買超，其中外資更大手筆敲進756億元。他認為，外資從8月5日以來，幾乎都站在買方，這與美元眨值及美國經濟數疲軟有關。

美國最新公布7月消費者物價指數（CPI）顯示通膨受到控制，加上先前非農就業人數意外減少，市場預期美國聯準會（FED）在9月會議維持利率不變的機率大增，因此外資在台股集中市場掃貨，也回補台指期空單，展現出作多姿態。

價漲量增藏隱憂 技術指標正乖離過大

台股今日開盤延續攻勢，一度大漲近400點，最高來到46,402點，不過，盤中漲勢收斂，預估成交量也有上兆元。李永年卻指出，昨日成交量已放大至1兆498億元，接近量價配合的理想情況，但仔細觀察，技術面已出現潛在風險。

李永年示警，至昨日為止，大盤已連續4個交易日收紅，昨日更在高檔再度跳空開高，這種「用力過猛」的走勢，往往伴隨而來是技術指標的正乖離過大。根據過往經驗，他認為，大盤極有可能在2天內量縮整理，收個小黑十字線或實體黑K線，但只要不是1.2兆元以上的巨量長黑，適度回檔修正，反而有利後市整理再攻。

國際政局成變數 觀察周線漲勢

個股方面，PCB族群股災跌最深，近期反彈也相當猛，金居由低點271元至今日已站上460元，短線漲幅近7成；健鼎則由327元來到524元，也有6成漲幅。李永年點名，這2檔漲多了，可能進入休息整理期，可適時獲利了結，收回資金，為下一批潛力個股進場做準備。他強調，調節持股並非看壞後市，而是掌握「空頭時保平安、多頭時賺價差」的操作節奏。

李永年表示，本周周線收紅無懸念，但下周面臨關鍵期。他指出，下周美伊臨時和平協議即將到期，地緣政治變數往往成為市場「洗盤」的藉口，國際談判角力也可能引發利空消息。李永年提醒，下周周線是否延續漲勢，是多頭續航力的指標，在盤勢震盪之際，投資人應保持判斷力，避免盲目追高，並審慎評估風險。

news.Title: AI費用增加 趨勢科技砍獲利預估 股價高掛跌停
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-14 10:52:19 蔡承啟 發佈

AI相關費用增加，全球網路資安解決方案領導廠趨勢科技(Trend Micro、4704.JP)下砍今年度獲利預估，財測遜於市場預期，今日股價聞訊高掛跌停。

截至日本股市14日早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)為止，趨勢科技尚未有任何一筆成交紀錄。據日媒指出，目前趨勢科技賣單價為5,851日圓、較前一個交易日收盤價(6,851日圓)崩跌14.59%(跌1,000日圓)高掛跌停。

趨勢科技13日於日股盤後公布財報新聞稿指出，因包含AI Token成本在內的雲端相關費用較原先預期大幅增加，今年度(2026年1-12月)合併營益目標自原先(5月)預估的564億日圓下修至444億日圓(將年減23.2%)、合併純益目標自366億日圓下修至307億日圓(將年減11.1%)，合併營收目標則維持於3,015億日圓(將年增9.2%)不變。

日媒報導，市場原先預期趨勢科技今年度純益將為370億日圓，趨勢科技公布的預估值遜於市場預期。

趨勢科技同時公布今年度上半年(2026年1-6月)財報：合併營收較去年同期成長11.0%至1,485.96億日圓、合併營益大減23.5%至217.92億日圓、合併純益成長6.2%至152.30億日圓。

上半年趨勢科技於日本市場的營收較去年同期成長0.7%至441.84億日圓、美洲市場營收成長7.5%至290.59億日圓、歐洲市場大增16.6%至338.65億日圓、亞太市場大增22.2%至414.86億日圓。

news.Title: 艾克曼大改投資組合，新增Netflix等六檔持股，NFLX、PSUS週四同步收漲
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，億萬富豪投資人艾克曼(Bill Ackman)週四公布近年最大規模的投資組合調整，新增Netflix(美股代碼NFLX)、Visa(V)、萬事達卡(MA)、愛爾康(Alcon，美股代碼ALC)、洲際交易所(ICE)及標普全球(SPGI)六檔持股。艾克曼表示，相關股份自第二季開始買進，將配置於旗下多檔基金，包括今年4月在紐約證券交易所掛牌的潘興廣場美國基金(Pershing Square USA，美股代碼PSUS)。他認為，六家公司均具備強勁的獲利成長潛力，而獲利增長是長期推升投資價值的最重要因素。

消息刺激Netflix週四收盤大漲5.4%，標普全球上漲約1.1%，其餘新增持股多數小幅走高；潘興廣場美國基金則上漲2.76%，收報40.18美元。艾克曼曾於2022年短暫持有Netflix，但在公司訂戶流失、股價急挫後認賠出場，如今相隔四年重新進場。

這次調整也反映潘興基金尋求扭轉落後績效。截至7月底，潘興廣場美國基金年內下跌3.5%，倫敦上市的潘興廣場控股跌9.2%，同期標普500總報酬指數上漲約10%。除六檔新持股外，艾克曼現有投資還包括微軟、Uber、Meta、亞馬遜、房利美及房地美等。

news.Title: 台股高檔震盪，類股輪動啟動，漢翔、龍德成軍工族群焦點
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃啟乙】美股與日、韓股市開高領漲，台股今日也以高盤開出，但隨後出現震盪走低的整理走勢。台股自半年線低檔反彈以來，尤其前期跌深個股展開強勁反彈後，週五已有獲利了結及拉回整理的跡象，顯示短線漲勢暫歇，盤面可能逐步轉向類股輪動。　　值得注意的是，隨著立法院局勢出現新的變化，市場傳出8月底前預算可望過關，加上無人機條例也有機會獲得通過，軍工族群再度受到關注。其中，漢翔(2634)近期股價出現重新轉強的跡象，若後續量價配合，有機會再度扮演類股領軍角色。

另一方面，龍德造船(6753)上半年EPS達6.55元，創下歷史新高，基本面表現亮眼。若軍工類股在政策題材帶動下重新展開攻勢，龍德造船的獲利表現與股價位置，亦可望成為觀察類股強弱的重要指標。

news.Title: 傳南亞科12吋新廠落腳雲林？ 張麗善回應了
news.Content:
受惠於AI浪潮帶來的高階財料需求激增，台塑集團積極擴展科技版圖，媒體傳言，將由在記憶體產業獲利頗豐的南亞科率先打頭陣，規劃在雲林及屏東新建12吋晶圓廠；對此，雲林縣長張麗善表示，縣府已多次與南亞科接觸，積極爭取南亞科來雲林虎尾產業園區設廠。

AI浪潮帶來記憶體缺貨潮，讓即使產能全開的南亞科都難以供給，由於台積電在國內大舉擴廠已讓電力供應緊張、新廠設置在北部無望，南亞科向府院提出土地請求，總統府祕書長潘孟安列出可供南亞科建廠所需土地。

據消息人士透露，南亞科最終評選出適合建廠廠址，其中包含雲林產業園區及屏東科學園區，考量周邊基礎建設完整度及用水用電規畫，南亞科傾向優先在雲林產業園區建廠，以擴產第四代10奈米（1D）以下先進製程產品；台塑集團行政中心總裁吳嘉昭證實，南亞科計畫在台興建新廠，雖然未透露具體位置，但強調這是集團擴大投資「非常重要」一環。

針對雲林縣發展高科技產業鏈的展望，雲林縣長張麗善在12日的「台塑企業安全文化績優部門表揚大會」中提到，台塑四寶已進駐六輕工業區20餘年，已與縣府有相當的合作默契與共識，若南亞科進駐雲林，將與台積電、輝達形成重要產業鏈，令雲林縣在半導體產業中的地位持續提升。

張麗善也特別向在場的南亞公司總經理鄒明仁，提出南亞科進駐雲林的構想。張麗善強調，已多次爭取南亞科於雲林設廠，雲林擁有水電充足、土地單一、港口物流等優勢，縣府將全力協助南亞科進駐。

news.Title: 8檔台股ETF交投熱絡 00685L登績效人氣王
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-14 10:36:15 新聞中心 發佈

台股ETF投資熱潮不減，統計目前已來到94檔，這麼多台股ETF，投資人該如何挑選，市場法人表示，成交量的高低可以觀察其在市場的活躍度，選擇成交量大的台股ETF，代表該標的受到市場關注度高、流動性佳，特別是在市場動盪之際，若維持一定的成交量，投資人也可避免流動性不足風險。

近月大盤表現極度震盪，8月以來反彈6.73%，也讓人氣回到台股ETF，統計8月以來所有台股ETF日均量表現，其中包括群益臺灣加權正2（00685L）、元大台灣50正2（00631L）、主動統一台股增長（00981A）、主動復華未來50（00991A）、元大台灣50（0050）、凱基台灣TOP50（009816）、主動統一升級50（00403A）、元大台灣50反1（00632R）共8檔日均量超過十萬張以上，其中群益臺灣加權正2（00685L）以日均量25.6萬張居台股ETF成交王，再以今年來績效表現來看，00685L上漲121.38%最亮眼，堪稱台股ETF中的價量齊揚績效人氣王。

群益投信台股ETF研究團隊表示，投資台股ETF，除了選擇適合自己的投資屬性主題以及價格外，還必須學會觀察「成交量」，在金融市場中，成交量是指某一特定資產在一段時間內交易的數量，是市場活動和流動性的觀察重要指標，透過分析成交量，可以看出整體市場動能的強弱，相對也減少被下市的風險。台股類股輪動快速、個股波動性大，預期台股指數傾向高檔震盪，建議投資人可以台股ETF參與台股未來上漲契機。

群益臺灣加權正2（00685L）ETF經理人洪祥益表示，市場短期雜音不改長線多頭格局，投資人應秉持謹慎樂觀態度審慎應對。不過，台股正2 ETF的運作機制為每日重新平衡，當市場上漲或下跌時，資產增減的幅度也會被加倍放大，投資人須考量自身理財目標與投資屬性，控制好投資風險。對於台股後市，中長線而言，台股基本面有支撐，指數熱度有望延續，因此若盤勢有回檔建議可採取逢低買進策略。

news.Title: 記憶體大廠Sandisk狂飆逾13%！力積電爆量衝80元 分析師點名2檔是長線首選
news.Content:
美國記憶體大廠Sandisk公布最新長期財務目標，激勵股價狂飆13.67%，今年以來累計漲幅達455%，帶動記憶體股續強。台股方面，華邦電（2344）盤中大漲逾半根停板、觸及191元；力積電（6770）也強勢站回80元大關，大漲逾8%，成交量逾27萬張居台股之冠。分析師表示，華邦電、南亞科受MSCI納入效應帶動，有望續強，力積電則屬落後補漲。

記憶體大廠華邦電（2344）今（14）日股價續強，盤中漲逾半根停板觸及191元，截至上午9時45分。力積電（6770）也一舉站上80元整數關卡，大漲逾8%，報81.5元，成交量27.3萬張，位居台股之冠。分析師看好，

記憶體大廠Sandisk公布最新長期財務目標，預估2028至2030財年營收每年可望維持15%至19%的成長速度，並將調整後毛利率穩定在約80%，帶動股價狂飆13.67%，收在每股1,528.11美元；今年以來累計漲幅達455%。

韓國巨頭則是漲跌互見，三星今日開盤後走弱，SK海力士開高後漲幅隨即收斂在3%左右。台廠方面，力積電股價大漲逾8%衝上80.3元，重回80元大關，成交量27.3萬張，位居台股之冠。南亞科（2408）歷經13日大漲，今股價持續創高，早盤最高來到542元。華邦電也展現多頭氣勢，大漲逾半根停板，衝上191元。

啟發投顧分析師白易弘表示，華邦電與南亞科近期因入選 MSCI 標準成分股，吸引了外資回補買盤，表現相對強勢。華邦電後續有機會挑戰 200 元以上的前波高點壓力區。

白易弘續指，相較之下，力積電則屬於落後補漲性質，雖然市占率與一線大廠仍有落差，但因位階較低且具備轉機題材，吸引外資回補，適合進行短線價差操作。他分析，力積電在90元以上的壓力巨大，短期應先觀察能否站穩85元。對於中長線投資者，他建議，以華邦電和南亞科為首選，並待收黑震盪至五日線時再進場布局。

news.Title: 日本資金大舉出海，上週淨買海外債券1.63兆日圓
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】日本財務省週五公布最新數據顯示，截至8月7日止一週，日本投資人淨買進海外債券1兆6,294億日圓，較前一週的4,779億日圓大幅增加逾兩倍，顯示在日本央行升息預期升溫及日圓劇烈波動之際，日本資金仍積極配置海外固定收益資產。同期，日本投資人淨買進海外股票9,635億日圓，扭轉前一週淨賣出2,764億日圓的局面。日本投資人單週合計淨買進海外股票及債券達2兆5,929億日圓，反映資金向海外資產移動的速度明顯加快。

外資方面，截至8月7日止一週淨賣出日本股票3,685億日圓，已是連續第二週撤出日股，但賣超規模較前一週的3,925億日圓略為縮小。外資同時淨賣出日本債券587億日圓，與前一週淨買進5,589億日圓相比，由買轉賣。

市場人士指出，日本資金大舉買進海外資產，可能與海外債券殖利率仍具吸引力，以及投資人進行區域分散配置有關；外資則在日本央行可能加快升息、日圓存在進一步升值風險之際，對日股與日債同步採取較審慎態度。

news.Title: 台積電傳重新規劃產能，龍潭三期設1.4奈米專區、嘉義為先進封裝專區
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】半導體供應鏈近期傳出，台積電( 2330 )將進行產能規劃的重新配置，龍潭科學園區三期定為1.4奈米晶圓代工專區。而嘉義園區定調為先進封裝專區，共有三期，傳出廠的數量最多高達10座，嘉義園區一期的第一個封裝廠，近期正式量產，一期的第2座封裝廠力拼今年底前運作。

台灣土地廠區取得不易，然半導體先進製程與先進封裝持續推進，且AI趨勢加快，半導體業者急尋適用的土地支援，而身為全球晶圓代工龍頭的台積電，不單在既有廠區內進行產線重置與調配，更加快購地、購廠、租地、蓋廠，像是近期業界盛傳，台積電已經向友達(2409)買下中科的二座廠。

而供應鏈又傳出，台積電近期又有產能重置的動作，預計將環評問題解決的龍潭三期，設定為完整的1.4奈米晶圓代工基地，至於嘉義，確定為龐大的先進封測專區，共有三期，已經揭露的廠有5座，但規劃中的廠可能多達10個。

首先在龍潭科學園區部分，現有一座自有的封測廠區是過去向高通購入的，目前專職生產蘋果晶片的InFo，也向鄰近的采鈺(6789)承租一層樓（采鈺只當房東），設有一條小型CoPoS實驗線，目前還在裝機試機階段，此CoPoS實驗線後續不動，持續放置在向采鈺承租的廠區中。但原先專替蘋果晶片封裝的廠區後續是否變動，待觀察，且這座廠的後方具備延伸性。至於紛擾很久的龍潭科學園區三期，環評後台積電新取得的土地，傳出要建置1.4奈米晶圓代工專區，無封裝產線。

而嘉義部分，則完全定調為先進封裝專區，並加快設廠腳步，設有三期基地，一期有二座先進封裝廠，1廠先前尚處於NPI階段，近期才是真正要量產，2廠外殼硬體都已經完成，傳出希望力拼今年底量產。而二期則規劃要設置共計3座的先進封裝廠，二期的第1個廠區，已經在2026年6月提前動工，預計2028年量產。目前台積電已經釋出的訊息顯示，嘉義定調為先進封測專區，一期加上二期合計會有5個先進封裝廠，然業界盛傳，事實上台積電嘉義園區的一、二、三期，將會有多達10座的廠。

news.Title: 'Big Short' Michael Burry takes aim at surging AI stock
news.Content: Betting against AI still looks like a dangerous game. In particular, one fast-growing AI neocloud stock has surged more than 200% in 2026, as investors continue to pour money into companies facilitating the AI boom. Demand looked relentless, and the market's been pricing in plenty more growth, even though investors appear to be in "show-me" mode with regard to AI. "Big Short" Michael Burry , though, is betting something has gone wrong. He continues to lean further against AI, adding to his bearish positions involving Micron ( MU ), Oracle ( ORCL ), and the iShares Semiconductor ETF ( SOXX ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Michael Burry is increasing his bearish positions, including against Micron (MU), Oracle (ORCL), and the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX).
• Burry is also shorting Nebius (NBIS), a neocloud/AI-focused cloud provider, questioning its pricing strategy for compute contracts.
• He finds it unusual that short-duration AI compute deals are priced significantly higher than longer-term contracts, suggesting a potential overvaluation of immediate capacity.
• Nebius reported explosive revenue growth of 454% and a swing to profitability, but Burry believes the underlying assets may not support the current market expectations.
• Burry's bet is that the AI boom's duration is overestimated by investors relative to the long-term viability of the underlying infrastructure.
news.Keywords: short position, AI valuation, market sentiment, bearish outlook, compute contracts

news.Title: 台指期夜盤漲364點！台股開盤46103點 台積電平盤震盪暫報2420元
news.Content:
市場對美國聯準會升息疑慮降低，美股勁揚，台指期夜盤也上漲364點。台股今（14）早開盤上漲82.33點，以46103.81點開出，隨後上漲300點觸及46402點。台積電平盤震盪，暫報2420元，不過南亞科、信驊和廣達等都呈現漲勢。

美股13日收盤四指數全收紅，因為美國在7月生產者物價指數意外持平，顯示通膨降溫，強化市場對聯準會9月不會升息的預期，帶動標普500指數上漲，創下收盤歷史新高；台積電ADR也小漲，台指期夜盤更上漲364點。

而截至上午9點30分，台股因受到權值股台積電影響，開盤表現震盪，以46103點開出，最高上漲300點、觸及46402點。

權值股方面，台積電（2330）開盤以2435元平盤開出，目前是下跌15元、暫報2420元；聯發科（2454）則是上漲40元開出，不過隨即下跌近200點列注意股，暫報4260元；台達電（2308）則是上漲25元開出，暫報1890元；另外像鴻海（2317）平盤開出，暫報263元；還有之前漲很多的南亞科、信驊跟廣達等等，今天也都是上漲勢頭。

而法人也認為市場目前資金追價的意願相當高，台股盤面結構也強勢，後續可以觀察台積電跟電子零組件的表現，如果成交量可以持續維持高檔，甚至突破兆元的話，上攻的動能還是可以期待。

另外美國那斯達克交易所全球交易時間制度將在今年12月6日啟動，改成1天有高達23小時的超長交易時段，牽動台灣券商的複委託業務，主管機關跟券商公會評估之後，傾向不採取強制複委託下單，全面同步美股的交易時段，讓各券商可以依照自己的營運成本還有客群需求評估是否要跟進，但是要求券商得注意兩大點，包含國外上手系統支援度跟國內系統的人力調整，因超長交易時段，不僅影響到國內投資人外資，也會影響到券商的工作流程。

台北／林品瑄　編輯／張碧珊

news.Title: 輝達點名Scale-up！光通訊下一戰開打 CPO迎關鍵轉折
news.Content:
I伺服器瓶頸正從算力轉向高速互連，輝達點名Scale-up，其頻寬需求約是Scale-out的10倍，Spectrum-X CPO正式走向量產，帶動台積電與鴻海等供應鏈，開啟「光進銅退」的新轉折。

Scale-up頻寬需求大增

口袋證券指出，要理解光通訊需求，必須區分Scale-out與Scale-up。Scale-out主要串聯不同伺服器與機櫃；Scale-up則讓同個運算域的多顆GPU像「一顆巨型GPU」般共同工作，對頻寬與延遲的要求更嚴苛。輝達網路事業資深副總裁Gilad Shainer過去談到NVLink時就曾指出：「Scale-up需要的頻寬，粗略而言大約可以達到Scale-out的10倍，同時還必須追求極低延遲。」到了Vera Rubin世代，NVLink 6已將單GPU雙向互連頻寬提升至3.6 TB/s，整個72顆GPU的NVL72機櫃合計可達260 TB/s，顯示競爭已從「單顆GPU算多快」變成「上千顆GPU能否有效率地一起算」。

高速互連推升CPO需求

口袋證券表示，傳統可插拔式光模組放置在交換器面板，電訊號需經過PCB走線才能轉為光訊號。當傳輸速度升至1.6T、3.2T以上時，電訊號傳輸距離帶來的損耗、功耗與散熱問題會更加明顯。CPO將光學引擎直接拉到交換器ASIC旁邊，大幅縮短電訊號距離。輝達表示，相較傳統光收發器架構，Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics可帶來5倍電源效率、5倍AI應用持續運作時間與1.3倍部署速度。輝達今年3月分別投入20億美元與Lumentum、Coherent深化合作，5月又與康寧合作擴大美國光連接產能10倍，顯示其布局已涵蓋整條高速互連供應鏈。

從矽光子延伸到系統整合

從產業鏈來看，台灣廠商並非全部集中在同一個環節，而是涵蓋晶圓製造、封裝、光纖、雷射、光學元件及系統整合。

台積電（2330）是矽光子與先進封裝的重要平台，輝達已點名台積電參與Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics量產流程，負責先進矽光子製造。

日月光投控（3711）旗下矽品則參與輝達CPO產品的晶片級封裝、組裝與測試，負責電子與光學元件整合。

波若威（3163）長期布局光纖被動元件與高速光連接方案，並被列入輝達Silicon Photonics技術合作夥伴名單，可望受惠於CPO放量後的高密度光纖連接需求。

上詮（3363）布局FAU（Fiber Array Unit，光纖陣列單元）及CPO光學封裝，公司先前表示2026年第3季開始交付相關FAU產品，初期以3.2T規格為主，後續朝6.4T以上規格推進。

光聖（6442）則布局資料中心光纖連接與被動元件，並將CPO External Laser Source模組列為Scale-up AI基礎設施相關產品方向。

訊芯-KY（6451）從SiP封裝延伸至矽光子與CPO先進封裝，布局高速光纖收發模組的封裝、測試及Turnkey服務，屬於後段封測整合環節。

聯亞（3081）則位於更上游的InP光源與CW Laser供應鏈，1.6T相關產品已進入量產，並持續開發3.2T及更高功率產品。由於CPO需要外部雷射光源，光源供應也是後續產業放量的重要觀察點。

鴻海（2317）則由零組件進一步延伸至系統端，Foxconn已被輝達列為Spectrum-X Photonics量產合作夥伴，負責CPO交換器系統整合。

光通訊下一戰在GPU核心互連

口袋證券認為，CPO真正重要的地方，不只是「把光模組裝進交換器」，而是AI基礎建設正進入新的階段，當算力規模持續擴大，資料

news.Title: 再生晶圓廠RS上半年業績破紀錄 惟財測遜、股價崩
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-14 09:41:27 蔡承啟 發佈

增產投資、產量增加，全球再生晶圓大廠RS Technologies(3445.JP)上半年業績創下歷史新高紀錄，不過RS維持財測不變，財測遜於市場預期，今日股價聞訊崩跌。另外，RS對台灣等地的增產投資計劃維持不變。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間14日上午9點20分為止，RS崩跌12.54%至6,210日圓。

RS 13日於日股盤後公布今年度上半年(2026年1-6月)財報：因增產投資、再生晶圓產量增加，加上8吋矽晶圓銷售揚升，帶動合併營收較去年同期成長6.8%至405.95億日圓、合併營益增加8.9%至77.35億日圓、合併純益成長9.2%至41.49億日圓，上半年業績創下歷史新高紀錄。

就部門別情況來看，因對特定客戶調整單價，加上部分增產計劃提前帶動產量增加，挹注營收，上半年RS「再生晶圓事業」營收較去年同期增加6.8%至142.84億日圓，營益成長6.9%至50.69億日圓，營益率為35.5%。

受惠設備投資效益，8吋矽晶圓月產量達27萬片、創下歷史新高，上半年RS「生產晶圓製造銷售事業(=矽晶圓事業)」營收大增39.0%至139.02億日圓，營益大增39.1%至32.40億日圓，營益率為23.3%。

上半年RS「半導體相關裝置/材料事業(包含RSPDH和LE系統公司)」營收萎縮12.1%至136.42億日圓，營益暴減54.6%至4.13億日圓，營益率為3.0%。RSPDH(艾索精密部件(惠州)有限公司)負責生產/銷售光學讀取模組及車用相機模組；LE系統公司(LE System)生產全釩液流電池(VRFB)用電解液。

RS維持今年度(2026年1-12月)財測預估不變，合併營收預估將年增9.5%至840億日圓、合併營益將年增7.8%至154億日圓、合併純益預估將年增7.6%至100億日圓。

金融情報服務公司QUICK事前所作的調查顯示，市場原先預期RS今年度營益、純益將為164.5億日圓、107億日圓。RS公佈的預估值遜於市場預期。

RS維持增產投資計劃不變

RS 13日表示，為了搶攻全球半導體需求，將在日本、台灣、中國進行大規模投資，增產再生晶圓，合計將投資520億日圓(投資額同於前次2026年5月公布的數值)，目標在2028年結束前確立全球月產119萬片的產能、進一步擴大市佔率。

RS計劃在2026年-2028年期間合計在台灣投資247億日圓(投資額同於前次2026年5月公布的數值)，目標在2028年將台灣12吋再生晶圓月產能提高至57萬片、將較2025年(30萬片)暴增90%(增加27萬片)。

就細項來看，RS計畫在2026年投資28億日圓將台灣12吋再生晶圓月產能提高至33萬片；2027年投資124億日圓，將在台灣打造第2工廠，目標將台灣12吋再生晶圓月產能提高至42萬片(第1工廠37萬片、第2工廠5萬片)；2028年將投資95億日圓，將台灣月產能進一步擴增至57萬片(第1工廠37萬片、第2工廠20萬片)，屆時台灣12吋再生晶圓產能將超越日本。

除台灣之外，RS計畫在2026年-2028年期間合計投資超過173億日圓(分別為119億日圓、54億日圓、未定)擴充日本12吋再生晶圓產能，目標在2026年將日本12吋再生晶圓月產能提高至38萬片(2025年為34萬片)、2027年提高至47萬片，2028年進一步提高至52萬片、將較2025年大增53%(增加18萬片)。

在中國的部分，RS計畫在2028年投資100億日圓、將中國12吋再生晶圓月產能提高至10萬片(目前為5萬片)。

另外，RS計畫在2026年投資38億日圓、將中國8吋生產晶圓(Prime Wafer、即矽晶圓)月產能提高至30萬片，2027年以後的投資計畫將視需求動向而定。

RS並計畫在2026年-2028年期間投資440億日圓(分別為100億日圓、220億日圓、120億日圓)，目標在2026年將中國12吋生產晶圓月產能提高至15萬片、2027年提高至20萬片、2028年進一步提高至25萬片。

news.Title: 國泰金前7月獲利逾873億元、EPS 5.68元
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-14 09:25:54 新聞中心 發佈

國泰金控(2882)公布2026年7月稅後淨利108.2億元，累計前7月稅後淨利達873.4億元；加計FVOCI股票處分損益後，累計前7月對保留盈餘影響數達1,870億元，續創歷史新高。國泰金前7月每股稅後盈餘(EPS) 5.68元。其主要子公司獲利表現亮眼，國泰世華銀行、國泰產險、國泰證券及國泰投信累計稅後淨利均續創歷年同期新高；其中，國泰金控及國泰人壽累計前7月對保留盈餘影響數亦再創歷史新高。

在子公司方面，國泰人壽7月稅後淨利54.2億元，累計稅後淨利達516.7億元，加計FVOCI股票處分損益，累計前7月對保留盈餘影響數已突破1,400億元。單月獲利持穩，主要受惠過往厚實CSM的穩定攤銷、經常性收益挹注，帶動保險本業及整體損益表現維持穩健。7月初年度保費及初年度等價保費分別為310億元及60億元，均維持穩定增長態勢。

7月受市場擔憂大量AI資本支出能否兌現獲利、相關類股估值過高，以及Fed貨幣政策不確定性升高等因素影響，拖累全球股、債市普遍回檔。然7月國泰人壽受惠CSM穩定釋出及經常性收益挹注外，亦掌握市場機會伺機實現資本利得，整體財務績效仍維持穩健。面對匯率波動，國泰人壽持續厚實外匯價格變動準備金，截至7月底累積餘額逾1,350億元，達歷史新高水平。

儘管7月全球金融市場劇烈震盪，國泰人壽憑藉強勁獲利表現及良好資產負債管理，金融資產評價波動相當程度上為負債評價所抵銷，使7月淨值仍維持逾9,200億元之水準，淨值比逾11%，整體影響溫和。

國泰世華銀行7月稅後淨利43.1億元，累計前7月稅後淨利313億元，年成長13%。淨利息收入方面，受惠放款動能強勁、財務資產部位成長以及降息帶動外幣資金成本下降，累計淨利息收入呈雙位數成長；手續費收入方面，財富管理維持強勁成長動能，信用卡簽帳金額成長動能亦維持強健，帶動整體淨手續費收入穩健成長。主力信用卡產品CUBE卡新戶增加，累計流通卡數超過600萬張，動卡率維持良好表現。截至7月底逾放比率為0.14%，備抵呆帳覆蓋率為1147%，資產品質維持穩健。

國泰產險7月稅後淨利5.2億元，累計前7月稅後淨利續創同期新高、達28.6億元，加計FVOCI股票處分損益16億元，累計前7月對保留盈餘影響數達44.6億元，整體營運穩健成長。國泰產險7月簽單保費收入達38.6億元，累計簽單保費達251.9億元，其中車險年增4%、健康及傷害險年增12%、火險年增12%；7月新車掛牌量較去年同期成長，支撐車險業務穩健發展；適逢暑假旅遊旺季，國人海外旅遊需求維持熱絡，帶動旅遊相關保障需求；商業保險則受大型商業火險保單挹注。

國泰證券7月稅後淨利9.9億元，累計前7月稅後淨利54億元，年增156%，累計稅後淨利已超越去年全年水準，主要受惠台股交易熱絡，經紀、自營及承銷三大業務同步成長，推升整體獲利。截至7月底，國泰證券累計台股市占率達4.63%，穩居歷史高檔；複委託成交量已超越去年全年規模，再度刷新歷史紀錄。台股及複委託開戶數均較去年同期倍增，從年輕小資族到熟齡投資人皆踴躍加入，顯示國泰證券數位平台服務深獲市場肯定。此外，國泰證券獲母公司國泰金控挹注資本50億，為未來業務發展備足銀彈，進一步提升業務承作量能與資本韌性。

國泰投信7月稅後淨利4.7億元，累計前7月稅後淨利21.2億元，年成長35%，總管理資產規模為3.4兆元，年成長52%。相較6月的類股輪動，7月風險明顯提高，美股大型科技股轉弱，但價值股相對抗跌；台股因半導體集中度高、籌碼擁擠與去槓桿賣壓，跌幅明顯大於美股；債券則受到油價、通膨與聯準會鷹派立場衝擊，長天期債券表現尤其疲弱。修正吸引台股買盤進駐，台股ETF多數呈現淨流入，主動國泰動能高息ETF則在開始配息後吸引投資人，持續有穩定資金流入，7月淨流入58億元。

news.Title: Apple’s next iPhone battle just got more complicated
news.Content: Apple ( AAPL ) is preparing to undertake a pretty unpleasant AI test. Google has unveiled the Pixel 11 series. With Gemini Intelligence incorporated much more deeply into the smartphone experience, it offers customers an AI assistant that can comprehend what they're doing across messaging, calendars, maps, and other services, then help take action. That's important, since Apple is likely to launch an overhauled Siri powered in part by Google's Gemini models. That is, Google is not merely one of Apple's AI providers. And it gives consumers a sneak peek of what a more powerful AI phone experience looks like ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Google's Pixel 11, with deeply integrated Gemini Intelligence, presents a significant AI challenge to Apple's upcoming Siri overhaul.
• The Pixel 11's AI assistant can comprehend and act across various services, offering a glimpse of advanced AI integration in smartphones.
• Apple is reportedly leveraging Google's Gemini models for its next-generation Siri, raising questions about competitive differentiation.
• The core challenge for Apple is integrating AI seamlessly into its ecosystem to maintain the iPhone's competitive advantage and installed base.
• While Apple has scale, a less capable or integrated Siri compared to Google's offering could pressure its strong hardware-software synergy reputation.
news.Keywords: AI integration, smartphone competition, virtual assistant, ecosystem lock-in, competitive advantage

news.Title: 仁寶攻漲停、南亞科創新高 台股驚驚漲上揚306點
news.Content:
台股今（14）日早盤開高震盪，上漲306點，來到46331點，漲幅0.7%，預估成交量來到1.3兆；櫃買指數則來到408.81點，上漲2.66點，漲幅0.57%。

權值股部分，台積電平盤震盪，上漲5元，來到2440元，漲幅0.21%，聯發科上漲100元，來到4325元，漲幅2.37%，鴻海來到262元，上漲0.5元，漲幅0.19%；受惠於法說報喜、獲利逾6成，仁寶跳空開高，漲停來到43.2元.。

觀察今日盤面，記憶體族群延續漲勢，華邦電到186.5元，上漲9.5元，漲幅5.65%，南亞科來到542元創新高，漲幅逾5%，旺宏來到142.5元，上漲6元，漲幅4.4%，力積電也有逾3%的漲幅。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 台股早盤上漲逾380點 台積電逆勢下殺 記憶體又大漲6％
news.Content:
美國通膨數據下修，升息預期再度降低，帶動美股周四收紅，台股昨（13日）站上46K大關之後，今（14日）又繼續向上挑戰，早盤以46103.81點開出，隨後上漲超過380點，權值股台積電下跌5元觸及2430元，台達電漲70元觸及1955元，聯發科漲140元觸及4365元。記憶體南亞科漲逾4%，華邦電也上漲超過6%。

台股反彈後正式重返46K大關，昨上漲503.41點，收在46021.48點，成交值新台幣1兆498億元。三大法人合計買超907.56億元。自營商買超150.6億元，投信買超0.01億元，外資及陸資單日買超金額創史上第7大，買超756.95億元。

針對台股後市，分析師林漢偉指出，台股今日挑戰反彈轉折區，反映通膨降溫與美股反彈利多，電子權值股延續漲勢，中小型股維持多方輪動。短線指數已逼近重要反壓，今天關鍵就在成交量能否放大，確認這波行情由反彈進一步轉為回升。

美國7月生產者物價指數PPI數據低於市場預期，顯示通膨壓力進一步降溫，市場對聯準會9月升息的預期持續下降，成為股市上漲的最大動力。林漢偉表示，資金重新回流AI軟硬體與科技成長股，推升美股連續兩天走高，其中標普500指數更創下歷史新高。

操作建議上，分析師張大文建議，現階段策略很清楚，進入套牢區要保留一定現金，並控制持股節奏、避免盲目追價，有計畫進出、資金效率最大化，鎖定H2獲利成長轉機股，第三季仍是「汰弱留強」聰明錢只會往強的走。

美股周四皆收紅，道瓊工業指數上漲69.72點（或0.13%）至53,839.99點，那斯達克指數漲214.54點（或0.81%）至26,803.03點，標普500指數漲50.49點（或0.65%）至7,798.99點，費城半導體指數漲56.62點（或0.46%）至12,456.00點，台積電ADR上漲1.34美元（或0.31%）至430.49美元。

news.Title: KOSPI自低點反彈逾22%步入技術性牛市，對沖基金低持倉恐觸發追價
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】《華爾街日報》報導，韓股週四延續強勁反彈，韓國綜合股價指數(KOSPI)收漲234.30點或3.56%，報6,813.34點，連續第四個交易日上揚，近四日累計漲約8.8%。指數較7月30日低點反彈逾22%，跨越自低點上漲20%的門檻，正式進入技術性牛市，從空頭市場翻轉至多頭市場僅花約兩週時間。記憶體雙雄為本輪反彈主力，三星電子收漲4.89%至26.8萬韓元，SK海力士大漲5.92%至159.3萬韓元。市場對AI數據中心投資及記憶體需求前景重拾信心，加上三星與SK海力士可能提高股東回報的預期，帶動科技股買氣；KOSPI波動率指數則較近期高峰近乎腰斬，顯示市場情緒已由7月恐慌性去槓桿轉向較穩定的風險承擔。

高盛交易台數據顯示，外資近期淨買入KOSPI股票約12億美元，其中約11億美元集中於科技類股；韓國本地機構淨買入約3.83億美元，科技類股買超約4.32億美元。相較之下，散戶趁反彈獲利了結，單是科技類股便淨賣出約15億美元，形成外資與機構接手、散戶退場的資金結構。

值得注意的是，對沖基金在7月暴跌後已大幅削減韓股部位，目前持倉回升速度明顯落後KOSPI逾22%的反彈幅度。分析人士指出，若指數持續上攻、三星電子突破50日均線，SK海力士重新站穩21日均線，持倉不足的基金可能因害怕錯失行情而被迫回補，成為下一階段潛在推力；不過，KOSPI仍低於6月高峰，100日均線亦構成後續技術阻力。

news.Title: 統一證券：台股估維持震盪盤堅
news.Content:
【昨日盤勢】：

美國7月CPI數據符合預期，升息預期降溫，費半指數大漲激勵周四台股跳空開高大漲，收盤成功站上4萬6大關，成交量也放大至一兆以上。盤面資金維持良性類股輪動，受惠AI與記憶體擴產需求一路向上游材料端延伸，SEMI最新統計第二季矽晶圓出貨旺，相關族群多檔亮燈漲停表現強勢，另外被動元件在日系大廠股價大漲連動下，龍頭廠國巨攻上漲停吹起反攻號角。權值股方面，台積電上漲0.83%、鴻海下跌2.96%、聯發科上漲5.23%、廣達下跌0.15%，台達電上漲5.31%。盤面強勢股，國巨*、信昌電、華新科、環球晶、台勝科、合晶、華碩、奇鋐等43檔漲停；和益、玉晶光、競國、鈞寶、創意、安碁、應廣等漲幅7%以上。盤面弱勢股，嘉澤、風青等跌停；美利達、亞德客-KY、威強電、佳大等跌幅6%以上。終場台灣加權指數上漲503.41點，以46021.48點作收，成交量1.04兆元。觀察盤面變化，三大類股漲跌互見，電子上漲1.42%、傳產下跌0.27%、金融下跌0.27%。在次族群部份以資訊服務、電腦及週邊設備、電子零組件表現較佳，分別上漲4.08%、3.03%、2.45%。

【資金動向】：

三大法人合計買超892.54億元。其中外資買超756.95億元，投信賣超15.02億元，自營商買超150.61億元。外資買超前五大為力積電、南亞科、大成鋼、兆豐金、和碩；賣超前五大為鴻海、群創、中鋼、華航、臺企銀。投信買超前五大為台新新光金、緯創、凱基金、欣銓、華星光；賣超前五大為華邦電、聯電、大成鋼、南茂、南亞。資券變化方面，融資增16.97億元，融資餘額為5497.81億元，融券增1.21萬張，融券餘額為21.4萬張。外資台指期部位，空單減少380口，淨空單部位86249口，借券賣出金額277.86億元。成交比重：電子88.64%、傳產9.11%、金融2.25%。

【今日盤勢分析】：

美國7月CPI月增0.1%，符合市場預期；排除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心PPI月增0.2%，低於市場預期的0.3%，進一步緩解市場對聯準會9月升息的擔憂，加上國際油價下跌逾2%，帶動美股四大指數全面收紅，標普500指數盤中首度突破7,800點，終場刷新歷史收盤紀錄。台積電ADR上漲0.31%，台指期夜盤上漲364點，預期台股震盪盤堅。台股後市分析如下：

第一、MSCI季度調整結果揭曉，台股在本次中，於MSCI全球市場指數權重由3.08％上調至3.13％，調升0.05個百分點；在MSCI全球新興市場指數權重由26.60％上調至26.85％，調升0.25個百分點；於MSCI亞洲除日本指數權重由29.75％上調至30.03％，調升0.28個百分點，意外超乎法人研判可能微降的預期。最新權重將在8月31日收盤生效。

第二、SEMI國際半導體產業協會12日舉辦半導體測試與量測產業倡議記者會，SEMI全球行銷長暨台灣區總裁曹世綸指出，測試與量測已由幕後走向台前，成為左右AI晶片良率、成本、效能及量產速度的關鍵環節；封測大廠京元電子總經理張高薰則表示，測試正由供應鏈的一部分，轉變為整體製程不可或缺的一環。

第三、技術面觀察，週四加權指數收量增帶上影線紅K，技術指標：KD 高檔鈍化、RSI 向散，MACD紅柱體持續擴大，整體技術面沿5日線震盪盤堅個格局仍未改變。

第四、盤面資金聚焦矽晶圓、被動元件、NB等族群，包括環球晶、台勝科、國巨*、華新科、華碩等表現強勢。

【投資策略】：

美PPI持平緩解升息疑慮，搭配油價與美債殖利率回落，帶動標普500再創新高。回歸台股，加權指數沿5日線盤堅挺進4萬6大關，受惠AI基本面與下週機器人展題材，行情維持震盪盤堅。惟目前5日均量不足1兆，需補量至1.2兆以上方能化解高檔解套賣壓；加諸融資持續增加與外資期貨淨空單逾8.6 萬口，仍須嚴防行情劇烈波動。操作建議「逢低布局、反彈汰弱留強」，選股以流動性佳的中大型AI權值股為主。長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進製程/封裝、載板與PCB、電源管理相關、機箱滑軌、機器人概念、特用化學及自行車等族群。

資料來源- MoneyDJ理財網

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》台股「新EPS王」呼之欲出！每股狂賺187元 董座曝4年大缺貨潮
news.Content:
小編今天（14）日精選5件國內外重要財經大事。台股上半年EPS（每股稅後純益）王呼之欲出！群聯第二季單季稅後純益262.19億元，EPS狂飆至118.57元，累計上半年大賺413.94億元，EPS更衝上187.43元，一舉超車宜鼎166.45元、緯穎156.38元及川湖110.96元；獲利大躍進，董事會同步宣布上半年每股豪發60元現金股利。

【1】群聯H1獲利躍進 配息60元

群聯執行長潘健成指出，市場往往認為記憶體價格上漲後，原廠即可快速增加資本支出、擴充產能，但實際新增NAND產能所需時間遠比市場想像更長。

他透露，近期與NAND原廠高層交流時，曾詢問從投資到真正進入量產需要多久，原先估計約兩年，但對方給出的答案是「四年」。

【2】MSCI成份股六進六出 南亞科獲調升權重最多

MSCI季度個股調整熱鬧滾滾，台灣指數成份股六進六出，陣仗之大超乎法人預期，記憶體在南亞科叩關成功下，帶領其餘指標股入列成份股；全球小型指數台股成份股也新增23檔、剔除27檔。觀察新成份股名單，光通訊與ABF／CCL供應鏈亦展現族群性，不讓記憶體族群專美於前。

【3】金控前七月狂賺 國泰金暫居冠

十家上市金控公司已公布7月獲利，單月合計稅後純益478.38億元，前七月達3,601.88億元，年增68.09％，其中，國泰金7月獲利逾百億元、達108.2億元，前七月873.4億元，暫居冠軍寶座。

值得注意的是，13家金控上半年狂賺4,408.75億元，已突破原來前七月原最高紀錄、2024年繳出的4,318.04億元成績，今年獲利表現相當受期待。

【4】高盛估Fed今年按兵不動

美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）符合預期，使得市場預期聯準會（Fed）9月升息的機率已降至3成多。高盛更大膽預期，美國今年可能維持利率按兵不動，理由為住房通膨可能降溫與就業市場表現均衡，讓通膨壓力有望在下半年逐步降低。

【5】AI滿血復活 韓股牛市回來了

拜槓桿強制平倉結束、半導體類股復甦和聯準會（Fed）升息預期降溫所賜，韓國股市已從7月底的波段低點強彈逾20％，符合技術性牛市定義。韓股在短期內由熊市回到牛市，反映投資人對AI概念股的信心回籠。

news.Title: Microsoft and Tesla Share a Common Concern, but Here's Why One Is Much More Justified
news.Content: For a large portion of the year, Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) were the two worst-performing "Magnificent Seven" stocks, but they've gone in two different directions since their latest earnings reports. As of market close on Aug. 11, Microsoft is up 6.5% year to date ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Microsoft and Tesla, initially underperforming "Magnificent Seven" stocks, have diverged significantly post-earnings.
• Microsoft's year-to-date performance is +6.5%, while Tesla's is -24%, attributed partly to differing capital expenditure (capex) justifications.
• Microsoft's Q2 capex was $41 billion (+70% YoY), generating $19.6 billion in free cash flow, whereas Tesla's $5.8 billion capex (+142% YoY) resulted in negative free cash flow (-$1.1 billion).

news.Title: 台股週五續彈機率高，留意記憶體股族群表現
news.Content:
【財訊快報／魏聖峰】繼前一日美CPI數據表現不錯後，週四公布的PPI指數也低於市場預期，降低聯準會短期升息的風險，激勵週四美股連二日上漲。不過，週四美股短線漲多後，尾盤漲幅收斂，四大指數漲幅都沒超過1%。不過，記憶體族群表現不錯，美光科技股價上漲4.23%、威騰電子股價上漲7.31%、SanDisk股價上漲13.67%、希捷科技股價上漲4.91%、SK海力士ADR上漲7.29%。台積電ADR上漲0.31%、日月光ADR上漲0.92%、聯電ADR上漲0.36%。以週四美股表現來看，週五可留意記憶體股能否帶動台股反彈表現。受到美國CPI以及近期公布的美國企業公布的最新財報表現，帶動週四台股表現，收盤時加權指數突破46000點大關，且成交量重回兆元，多頭氣勢有逐漸回籠態勢。台積電(2330)、聯發科(2454)和台達電(2308)帶動大盤多頭氣勢的攻堅角色，比較可惜的是，鴻海(2317)股價卻逆勢下跌2.96%，沒有跟上其他權值電子股的多頭漲勢。

週四盤中亮眼的在於股價基期相對較低、且有實質利多加持的電子次族群。被動元件族群由龍頭國巨*(2327)強勢攻上漲停板鎖死的帶動下，華新科(2492)、信昌電(6173)、凱美(2375)攻上漲停板，佳邦(6284)、聚鼎(6224)、九豪(6127)、雷科(6207)、蜜望實(8043)、金山電(8042)、日電貿(3090)、鈺邦(6449)、立隆電(2472)、禾伸堂(3026)等股都有好表現，被動元件股展現許久未見多頭氣勢。

記憶體族群因最新MSCI季度調整納入成分股，利多催化下，南亞科(2408)、鈺創(5351)聯手大漲，群聯(8299)、晶豪科(3006)也有多頭點火而上漲，但華邦電(2344)、旺宏(2337)則呈現開高走低，市場有獲利了結出場的現象。週四下午群聯召開法說會，第二季EPS 118.57元，累計上半年賺EPS 187.43元，群聯也大方宣布上半年要配股60元，有利於週四記憶體股表現。矽晶圓龍頭的環球晶(6488)早盤展現強勁的多頭氣勢，很早就漲停板關門，台勝科(3532)跟進漲停板鎖死，帶動中美晶(5483)、合晶(6182)的股價表現。受惠台積電今年資本支出創高，積極在先進製程與CoWoS設備拉貨，帶動台積電設備供應鏈股價表現，萬潤(6187)、陽程(3498)、致茂(2360)、帆宣(6196)、鴻勁(7769)、竹陞科技(6739)等股表現。週四市場的資金很明顯從過去漲多的高檔股，移向落後補漲與跌深反彈的標的。

週四被動元件族群全面走強，記憶體類股在利多發酵下也有不錯的表現，記憶體股比較可惜的是尾盤有人偷跑，如果這是洗盤的話，週五應該要補量續漲，才能證明多頭的強勢內涵。PCB族群週三股價展現不錯的多頭內涵，但週四表現稍嫌疲弱，僅玻纖布的德宏(5475)股價連二日攻上漲停板，聯茂(6213)、金居(8358)都收紅，但台光電(2383)股價卻呈現開高走收低格局。臻鼎-KY(4958)股價開高走低收小漲，ABF三雄的欣興(3037)、南電(8046)和景碩(3189)表現疲弱，假如PCB族群週五不能轉強，就得要留意先前的強勢表現要暫告一段落。

news.Title: 台股跌破季線該停損嗎？杜金龍揭「葛蘭碧法則」：這時反而是買點
news.Content:
資深分析師 杜金龍 指出，按照葛蘭碧8大法則，大盤破季線一定可以買。示意圖。（資料照，陳品佑攝）

台股7月劇烈震盪，有網友在大盤跌破季線時，停損投機標的，不料一停損就看到V型反轉，懷疑自己是不是做錯了？對此，資深分析師杜金龍於節目《股市錢滾錢》中指出，按照葛蘭碧8大法則，大盤破季線一定可以買。

葛蘭碧8大法則是什麼？

突破：均線由下跌逐漸轉為走平或上揚，且股價由均線下方向上突破均線，代表原本的跌勢可能告一段落。

假跌破：股價一度跌破均線，但很快重新站回均線之上，同時均線仍維持上升趨勢，意味跌破可能只是短暫現象，整體多頭格局未變。

支撐：股價持續位在均線之上，回檔時未跌破均線又向上反彈，顯示均線發揮支撐作用，行情趨勢沒有轉向。

抄底（反彈）：均線向下趨勢中，股價快速下跌並遠離均線，當跌幅過大開始反彈、重新朝均線靠攏，可視為短線反彈買進訊號。

跌破：均線由上升轉為走平或下彎，且股價由均線上方向下跌破均線，代表股價可能由多轉空。

假突破：股價短暫站上均線後又迅速跌回均線下方，此時均線仍維持下降趨勢，表示突破未能成立。

反壓：股價持續位於均線下方，即使反彈也無法突破均線，顯示均線形成壓力。

反轉：股價快速上漲並大幅偏離均線，當漲幅過大、股價開始回落，向均線靠近，可視為賣出訊號。

news.Title: 挪威、新加坡主權基金都在買台股！黃世聰曝「下個國家」可能是它：大錢長錢都回來了
news.Content:
台股連漲4天，今（13）日更收在46021點，回到4萬6大關。（資料照，顏麟宇攝）

台股在前幾周經歷大修正，甚至一度跌破4萬點，不過近日逐步站穩復活，指數連漲4天，今（13）日更收在46021點，回到4萬6大關。對此，財經專家 黃世聰 在節目《寶傑點兵》指出，台股今日漲了503點，但其實更好的消息是「量回來了」，過去幾天成交量都不到9000億，但今天是1.05兆，「這代表什麼？代表大錢、長錢都回來了！」

黃世聰表示，「大錢」指的是大戶願意歸隊，讓今日的高價股表現都相當不錯；「長錢」則是有很多國家的主權基金或央行，都加碼投資AI股，而台灣就是他們買進的標的。所以大錢、長錢都進來，讓盤勢的表現相當熱鬧。

台股默默回血沒撞牆？黃世聰：外資都買回來了​

黃世聰指出，這幾天看起來單日並沒有漲多少，但這周已經連漲4天，共漲了1793點，市場原本認為指數在4萬5、4萬6就會遭遇壓力，「結果沒想到默默地每一關都過了」；而且外資也回來大買超，今日買進756億，創史上第8大紀錄，這4天共買1607億，把之前賣的慢慢買回來，成為推高指數的燃料，「台股更有機會往上反彈」。

黃世聰提到，美超微財報大超預期，帶動美股費半、科技股全面大漲；另外也包括韓股的記憶體雙雄三星、SK海力士，韓股已從低點反彈23%，進入「技術性牛市」。「整個AI股往上衝，只要美股、韓股往上，台股也一定跟著往上拉。」

​​AI趨勢會維持多久？黃世聰：長錢、大錢還會繼續來​

黃世聰分析，「長錢跟大錢還會繼續來到台灣」，以AI趨勢來看，挪威主權基金買了一大堆的台灣股票，橋水基金也有買進台積電、新加坡淡馬錫更加碼記憶體，並強調會加深AI股占比，台灣就有可能是目標。

黃世聰指另外台灣最近也出現很多阿拉伯人的身影，除了是來取貨AI伺服器外，也可能是來慢慢布局台股，「我們接下來也有可能看到阿拉伯的主權基金來買台灣的權值股。」

news.Title: Cisco Drops 9% and Holds the Dow Back While the Nasdaq Climbs. Common Denominator: Memory Chips.
news.Content: Record revenue, record earnings, $4 billion in AI orders, and the stock fell 9%. Cisco Systems (NASDAQ: CSCO) had quite a morning. The result is a split morning session on Wall Street. The Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX: ^IXIC) index gained 0.53% as of 12:32 p.m. ET and the S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) is up by 0.41%, while the Dow Jones ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock fell 9.3% despite reporting record Q4 revenue of $17.3 billion (up 18% YoY) and record adjusted earnings of $1.22 per share.
• The decline was attributed to shrinking gross margins caused by soaring memory chip costs and a less favorable hardware sales mix.
• The company reported approximately $4 billion in AI orders from hyperscale customers during the quarter.
• Rising memory chip costs are benefiting chipmakers like SK Hynix (up 7.8%) and Micron Technology (up 5.1%), while impacting companies like Cisco that purchase these components.
• The market is reacting to the increased component costs impacting Cisco's margins, demonstrating how rising input prices can outweigh record revenue and earnings.
news.Keywords: component costs, gross margin, memory chips, AI orders, revenue impact

news.Content:
資深分析師 杜金龍 分析，每次縣市長選舉前面幾個月，台股都是箱型整理。示意圖。（資料照，陳品佑攝）

台股13日漲503.41點，收在4萬6021.48點，成交值新台幣1兆498億元。三大法人同步買超，合計買超907.56億元。對於台股是否有可能再打第2隻腳？資深分析師杜金龍於節目《股市錢滾錢》中分析，每次縣市長選舉，台股在前面幾個月都是箱型整理。​

杜金龍表示，8、9月大概還在箱型整理。7月已經有690幾家除權完了，大概配了1.8兆。以前說7到8月要扣1700點，因為有2兆左右。現在到7月已經大概1.8兆，8到9月的息值就不大，以前期貨不是先跌到4萬點，這次真的到4萬點。

息值是什麼？

公司將當年度賺到的利潤，以現金股利形式發放給股東時，每一股所代表的現金金額。

杜金龍提到，8、9月息值大概只剩下4000多億，所以扣的點數不會那麼大，是比較好的現象。大盤有可能3萬9384，或是往下再抓差不多1000點。如果按照技術的話，到3萬6是最漂亮的。可是目前台灣的GDP太好了，上市公司的獲利都好。所以可能4萬點附近完，這一波的低檔完以後，再走另外一波。

​10月前大盤會繼續震？​

主持人葉芷娟表示，所以至少10月以前，大盤還是會繼續震？即便台股從3萬9彈到了4萬5左右，杜金龍認為接下來再往下走，回到測4萬，甚至到3萬6都是有可能的？真的要看它回穩重新攻，成交量要先出來，櫃買要止穩，可能要到10月以後了？

杜金龍表示，沒有錯，這次難得等很久，因為跌了8000多點，很多股票殺很多。台積電現在彈上來比較弱勢，應該8、9月還是在區間整理。他一直很相信每次縣市長選舉，台股在前面幾個月都是箱型整理。4年前、8年前都一樣。這次跌了1隻腳下來以後，不管這1隻腳有沒有破前1低，相對就是一個好的買點。

打第2隻腳是什麼意思？

市場反彈一段時間後，整體信心尚未完全恢復，先前沒賣到的賣壓再度湧現，導致股價再次下跌。當這次下跌來到接近「第1隻腳」的低點位置附近時，若沒有繼續往下破底，反而獲得支撐並再次上漲，這個回測低點的過程就稱為「打第2隻腳」。

news.Title: 台股衝回4萬6！股民憂美國通膨恐成「隱藏炸彈」　專家點破迷思：下降才有害市場
news.Content:
台股逐步回升，今日延續漲勢，收盤上漲503點、收在46021點，站回4萬6大關。示意圖。（資料照，顏麟宇攝）

台股挺過前幾周的大回檔災情後逐步回升，今（13）日開高走高延續漲勢，收盤上漲503點、收在46021點，站回4萬6大關。財經作家狄驤分析，台股的籌碼集中力道相當強勁，但也有人擔心美國CPI仍高的通膨疑慮，對此他指出，其實「通膨趨緩」跟「通膨下降」是兩種狀況，趨緩是更大的利多好消息，但下降卻是負面影響。

狄驤在臉書發文指出，美國CPI符合預期，台股重返46000、美股進一步創高，回想前幾周台股還一度跌破40000大關，再次見識到去槓桿後的籌碼集中與FOMO力道有多強。

狄驤提到，可能有人會說CPI還是很高、不看好前景，但實際上我們要擔心的，是通膨增速是否有擴張，「如果像現在這樣沒有擴張，那真的是好消息沒錯。」

​通膨就是壞事？狄驤：要分清楚這兩種狀況​

狄驤強調，相對的，投資朋友也要分清楚「通膨趨緩」跟「通膨下降」兩種狀況，「趨緩」是指增速放緩，屬於更大的好消息；但通膨「下降」可能就是通縮了，對整體市場來說反而有負面影響。

狄驤直言，「所以說，適當的通膨是好事」，可以讓經濟、企業保持成長動力，他也是繼續看好市場前景。

狄驤提到，但有個小地方要注意，那就是短線上市場有點過熱了，我會開始找機會分批少量減碼。機會永遠都在，但假如沒有控制好風險，可能就沒有下一次了。

news.Title: MSCI調整 台股升至26.85%
news.Content:
明晟（MSCI）公司公布第3季指數調整結果，臺灣市場於MSCI全球 新興市場 指數（MSCIEmergingMarketsIndex）權重由26.60%進一步調升至26.85%，增加0.25個百分點；臺灣於MSCI全球市場指數（MSCIACWI）及MSCI亞洲除日本指數（MSCIACAsiaexJapan）權重亦分別調升至3.13%及30.03%，相關調整將於2026年8月31日收盤後生效。

值得關注的是，依MSCI截至7月底資料，臺灣在MSCI新興市場指數權重已達26.63%，成為新興市場指數第一大市場。上市公司中，台積電更以15.46%的權重居MSCI新興市場指數第一大成分股，聯發科、台達電及鴻海亦名列該指數前十大成分股，展現臺灣上市公司在全球半導體、AI及科技供應鏈的關鍵地位，亦凸顯上市市場已成為國際機構投資人參與臺灣優質企業及配置臺灣資產的重要平台。

本次MSCI全球標準型指數臺灣成分股新增之上市公司，其產業涵蓋記憶體及高階電子零組件等重要科技領域，凸顯臺灣上市企業在全球AI及半導體產業發展趨勢下的市場競爭力及國際能見度，進一步提升國際機構投資人參與度。

此外，本次MSCI全球小型股指數新增成分股包括創新板上市公司，也顯示臺灣具創新技術及成長潛力的企業正逐步受到國際指數及全球投資人的關注。臺灣創新板（tib-創）做為落實打造臺灣成為亞洲納斯達克的重要核心板塊，有別國際其他交易所將創新板塊視為次板的傳統框架，我國的臺灣創新板（tib-創）定位為與一般板並列的主板塊，提供橫跨上市前、中、後階段的全方位服務創新板作為證交所扶植創新成長企業進入公開資本市場的重要管道，隨企業營運規模及市場能見度提升，有助其逐步接軌國際資金與全球指數體系。

近年臺灣在MSCI新興市場指數權重持續提升，由去年第3季的19.40%持續提升至本季26.85%，顯示臺灣資本市場在全球新興市場版圖中的重要性明顯提升。

證交所表示，未來將持續協助具國際競爭力之優質企業進入資本市場，積極推動臺灣創新板發展，鼓勵具規模、成長性及國際發展潛力之企業善用上市市場籌資、提升品牌及接軌國際資本的功能，協助具創新、成長及關鍵技術能力之企業透過資本市場加速成長；同時持續提升公司治理、資訊揭露及市場制度與國際接軌程度，吸引更多國內外長期資金投入臺灣市場。

news.Title: 群聯上半年每股純益187.43元　配息60元
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中新竹2026年8月13日電）記憶體控制晶片廠群聯 (8299) 第2季歸屬母公司淨利新台幣262.17億元，創下歷史新高，每股純益達118.57元；累計上半年每股純益187.43元。群聯董事會決議上半年盈餘每股配發60元現金股利。

群聯今天召開線上法人說明會，公布第2季營運結果。受惠AI帶動的結構性儲存需求浪潮持續發酵，群聯第2季營收678.88億元，歸屬母公司淨利262.17億元，同創歷史新高，每股純益118.57元。

群聯累計上半年營收1088.55億元，毛利率63.8%，歸屬母公司淨利413.91億元，每股純益187.43元。董事會今天決議上半年盈餘每股配發60元現金股利。

群聯統計，第2季存貨淨額917.92億元，平均存貨週轉天數297日。群聯指出，存貨以應用於非零售市場為大宗，將持續密切觀察市場需求與公司策略進行存貨調整。

群聯執行長潘健成說，AI正帶動全球儲存產業進入一個與過去完全不同的發展階段。AI推論所產生的資料與詞元（Token）需求持續快速增加，使儲存型快閃記憶體需求不再如過去只是跟著個人電腦、手機等終端裝置出貨量成長，而是由AI基礎建設與AI應用本身創造新的結構性儲存需求。

潘健成表示，面對AI時代對效能、容量、能耗與成本的全新要求，群聯將持續深化與全球中央處理器（CPU）、繪圖處理器（GPU）、雲端服務商及AI生態系夥伴的策略合作，聚焦企業級、AI及客製化儲存解決方案，同時大幅降低對低毛利、標準化零售市場的依賴。

潘健成並說明與投保中心之間的訴訟爭議。他表示，尊重投保中心的訴求，只要對方能提出證據，證明群聯過去的經營方式確實造成當時股東損害，他願意負起責任並賠償；但若無法證明，就不應讓案件一再拖延，耗費司法資源，影響現在的股東權益。

news.Title: 科技股漲勢帶動韓股收高逾3%　亞股走勢不一
news.Content:
（中央社香港2026年8月13日綜合外電報導）最新數據顯示美國上月通膨降溫，聯邦準備理事會（Fed）升息疑慮緩解，提振市場信心。同時，科技股漲勢帶動今天韓股收盤勁揚超過3%，東京和台北股市收盤漲幅也逾1%。

法新社報導，美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）符合市場預期，此前公布的數據則顯示就業市場降溫，可望讓聯準會暫時維持利率不變。

然而，由於通膨率已連續逾5年高於聯準會2%的目標，加上中東戰爭推升油價，外界仍預期聯準會最終將在某個時間點收緊貨幣政策。

盛寶金融（Saxo Markets）分析師威爾森（NeilWilson）表示：「7月通膨數據連續第65個月高於目標，儘管如此，美國CPI數據讓9月升息可能性降低。」

他指出：「對市場來說，這看起來似乎已經夠溫和，讓聯準會有更多時間，在通膨高於目標的情況下繼續觀望。」

前夜華爾街股市普遍走高，部分亞股今天也隨之上揚。日韓股市領漲亞股，成為市場重新看好人工智慧（AI）交易的主要受益者。AI熱潮今年推動日韓股市大幅上揚並屢創新高。

韓股今天在SK海力士（SK hynix）和三星（Samsung）漲勢帶動下，收盤勁揚3.6%。韓股自7月30日低點迄今在10個交易日內，反彈大漲約22%。

日股則是在記憶體製造商鎧俠（Kioxia）、東京威力科創（Tokyo Electron）和愛德萬測試（Advantest）重獲買盤青睞帶動下，收盤漲幅逾1%。

至於其他亞股，台北與威靈頓股市也收高；香港、上海、雪梨、新加坡和馬尼拉股市則是收跌。

【記者呂承哲／台北報導】美國最新通膨數據並未隨著近期美伊衝突推升油價升溫，市場對於美國聯準會（Fed）利率升息預期下降，加上美國記憶體股強力反彈，帶動美股週三（12日）標普500指數、那斯達克指數上揚，道瓊工業平均指數下跌0.4%，費城半導體指數勁揚2.49%，輝達股價上漲3.03%，美光股價上漲4.92%，台積電ADR上漲1.68%。台股週四（13日）開盤上漲650點，重返4萬6關卡，台積電漲20元，報2435元。

台股週四收盤，台股終場上漲503.41點或1.11%、報46021.48點，成交金額超過兆元。台積電股價上漲20元或0.83%、報2435元，台達電股價上漲95元或5.31%、報1885元，聯發科股價上漲210元或5.23%、報4225元，鴻海股價下跌8元或2.96%、報262元。

在權值股以及多個熱門族群領軍下，台股12日終場上漲397.35點，報在45,518.07點，成交金額來到8587.32億元。三大法人方面，外資買超110.21億元、為連三買，自營商買超87.01億元，投信買超28.01億元，合計買超225.22億元。

鴻海（2317）12日召開法說會並公布2026年第二季財報，合併營收2.53兆元、年增41%，毛利率6.12%、營業利益率3.75%、淨利率2.37%，三率均較去年同期成長，每股盈餘（EPS）4.27元；上半年營收累計達4.65兆元。

鴻海集團輪值CEO蔣集恆表示，受惠CSP客戶持續擴大資本支出，AI機櫃持續放量，第三季VR機櫃開始量產，預估整體AI機櫃營收將季增，出貨量可望呈高雙位數成長，今年全年AI機櫃出貨更將有倍數以上成長。

蔣集恆指出，隨AI機櫃持續擴大市占，預估雲端網路產品第三季營收將呈現季增、年增高雙位數成長；高速網路產品同步推進，800G以上交換機全年營收可望倍增，CPO全光交換機也將按計畫於第三季量產出貨。

SEMI國際半導體產業協會則是於12日SEMICON Taiwan展前會「AI時代半導體測試與量測產業洞察暨倡議記者會」，SEMI全球行銷長暨台灣區總裁曹世綸表示，AI已徹底改變半導體產業風貌，隨AI晶片價值提高、先進製程持續微縮及3D結構日益複雜，錯誤成本同步攀升，量檢測不能只停留在「看見錯誤」，更要理解錯誤來源並即時調整，角色也從幕後品管走向前台。

致茂電子執行長兼總經理暨SEMI檢測與計量委員會主席曾一士表示，近年測試與檢測設備全球營收成長斜率明顯上升，並非AI投資帶來的短期榮景，而是量檢測正迎來典範轉移。

京元電子總經理張高薰則是形容，現在產品開發走在技術成熟之前，如同「穿著衣服改衣服」，開發過程中測試結果的即時回饋更加重要。另一方面，半導體產業從IDM逐步拆分為Foundry、Fabless及OSAT後，原本高度整合的產品工程也分散至不同環節，未來測試業必須進一步串聯設備、配件、測試與客戶產品，建立新的合作模式。

news.Title: The Race to $5 Trillion: Who Will Get There First, Apple or Alphabet?
news.Content: Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) and Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL) have never ended the day in the $5 trillion market cap club. The only company to ever achieve that feat is Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA), and it's likely to stay there for good. But which one of these two will join Nvidia first? Apple has a head start, ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Apple and Alphabet are competing to reach a $5 trillion market capitalization, a milestone only Nvidia has achieved.
• Alphabet's Google Cloud saw 82% revenue growth in Q2, contributing to a 24% overall revenue increase, and plans $200 billion in data center capex this year.
• Apple faces headwinds from memory chip price increases, forcing a choice between raising prices (potentially deterring consumers) or absorbing costs (reducing profitability).
• Alphabet's business is seen as better positioned to reach $5 trillion first due to its strong growth and AI demand.
• Apple trades at a premium valuation compared to Alphabet, especially when considering operating cash flow, making Alphabet the more likely candidate to reach $5 trillion first.
news.Keywords: market capitalization, revenue growth, cloud computing, memory chip prices, valuation premium

news.Title: While AGNC Investment Offers a 13.5% Yield, I Just Bought This High-Yield Dividend Stock Instead
news.Content:
AGNC Investment (NASDAQ: AGNC) currently offers a monster 13.5% dividend yield. As much as I like passive income, I decided to pass on buying shares of the mortgage-focused real estate investment trust (REIT). Instead, I recently bought a different high-yielding dividend stock, fellow mortgage REIT Ladder Capital (NYSE: LADR).

I'm not going to lie, AGNC Investment's dividend is very tempting, as it offers a massive yield and a monthly payment schedule. The mortgage REIT has also put together a solid streak of 75 consecutive monthly dividend payments at its current rate. However, there are a couple of things that Ladder Capital offers that make it a better income investment for me.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

What's preventing me from buying AGNC Investment

AGNC Investment has a singular focus. It invests solely in Agency MBS, pools of residential mortgages guaranteed against credit risk by government agencies such as Fannie Mae . They're low-risk, fixed-income investments. AGNC boosts its returns with leverage, also increasing its risk profile. The REIT ended the second quarter with a leverage ratio of 7.4 times. That's at the high-end of its 7.0-7.5x target range.

That leverage works both ways. It enhances returns in supportive market environments and weighs on them when conditions deteriorate. When its returns fall out of alignment with its costs, it puts AGNC's dividend at risk. While that's not a concern these days, the REIT has cut its payout several times, most recently in 2020.

The safer mREIT

Ladder Capital is a mortgage REIT with a very different investment focus and business model. It finances commercial real estate. The REIT primarily originates senior secured first mortgage loans on commercial real estate (about 49% of its portfolio). Additionally, Ladder invests in AAA bonds backed by senior secured first mortgage loans (CMBS and commercial real estate collateralized loan obligations, or CRE CLOs), which is about 33% of its portfolio. Finally, the REIT has a portfolio of owned real estate, primarily properties secured by long-term net leases (18% of its portfolio).

That much more diversified portfolio helps lower its risk profile. It also gives Ladder the flexibility to invest capital where it sees the best risk-adjusted return opportunities. Additionally, its equity investments provide durable, growing long-term cash flow and upside potential from appreciation.

Story Continues

Ladder also has a much lower leverage ratio (2.3x, toward the lower end of its 2.0x-3.0x target range). Its leverage ratio is low for the sector and backs the company's investment-grade balance sheet (Ladder is the only REIT focused on commercial real estate financing with an investment-grade rating). That reduces risk and provides greater financial flexibility.

Finally, whereas AGNC strives to maintain its dividend, Ladder Capital aims to grow its earnings. That should support dividend growth and share price appreciation, positioning it to produce higher total returns.

Better risk-reward potential

AGNC's big-time monthly dividend really tempts me. However, I want more than a static income stream; I'm still young enough to want some growth (in both income and share price appreciation), which Ladder Capital offers. It provides the income (Ladder yields more than 9.5%) and upside potential while having a lower-risk profile than AGNC. That's why I just added Ladder to my portfolio instead of going with the higher-yielding, higher-risk income stream offered by AGNC.

news.Title: Exclusive-Microsoft retreats in China, but AI boom helps it keep a window open
news.Content:
By Eduardo Baptista and Casey Hall

BEIJING/SHANGHAI, Aug 13 (Reuters) - Microsoft once regarded the idea of quitting China as unthinkable.

The year was 2010 and Google was about to exit due to concerns over censorship and cyberattacks. That decision was lauded by democracy activists, but not Bill Gates and Microsoft's then-CEO Steve Ballmer, who suggested Google was overreacting.

More from Yahoo Scout

What role does ByteDance play in Microsoft's China presence?

How are export controls impacting Microsoft's China talent retention?

How have U.S.-China tensions affected Microsoft's business strategy?

Why is Microsoft retreating from its China operations?

In the past five years, however, at least 15 Microsoft branch offices and joint ventures in China have been shut, corporate filings show, and Microsoft is pursuing what five company sources described as ‌a strategy of retreat.

The firm considered quitting the market in 2023 because some executives felt it took on too much geopolitical risk for too little economic return, one of them said, while stressing Microsoft has no current plans to exit. China accounted for just 1.5% of global ‌revenue, Microsoft said in 2024.

Microsoft took a major hit from the erosion of trust between Washington and Beijing, the five people said. China has since 2017 pushed the use of domestic software, which Beijing sees as more secure and whose quality is increasingly competitive with Windows and Office. U.S. restrictions, including export controls on advanced technology, have meanwhile hindered efforts to scale Microsoft's lucrative AI and ​cloud businesses in China.

Details of Microsoft's internal deliberations about its future in China have not previously been reported.

Other U.S. tech giants with large China businesses are also reconsidering their exposure amid geopolitical tensions. Apple plans to manufacture in India most iPhones sold to Americans by the end of 2026, while Elon Musk last month denied reports that Tesla is debating separating its China business.

Microsoft ultimately decided to remain because it had carved out a profitable business servicing Chinese companies like TikTok owner ByteDance, which need Western technology to manage overseas operations, according to three people familiar with the matter. The company also believed that it needed a presence to maintain access to China's world-class engineering talent, two of them said.

Microsoft had also cultivated a relationship with the government that is among the deepest of any tech company, its former China head Alain Crozier told Reuters. "Because of the geopolitics … some days it's a little bit harder, but we never had a crisis," he said.

A Microsoft spokesperson did not address questions about the ‌firm's deliberations on its China business but said it operates in a regulatory "environment that applies to every international ⁠supplier" and that it remains committed to the Chinese market.

Story Continues

The state of Microsoft's China business reflects market competition, regulatory demands and technological trends, the company said.

ByteDance did not respond to questions about its relationship with Microsoft.

CHINA BLUES

Microsoft's engagement with the highest levels of China's government dates back to the early 1990s. Gates made the first of his many visits in 1994 and was received by President Jiang Zemin, who advised the Microsoft co-founder to study Chinese history.

The company has since made various efforts to ⁠build a relationship with the ruling Communist Party. Microsoft co-invested in startup incubators with the government and complied with censorship requirements that Google — now part of Alphabet — could not countenance.

By the mid-2010s, however, China had become increasingly suspicious of Western technology after revelations that U.S. firms had helped Washington spy on foreign governments. That was problematic for Microsoft as China's largest companies are either state-owned or maintain close government ties.

Microsoft's response was Windows 10 China Government Edition, whose release was personally negotiated between chief executive Satya Nadella and finance ministry officials, according to a person familiar with the matter.

The product was adopted by several government agencies, but did not take off as Microsoft hoped, said Crozier, who ran China operations ​through ​2021.

At around the time of the Windows announcement in 2017, the Chinese government introduced new procurement guidelines that it billed as a framework for purchasing "safe and reliable" services. No foreign ​operating system, including Windows, has been regarded by the government as compliant with those policies, Microsoft said.

Non-compliance did not mean ‌products were banned but it subjected tech administrators who used such services to scrutiny, including having to run more security checks and seek additional approval, said Paul Triolo, a Washington-based China tech policy expert at DGA-Albright Stonebridge Group.

Reuters reviewed six Chinese government computer-system procurement guides published between December 2023 and May 2026. Five did not recommend Microsoft. The sixth included Windows 10 China Government Edition but said its usage was subject to "additional management requirements," without elaborating.

The Chinese tech and finance ministries did not respond to questions about the effect of regulations on Microsoft's business.

U.S. businesses operating in China, which have long complained about an uneven playing field, have had their confidence further dented by deteriorating Sino-American ties. Just 52% of respondents to the American Chamber of Commerce in China's latest business climate survey said China was a top global investment priority, down from 62% in 2019.

While its efforts to become the Chinese state's tech vendor of choice did not pay off, Microsoft found a second wind with the private sector.

Firms like ByteDance and ultra-fast-fashion retailer Shein have key businesses serving Western customers and rely on Microsoft's Azure cloud to manage data in compliance with foreign regulations, two company sources said. Microsoft also offers Chinese enterprise clients exclusive access via Azure to Western AI models from providers like ‌OpenAI, which do not serve China.

By the mid-2020s, helping Chinese firms go global had become Microsoft's largest China-linked business, three people said. Two of them stressed that sales remained ​small by the firm's global standards.

Analysts have additionally questioned the sustainability of that AI business, which relies on third-party suppliers like OpenAI. Chinese businesses also do not need Azure if they use ​domestic AI models like Kimi, which are increasingly competitive with Western alternatives while being far cheaper.

OpenAI and Shein did not respond to questions.

HUMAN CAPITAL

Microsoft has ​since the 1990s played a central role in building China's tech talent base.

Alongside hiring commercially focused engineers, it also established Microsoft Research China, which concentrates on advanced technologies. The lab's alumni include senior leaders at AI pioneers SenseTime and DeepSeek.

But the recent ‌political pressures have affected Microsoft's ability to retain talent.

U.S. export controls on chips and AI models have restricted the ​access of Microsoft's China-based engineers to cutting-edge technology. The firm doesn't conduct research on ​quantum computing and other sensitive technologies in China, Microsoft president Brad Smith told U.S. lawmakers in 2023.

Microsoft considered shutting the lab down but ultimately decided to relocate some top talent, according to two people familiar with the matter. Since the U.S. began restricting AI exports, Microsoft Research China — now known as Microsoft Research Asia — has opened labs in Vancouver, Singapore and Tokyo.

The firm has, however, struggled to convince developers to leave China. It offered 1,000 top engineers relocation to the U.S. and three other Western countries in 2024, but only about a third accepted, the sources said.

Microsoft ​confirmed it offered transfer opportunities that year but declined to provide more details.

Many senior engineers instead left for Chinese universities ‌and tech firms, where they can conduct top-level research while remaining close to family, both sources said.

Microsoft had previously warded off poaching efforts by domestic rivals. The firm had an attrition rate of roughly 17% in the mid-2010s, though Crozier said Microsoft reduced it to ​under 10% by growing new businesses, like servicing ByteDance, and offering staff global opportunities.

There is "up and down in terms of the number of people and maybe some of the things that were developed over there," he said. "But we never change one inch of the ​fact that we will bring technology into China… for China, for Chinese companies."

(Reporting by Eduardo Baptista in Beijing and Casey Hall in Shanghai; Editing by Katerina Ang)

news.Title: 主動台股ETF 8月以來規模大增1636億
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】經過7月大盤大跌的洗禮，主動式台股ETF規模首見今年來減少744億，不過8月來僅短短8個交易日，大盤回神上漲5.56%，主動式台股ETF規模也增加了1636.27億，顯現人氣回籠。進一步觀察主動式台股ETF 8月以來平均上漲12.18%，而規模增加前10名的以主動群益科技創新（00992A）上漲16.67%表現最亮眼。市場法人表示，主動式台股ETF可在盤勢多空之際來回靈活操作，建議投資人可以主動式台股ETF參與台股未來上漲契機。

群益投信主動式台股ETF研究團隊表示，大盤在高檔震盪下，接下來面臨的挑戰更為複雜，此時也凸顯主動選股、靈活調整的重要性。台股類股輪動快速、個股波動性大，預期台股指數傾向高檔震盪，不過，在台股具基本面支撐、後市不看淡前提下，可運用主動式台股ETF介入台股。

主動群益科技創新經理人陳朝政指出，在科技產業成長趨勢未變以及內需穩健下，台股中長線還是持續看好。由於AI資料中心對光通訊產品的爆發性需求，儘管相關廠商均積極擴產，2026年底預期仍有25~30%供給缺口，主要瓶頸在於上游雷射，為隨時間推移，銅解決方案逐漸被光通訊取代，光通訊需求將持續成長，持續看好光通訊廠商營運發展，隨著上游雷射廠商積極擴產，台廠可望同步受惠。

主動群益台灣強棒ETF（00982A）經理人陳沅易表示，近期在市場雜音干擾下，台股波動加劇，不過整體來看，基於台灣經濟狀況穩健，且下半年逢消費性電子產品備貨旺季，同時AI需求依舊強勁，故出口動能可望延續，台系科技供應鏈也在全球AI成長趨勢未變下，料持續從中受惠。（自立電子報2026/8/13）

news.Title: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Short-Sellers Probably Won't Survive. These 3 Earnings Numbers Say He's Wrong.
news.Content:
Last month, Elon Musk took to X to tell the short-sellers betting against his rocket company, Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ: SPCX), that their "survival probability" is "very low."

And after its first quarterly report was released last week, a whole lot of investors think he's right. The company gave bulls plenty to like, with revenue up 92% year over year (YoY), the doubling of Starlink subscriptions, and adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) nearly tripling.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

But dig a little deeper into the numbers, and I think there are plenty of reasons to think the short-sellers -- who profit when share prices fall -- are right.

SpaceX's cash burn is staggering

SpaceX generated $3.5 billion in operating cash flow through the first six months of 2026 -- impressive, until you see that the company made $28.5 billion in capital expenditures (capex).

Free cash flow (FCF) was roughly negative $25 billion in just six months. And that actually understates the economic investment somewhat, because another roughly $3.9 billion of capital expenditures were financed rather than paid in cash.

Now, to be fair, this is a company in the middle of an enormous build-out, and heavy spending today can mean big payoffs down the road -- in theory. Spending at this pace and on this scale puts a whole lot of pressure on those investments to pay off quickly, and, at least for the spending on AI, there's a real question of whether they will pay off at all.

One customer accounts for nearly 20% of revenue

One unnamed customer accounted for 19.5% of SpaceX's entire Q2 revenue and the lion's share of its AI revenue. That could be a serious problem if the customer backs out, especially given that AI is where SpaceX is spending lavishly -- $23.6 billion of its total capex went into AI alone.

Although the customer is unnamed, it is very likely that it's Anthropic, the maker of Claude. The deal to lease computing capacity from SpaceX's xAI is cancellable by either side with just 90 days' notice after an initial ramping period. That is not the kind of agreement you want when you're committing billions to service it.

We've already seen how loose these arrangements can be. Musk himself previously clarified that one heavily touted lease was initially just for 180 days, despite the potential for a much longer relationship.

Story Continues

Starlink's hidden problem: falling revenue per user

Starlink is still SpaceX's best business, generating $4.3 billion of Q2 revenue and $1.7 billion in operating income.

But I think investors have been ignoring a problem: Average revenue per user (ARPU) has been falling. The figure came in at just $66 per month, and though that's little changed from the previous quarter, it's down from $85 a year earlier.

ARPU decline is fine when you have subscriber growth to compensate -- and make no mistake, Starlink very much does at this point -- but as time goes on and more of the market is captured , especially in more developed nations, I think ARPU could start sliding even faster even as growth slows.

Is SpaceX stock overvalued?

Now, I'm not advocating that you short SpaceX stock -- that's a very dangerous maneuver that can easily backfire if you're wrong -- but I am saying that short-sellers will ultimately be proven right . I believe that SpaceX stock is overvalued and that the top-line growth is overshadowing some serious flaws beneath the surface.

And, remember, during the next year, nearly $6 billion of shares owned by early SpaceX  investors and employees will be unlocked and available for sale on public markets. Even a sliver of those insiders deciding to sell could put pressure on the stock price.

news.Title: XRP (Ripple) Just Did Something It Hasn't Done Since 2024, and Here's What It Means for Investors
news.Content:
In 2012, a company called Ripple launched the XRP Ledger, a decentralized blockchain designed for rapidly settling global payments. XRP (CRYPTO: XRP) is the ecosystem's native cryptocurrency, used to pay fees and bridge fiat currency exchanges, speeding up transactions and minimizing costs.

However, Ripple went on to launch a comprehensive payment network that now supports a range of alternatives, including stablecoins. This is gradually eroding XRP's utility, contributing to a 72% decline in the token's value from last year's peak of $3.65. In fact, on Aug. 11, XRP briefly traded below $1 for the first time since 2024.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Here's what all of this means for investors going forward.

XRP is no longer the only game in town

The global banking system is highly fragmented. Some financial institutions use the SWIFT (Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication) network, while others don't, so transacting with one another often requires an intermediary. This creates friction, slows processing times, and adds costs.

Ripple Payments facilitates communication between banks, no matter what existing infrastructure they use, allowing them to settle transactions with one another directly and, therefore, instantly. XRP can standardize those transactions; for example, an American bank sending money to a Mexican bank via Ripple Payments might have its U.S. dollars converted into XRP tokens, which are then converted into Mexican pesos at the receiving bank.

This whole process takes just a few seconds, and it can eliminate costly foreign exchange fees that would normally come with converting U.S. dollars directly into Mexican pesos. In fact, such a transaction through Ripple can cost as little as 0.00001 XRP tokens, or a fraction of one U.S. cent.

But not every bank will use XRP because of its extreme volatility, which can result in steep losses if they need to hold tokens for an extended period. Ripple launched a U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin, Ripple USD (CRYPTO: RLUSD), in late 2024 to address this issue. As their name implies, stablecoins maintain a consistent value, so senders and recipients face virtually no risk of loss due to volatility. Plus, countries like the U.S. already have regulatory frameworks for stablecoins in place, making them a relatively safe choice.

Story Continues

Ripple USD runs on the XRP Ledger, so any transaction fees incurred are still payable in XRP tokens. Therefore, XRP isn't entirely redundant, but there is a good chance that stablecoins will absorb a growing share of transaction volume over time because of their more favorable qualities.

History suggests XRP could trade much lower in the future

When XRP soared to $3.65 last year, it marked the first new all-time high since 2018. Following that previous occasion, the token had lost 95% of its peak value by mid-2020, and it remained below $1 until November 2024. I think history could repeat, so its recent losses could be the start of a prolonged downturn.

As mentioned earlier, banks don't have to use XRP to benefit from instant cross-border transactions through Ripple Payments thanks to alternatives like Ripple USD. That means even if the network becomes wildly successful in the coming years, it won't necessarily translate into a higher value for XRP.

Moreover, bridge currencies like XRP weren't actually designed to provide returns for investors. In my earlier example, the American bank would be a buyer of XRP. Still, the Mexican bank would be an equal seller when it converts the tokens into pesos, so the transaction would be a wash and create absolutely no value.

It seems XRP's past rallies were mostly driven by speculative investors who thought the token would be more widely used than it currently is, so I'm not surprised it's trending lower. If the recent decline matches the magnitude of the post-2018 plunge, then XRP could eventually fall to around $0.18 per token. I'm not suggesting that will happen, but I think the recent dip below $1 is a clear warning that investors should brace for more downside.

news.Title: Google Parent Alphabet Just Revealed How Many SpaceX Shares It Owns... and the Figure Is a Doozy
news.Content:
For most investors, earnings season is the pinnacle of each quarter. The six-week period during which most S&P 500 companies report their quarterly operating results provides invaluable information for investors.

But a strong argument can be made that quarterly Form 13F filings can be equally important. These filings detail which stocks Wall Street's brightest money managers purchased and sold in the latest quarter. The catch is that "money managers" also includes businesses with sizable investment portfolios, such as Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL)(NASDAQ: GOOG).

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

When most investors hear the Alphabet name, they think of Google, which holds a virtual monopoly in global internet search , and Google Cloud, the world's No. 3 cloud infrastructure service platform by total spend. But when it comes to investments, Alphabet has proven to be the Warren Buffett of Wall Street.

Google's SpaceX investment has gone parabolic

Looking in the rearview mirror, Google acquired streaming platform YouTube in October 2006 for $1.65 billion. Today, YouTube is the second-most-visited social site on the planet, behind only Google, and as a stand-alone entity, it might fetch a valuation of $500 billion (or more).

However, Google's investment in Elon Musk's Space Exploration Technologies (SpaceX) (NASDAQ: SPCX) may give YouTube a run for its money.

Google initially invested around $900 million in SpaceX in January 2015. At the time, SpaceX was being valued at $12 billion, netting Google a roughly 7.5% stake in the company.

Following several rounds of additional financing, this initial 7.5% stake has been diluted, but to what extent remained a mystery -- until now.

On Aug. 6, Alphabet filed its 13F with regulators covering its second-quarter trading activity. Given that SpaceX went public on June 12, Google's parent company is now required to include its SpaceX holdings in its quarterly 13F.

As of the end of June, Alphabet revealed a 551,189,500-share stake in SpaceX, worth $94.18 billion, which comprised 95% of its investment portfolio. According to Alphabet's second-quarter filing, $80 billion of this position is subject to short-term sale restrictions, with the remainder restricted through the third quarter of 2027.

Alphabet has a knack for spotting deals

Story Continues

As of the closing bell on Aug. 7, Google's initial investment in SpaceX has increased in value by more than 8,000% -- and there's more where this came from.

In addition to striking it rich with SpaceX, Google was an early investor in Anthropic, the developer behind the Claude large language models. Alphabet gobbled up a 10% stake in Anthropic in April 2023, pledged another $2 billion (with $500 million upfront) later that year, and announced $40 billion in add-on investments (with $10 billion upfront) in April 2026.

Alphabet is estimated to hold a 14% stake in Anthropic. Despite its total investment in the brainchild behind Claude adding up to less than $13 billion, Alphabet's stake in Anthropic may be worth in excess of $120 billion.

Alphabet has a virtual monopoly on global internet search traffic, has seen Google Cloud sales go parabolic following the integration of artificial intelligence solutions, and has a cash pile that nearly all businesses would envy. But its penchant for making winning investments may be its defining trait.

news.Title: 台股重返「兆元量」！國巨引領被動元件飆風再起 華碩財報點火「雙碩」漲停｜Yahoo財經掃描
news.Content:
台積電與電子權值股攜手點火！台股今(13)日早盤站上4萬6千點，盤中一度衝抵46,216.41點，終場上漲503.41點、漲幅1.11%，收在46,021.48點，成交金額達1兆515.91億元，電子類股勁揚1.42%，金融類股則小跌0.27%。

權王 台積電(2330) 上漲20元、收2,435元，穩住大盤多頭陣腳； 聯發科(2454) 、 台達電(2308) 雙雙勁揚約半根漲停，權值電子股全面接棒。盤面題材百花齊放， 台灣大(3045) 斥資291億元、溢價約30%收購精誠， 精誠(6214) 應聲亮燈漲停，台灣大股價反而收在平盤之下；受惠MSCI季度調整，新增成分股激勵，記憶體及PCB族群強勢表態。

華碩公布財報繳出「三率三升」成績， 華碩(2357) 、 和碩(4938) 雙雙攻上漲停；被動元件買氣重燃， 國巨(2327) 、 華新科(2492) 同樣亮燈， 禾伸堂(3026) 、 日電貿(3090) 、 信昌電(6173) 均漲逾8%。此外， 榮成(1909) 宣布轉型投資控股公司後恢復交易，股價漲逾半根漲停；台北國際自動化工業大展下周登場，資金提前卡位機器人族群， 所羅門(2359) 衝上漲停， 上銀(2049) 、 和椿(6215) 同步勁揚。

亞股在美國AI與半導體股反彈帶動下漲跌互見，日經指數上漲1.16%，韓國綜合指數勁揚3.56%，主要受三星電子上漲、SK海力士勁揚助攻；香港恆生指數則小跌0.17%，上海綜合指數同步下滑0.50%。

投資人持續追逐AI與半導體題材，美股四大指數呈現漲多跌少，道瓊工業指數微跌0.04%，標普500指數上漲0.26%，那斯達克指數走揚0.54%，費城半導體指數則強彈2.49%。

📝盤點熱門股：力積電、主動統一升級50、群益臺灣加權正2

熱門成交股方面，記憶體股包辦兩席， 力積電(6770) 以46.85萬張居成交王，受現金股利拍板與記憶體題材帶動，買氣爆棚、股價走揚； 華邦電(2344) 獲納MSCI成分股助攻，盤中多空交戰激烈，終場收平盤。

ETF交易同樣火熱， 主動統一升級50(00403A) 隨主動選股題材吸引資金進駐， 群益臺灣加權正2(00685L) 則因台股走強帶旺槓桿操作需求，雙雙走揚；伺服器代工股 仁寶(2324) 受AI業務成長、上半年獲利年增9成激勵，惟短線賣壓湧現，股價下挫。

📌三大法人買賣超

news.Title: Michael Burry Warns of a 1987-Style Crash. Here Are 2 Index ETFs to Buy Anyway.
news.Content:
Investor Michael Burry, who made a name for himself by successfully profiting from the housing market collapse, has been one of the biggest bears when it comes to investing in artificial intelligence (AI) stocks . He holds short positions in several large tech stocks, including chip giant Nvidia , memory maker Micron , AI operating platform Palantir , and Elon Musk's Tesla . In a bet against the entire AI infrastructure trade, he is also short the iShares Semiconductor ETF .

However, Burry took his negative views to a new level recently, calling for a potential stock market crash reminiscent of the one from 1987. Known as Black Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average, which was widely considered the benchmark index at the time, dropped a record 22.6% on Oct. 19, 1987. A combination of a long bull market, rising interest rates, international tension in the Persian Gulf (sounds familiar), the start of computerized trading, and hedging strategies that led to more selling are often cited for the crash.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

In a post on Substack, Burry wrote: "I continue to believe it is possible we are near a major top, and [possibly] a 1987-type fall, but the S&P 500 making new highs likely will bring new money into the market. ... Remember, the market going up on falling volatility forces vol-targeting funds to leverage up, and brings leverage from other momentum strategies into play."

Despite Burry's success with the housing collapse, a 1987-type crash seems unlikely to happen again. The introduction of circuit breakers, or mandatory trading halts during severe market drops, has helped stem panic selling and prevented a similar crash since. Meanwhile, hyperscalers aren't slowing down. Rapid payback periods on AI chips and networking hardware, coupled with locked-in customer agreements, continue to justify their aggressive infrastructure spending. At the same time, most AI stocks don't look expensive.

Against this backdrop, I think the best strategy for the average investor is to stick to dollar-cost average into index exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Consistently buying index ETFs through bull and bear markets has historically proved to be a great wealth-building strategy. One of the big reasons for this is that market-cap-weighted indexes basically deploy a survival of the fittest strategy that lets their winners run and losers fade, which has worked wonders over the long term. Even as AI infrastructure stocks were pulling back earlier this year, the S&P 500 index was still holding strong as new leaders, like Apple, emerged.

Story Continues

Let's look at two top index ETFs I'd continue to dollar-cost average into right now.

The Vanguard S&P 500 ETF

Few actively managed funds have been able to consistently beat the S&P 500 Index over the long term. As such, one of the smartest decisions someone can make is to invest alongside the index by dollar-cost averaging into a low-cost ETF such as the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (NYSEMKT: VOO).

The ETF consists of 500 of the largest U.S. stocks, giving investors an instant portfolio of top companies. The ETF has been a strong performer over the years, generating an average annual return of more than 15% during the past decade. If you were to invest in only one ETF, this is a top choice given its long-term performance and diversity.

The Invesco QQQ Trust

Growth and tech stocks have helped lead the market higher during much of the past two decades, which makes the Invesco QQQ Trust (NASDAQ: QQQ) another great ETF option to dollar-cost average into over the long term. The ETF, which tracks the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index, has consistently outperformed the S&P 500, topping it on a 12-month rolling basis 88% of the time during the past 10 years.

Although not as diversified as the S&P 500, the ETF has been a stellar performer, producing a 20.4% yearly return during the past decade. That's tough to beat, and with the technological innovation curve steepening, it could continue to outperform during the next decade.

news.Title: 外資大買756億！ 掃貨力積電、南亞科  「這族群」成大贏家
news.Content:
台股今（13）日延續反彈氣勢，加權指數上漲503點，收在46021點，重新站回46000點大關，漲幅1.11%，成交量同步放大至1.4兆。盤後三大法人合計買超907.56億元，其中外資及陸資狂買756.94億元，為史上第七大。

根據證交所公布三大法人買賣超資料，三大法人今日合計買進5068.37億元、賣出4160.81億元，合計買超907.56億元，買超金額突破900億元，顯示大型資金明顯回流台股。其中，外資及陸資今日大舉買超756.94億元，單日買超金額占三大法人合計買超超過8成，成為推升台股重新站回46000點的重要力量。

從外資買超個股來看，今日最受外資青睞的仍是主動式ETF。買超第一名為主動統一升級50（00403A），單日買超88137張；第二名為力積電（6770），買超57184張；第三名為主動凱基台灣（00407A），買超43829張。

值得注意的是，南亞科（2408）也被外資大手筆買進42740張，排名第4；大成鋼（2027）買超39932張，排名第5；主動統一台股增長（00981A）買超34427張；元大台灣50（0050）則買超31063張，位居第7。此外，兆豐金（2886）買超28691張、主動復華未來50（00991A）買超26466張、和碩（4938）買超24643張，也都進入外資買超前10名。

換言之，外資今日不僅大買個股，也明顯加碼主動式ETF及大型ETF，買盤呈現「ETF＋AI／記憶體」雙軸布局。其中力積電與南亞科等記憶體族群獲大舉加碼，成為市場關注焦點。

不過也有部分大型權值股仍遭調節。外資今日賣超第一名為鴻海（2317），單日賣超33363張；群創（3481）賣超27433張，中鋼（2002）賣超23669張，華航（2610）賣超20853張。其他遭外資調節的個股還包括臺企銀（2834）賣超19670張、亞泥（1102）賣超14247張、長榮航（2618）賣超13925張、正新（2105）賣超12844張、中石化（1314）賣超11723張，以及中纖（1718）賣超11627張。

外資今日大舉買進，也引發PTT股民熱議。針對力積電單日獲外資買超逾5.7萬張，有網友直呼「外資又爆買力積電快60000張，這波真要攻100？」也有人笑稱「力積買五萬跌成狗」，認為外資雖然大買，但股價表現未必同步反映。而南亞科則因外資前一日賣出、今日卻反手大買逾4.2萬張，引發網友討論，有人直呼「昨天丟南亞科，今天又買更多回來」，也有人認為外資的進出操作讓人難以捉摸。

至於今日大量買進主動式ETF，則成為PTT討論度最高的另一焦點。有網友表示，外資近期「一直囤主動賣個股」，似乎正在進行不同於過去的資金配置，也有人提醒「買了一堆主動好像都還沒開始倒」，對後續是否出現調節行情抱持觀望態度。

news.Title: Nvidia Stock Investors Just Got Good News From Wall Street (Hint: It's Time to Buy)
news.Content:
Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) shares are up 1,390% since the artificial intelligence boom began in January 2023, and Wall Street still thinks the stock is undervalued. Among 65 analysts, the median target price is $300 per share, implying 37% upside from the current share price of $218.

Nvidia shareholders recently got good news from Wall Street. Consensus earnings estimates have recently been revised higher, such that analysts now expect earnings to increase at 44% annually over the next three years. In March, the consensus estimate said earnings would increase at 33% annually over that period.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

What changed? Wall Street analysts once again underestimated how much money hyperscalers would spend on AI infrastructure. Here are the important details.

Nvidia dominates the market for AI infrastructure across GPUs, CPUs, and networking equipment

Nvidia is a full-stack accelerated computing company that develops graphics processing units (GPUs), central processing units (CPUs), and networking equipment, supported by a robust ecosystem of software tools. That approach lets the company optimize performance and power efficiency in ways most competitors cannot, which explains why Nvidia systems are the gold standard in artificial intelligence .

Most readers probably know that Nvidia GPUs account for a large percentage of data center accelerator sales (around 90%, according to HPC Wire ). But readers may be less familiar with the company's prowess in other categories. Nvidia recently became the largest networking company in the world, and it's on pace to become the largest CPU supplier by the end of this year.

Of course, there's been a lot of talk about application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), chips purpose-built for specific workloads like artificial intelligence. Some investors are worried that custom silicon will eventually displace Nvidia. But those fears are unwarranted. ASICs perform certain tasks more cheaply than Nvidia GPUs, but they are less flexible and lack the robust software development ecosystem that backs Nvidia chips.

"Nvidia isn't going anywhere anytime soon," according to Meera Pandit, global market strategist at J.P. Morgan. "Only Nvidia chips can handle any AI workload. Custom hardware is a safe and efficient bet for known workloads like inference, but there's an obsolescence risk as AI evolved."

Story Continues

Wall Street raised its hyperscaler capital expenditure (capex) spending forecast for 2026

Currently, 26% of hyperscaler capital expenditures (capex) go straight to Nvidia's bottom line, according to research from J.P. Morgan. That astonishing metric underscores the essential role Nvidia plays in the AI infrastructure market. And assuming the company maintains its pricing power and market share, earnings growth should more or less match capex growth going forward.

Here's the good news for shareholders: Wall Street has consistently underestimated how much hyperscalers will spend on AI infrastructure. "At the start of both 2024 and 2025, consensus estimates implied capex growth of roughly 20% for the year," writes Goldman Sachs . "In reality, it exceeded 50% in both years."

The same thing happened in 2026. Last June, the consensus estimate said capex spending among the five largest hyperscalers -- Alphabet , Amazon , Meta Platforms , Microsoft , and Oracle -- would total $361 billion this year. But Wall Street has since raised its forecast by over 100%, such that the consensus estimate now says their capex spending will total $733 billion in 2026.

Similarly, investors have reason to think Wall Street is making the same mistake with 2027. The consensus estimate currently says capex spending among the top five hyperscalers will grow 28% to $939 billion next year. But that would be a major slowdown compared to capex growth of 56% in 2024, 73% in 2025, and the projected capex growth of 90% in 2026.

Here's the big picture: Wall Street currently expects capex spending among the five largest hyperscalers to grow at 41% annually through 2028. Meanwhile, the consensus estimate says Nvidia's earnings will increase at 44% annually over the same period. It makes sense that those figures are roughly equivalent.

However, if analysts are underestimating hyperscaler capex, which is plausible given their track record, it stands to reason that they are also underestimating Nvidia's future earnings. And if earnings grow faster than expected over the next few years, the efficient market hypothesis predicts the stock price will rise. That makes Nvidia a worthwhile long-term investment.

news.Title: Prediction: Amazon Will Join Apple in the $4 Trillion Club Before 2030
news.Content:
It was just a couple of weeks ago when Apple 's market capitalization eclipsed $5 trillion. Weaker-than-expected Q4 revenue guidance tanked the share price. As of Aug. 10, the dominant consumer technology enterprise sports a valuation of $4.5 trillion.

Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) isn't far behind -- the e-commerce, cloud computing, and digital advertising behemoth carries a market cap of $3 trillion. I believe this business will have no problem joining Apple in the $4 trillion club before 2030. Here's why.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Growth continues even at a massive scale

Amazon reported $717 billion in net sales in 2025. Sell-side analysts have a consensus view that in 2028, that figure will grow to $1.1 trillion. This translates to a 15% compounded annual growth rate over the three-year time period. This is an enormous company. But the expansion story isn't finished.

The market cap will keep climbing as the business keeps succeeding in key areas. Amazon is a leader in online shopping, for instance. There is a long runway for continued growth. In the U.S., e-commerce has only captured 16.9% of all retail spending.

Amazon's marketplace possesses a phenomenal network effect. And the logistics system is robust. They provide shoppers with a top-notch value proposition.

The company's digital ad operation is thriving, with revenue surging 26% year over year in the second quarter (ended June 30). That's the fastest pace of growth in at least the last six quarters. Amazon's position as a popular shopping destination gives it prime digital real estate to monetize.

There's also Amazon Web Services, which saw sales jump 37% in the second quarter. Management is directing huge financial resources into expanding artificial intelligence capabilities. The segment's backlog is $496 billion.

Reasonable valuation controls downside risk

Beyond its durable growth potential, this Magnificent Seven stock is poised to be a winning investment thanks to its current valuation. Shares trade at a price-to-earnings ratio of 22.4. This multiple is close to being at a 10-year low.

If the valuation ratio were much higher, then it would introduce greater downside risk. But because it's not at an expensive level, the market doesn't have rosy expectations that would be difficult for the business to outperform.

Story Continues

It might be conservative to think that Amazon's market cap could reach or exceed $4 trillion by 2030, given that this figure has more than doubled over the past four years. However, if this feat does happen, it doesn't say anything about where Apple might be. At that point in the future, the Cupertino business might be worth more, leaving another milestone for Amazon to strive for.

news.Title: Missed Out on Amazon? This Stock Could Be Your Second Chance to Profit From Owning a Growing E-Commerce Conglomerate
news.Content:
Amazon is one of the market's most notable stocks. The company pioneered e-commerce and cloud computing, and its successes led to a 278,000% return for investors over its 29-year trading history.

Fortunately, other companies have followed its lead in e-commerce in other regions of the world, and they have become conglomerates by succeeding in other industries.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Sea Limited (NYSE: SE) has become this kind of company in Southeast Asia. Given its smaller size and its focus on a fast-growing, developing region, this company could offer investors a second chance at Amazon-like growth. Here's how.

The market positioning of Sea Limited

Unlike Amazon, Sea began its history as a gaming company called Garena. However, founder and CEO Forrest Li saw an opportunity for e-commerce in Southeast Asia and formed Shopee, now Southeast Asia's largest e-commerce company. While it didn't exactly follow Amazon's growth strategy, Shopee invested in logistics and sold ads on its site, much like its North American counterpart.

Moreover, Shopee had an issue that Amazon did not: shoppers who deal primarily in cash. Thus, instead of going into cloud computing, Sea formed fintech company Monee to serve these customers and offer digital financial services.

At a $2.9 trillion market cap, Amazon is nearly 40 times the size of Sea Limited, with a market cap of around $75 billion. That difference gives investors an idea of Sea's possible growth.

Additionally, Sea Limited's seven Southeast Asian markets have a population of around 645 million, far above the U.S.'s 349 million. Although it operates primarily in developing countries with lower incomes than the U.S., Shopee markets such as Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines have reported 5% to 7% yearly economic growth, well above the U.S. at around 2%.
