news.Title: Amazon (AMZN) Is Powering OpenAI’s Cyber Models, So Why Is The Stock So Cheap?
news.Content:
Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ) just gave security teams a fresh reason to watch its cloud business. On August 11, two specialized cybersecurity models from OpenAI, Daybreak Red and Daybreak Blue, went live on Amazon Bedrock for eligible customers, and AWS's own security teams are already using them to find and fix vulnerabilities faster. It's the latest step in a partnership that keeps expanding, and it lands just as investors are debating whether Amazon's spending spree will pay off.

Bull Case: AWS Is Quietly Becoming An AI Machine

The Daybreak launch caps months of buildout. Earlier on April 28, Amazon and OpenAI announced a major expansion of their partnership, bringing OpenAI models, the Codex coding agent, and Bedrock Managed Agents to AWS in limited preview, wrapped in the enterprise controls big customers already use, including IAM access management, AWS PrivateLink, and CloudTrail logging. By July 9, GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna reached general availability on Bedrock, with Terra priced at half the cost of GPT-5.5 and a 90% discount on cached inputs. Codex already has more than 4 million weekly users, and now it runs inside the AWS environments those customers already operate at scale.

The financial results back up the momentum. AWS revenue grew 37% year-over-year last quarter, the fifth straight quarter of acceleration and the fastest pace in 18 quarters, even though the business has doubled in size over that stretch. Amazon's AI services and its custom chip lineup, Trainium, Inferentia, and Graviton, each crossed a $25 billion annualized run rate and are both growing at triple-digit rates. Behind that sits $496 billion in contracted revenue, including deals to supply OpenAI with 2 gigawatts of Trainium capacity and Anthropic with up to 5 gigawatts of Trainium and Graviton over a 10-year agreement. Retail is contributing too, with advertising revenue up 26% year over year and online store sales up 15%.

Bear Case: Building That Much Infrastructure Isn't Free

Amazon now plans to spend $220 billion on capex this year, up from a $200 billion estimate just one quarter earlier and well above the $132 billion it spent in 2025. Part of that increase traces to memory chip prices, which have spiked amid a shortage. The spending has pushed free cash flow to negative $7.6 billion over the trailing 12 months, a sharp reversal from the positive $18.2 billion generated a year earlier, and long-term debt has climbed 96% to nearly $129 billion.

That kind of spending increase leaves less room for error if it doesn't convert into earnings growth. The bigger risk isn't that Amazon or its AI partners can't pay their bills; it's that hyperscalers collectively build more data center capacity than the market needs, which would pressure pricing industry-wide. Amazon does have some flexibility here, since server orders typically carry a lead time of just a few months and a payback period under three years. Jeff Bezos also sold more than $4 billion worth of shares, a transaction reportedly planned eight months, though the timing still rattled some investors.

Story Continues

Wall Street's Mixed Signals

Hedge fund ownership dropped from 381 funds to 353 in the most recent quarter, a pullback suggesting some institutional holders trimmed their positions. Short interest, by contrast, sits at just 1% of the float, showing little organized skepticism toward the stock. As of August 12, Amazon trades at 23.70 times forward earnings, a multiple that assumes real profit growth ahead. Put those signals together, and the picture is mixed: funds pulling back even as short sellers stay away and the market keeps paying a premium.

Where This Leaves Amazon Investors

Amazon's cloud business is accelerating at a pace it hasn't shown in years, and the OpenAI partnership adds another lever as enterprises adopt AI tools. That growth is coming at a cost, with capital spending pushing free cash flow sharply negative and debt climbing quickly. The newer AI and chip segments becoming real revenue contributors is the clearest sign the investment is starting to pay off.

While we acknowledge the potential of AMZN as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: Airbnb vs. PepsiCo: Which Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
news.Content:
Should you prioritize the high-growth potential of the digital travel economy or the steady dividends of a global snack titan? Investors choosing between Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) and PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) are weighing two very different paths to wealth.

Airbnb operates a massive online marketplace for stays and local experiences, while PepsiCo produces iconic food and beverage brands found in almost every pantry. Comparing these two giants helps you decide if you prefer a lean, tech-driven platform or a diversified consumer manufacturing powerhouse with a long history of dividends.

The case for Airbnb

Airbnb operates as a leader among consumer discretionary stocks by providing a global marketplace for stays and local experiences. The company connects over five million hosts with guests while utilizing infrastructure from Amazon and Alphabet to run its platform. It also manages complex payment integrations to support transactions in approximately 50 different currencies worldwide.

In FY 2025, revenue reached nearly $12.2 billion, which was an increase of approximately 10.3% compared to the previous year. The company generated a net income of roughly $2.5 billion for the period. This resulted in a net margin of close to 20.5%, reflecting the platform's ability to turn a significant portion of its sales into profit.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was approximately 0.3x. This ratio compares total debt, including short-term and long-term obligations, to shareholder equity, suggesting the company uses relatively little debt to fund its operations. Free cash flow was approximately $4.6 billion, though note that stock-based compensation represented roughly 34.3% of operating cash flow, which inflates reported cash generation since SBC is a non-cash expense added back in the cash flow statement.

The case for PepsiCo

PepsiCo is a global giant in the beverage and snack markets with brands like Lay's and Gatorade. Its customer base spans wholesale distributors, grocery stores, and massive retailers like Walmart . Notably, Walmart represents a major customer concentration, accounting for nearly 14% of total revenue in 2025, and customer concentration like this adds a layer of risk to the business.

In FY 2025, revenue reached nearly $93.9 billion, representing a growth of roughly 2.3% over the prior year. The company reported a net income of approximately $8.2 billion. This led to a net margin of nearly 8.8%, reflecting the higher costs associated with manufacturing and distributing physical goods compared to digital platforms.

Story Continues

As of the December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was approximately 2.4x, indicating the company carries more debt than the value of its shareholder equity. The current ratio was close to 0.9x, indicating that its short-term liabilities slightly exceed its most liquid assets. Free cash flow reached nearly $7.7 billion for the fiscal year, providing significant capital for dividends and business reinvestment.

Risk profile comparison

Airbnb faces significant regulatory hurdles as various cities implement strict rules or outright bans on short-term rentals. The company is also involved in a major tax dispute with the IRS involving a $1.3 billion notice regarding the valuation of international intellectual property. Furthermore, the business relies heavily on third-party infrastructure from Amazon and Alphabet , which could lead to service disruptions if those partnerships face technical or contractual issues.

PepsiCo must navigate increasing government taxes on sugar-sweetened drinks and evolving environmental rules for plastic packaging. It faces intense competition from global rivals like The Coca-Cola Company , as well as cheaper private-label brands that pressure its pricing power. Additionally, the company is managing various legal challenges, including antitrust litigation and lawsuits related to the health profile of its snack products in the eyes of consumers and massive retailers like Walmart.

Valuation comparison

PepsiCo appears significantly cheaper based on its earnings multiples, while Airbnb commands a higher premium for its growth potential. The Forward P/E measures price against future earnings estimates, while the P/S ratio compares market value to total revenue. Valuation metrics indicate that investors are paying more for each dollar of sales at Airbnb.

Which stock would I buy in 2026?

I'd go with Airbnb. That said, PepsiCo is a household name with a dividend history that income-focused investors have counted on for decades, and that stability has value. International demand for its snacks and beverages is holding up well, and the company reaffirmed its full-year guidance in its most recent quarter.

But PepsiCo is dealing with a soft patch that is hard to overlook. North American consumers are pulling back on discretionary snack spending as gas prices and inflation squeeze household budgets, and the company signaled that full-year earnings may come in toward the lower end of its guidance range. For a stock that investors typically buy for steady, predictable returns, that cautious tone is not encouraging.

Airbnb, by contrast, is a company in good shape. Revenue grew at a healthy pace in the most recent quarter, free cash flow is substantial, and global travel demand is holding up well. The platform has a loyal, growing user base and a business model that keeps getting more efficient as it scales.

If you're a long-term investor looking for growth, Airbnb is the more exciting place to put your money right now.

news.Title: 輝達攜金融巨頭擴AI融資引疑慮 分析師：投資回報成關鍵
news.Content:
輝達攜手六大金融機構，目標引入逾5000億美元第三方資金投入 AI 基礎設施。分析師認為，融資平台有助降低業者取得AI基建資金的門檻，至於是否形成泡沫，關鍵仍在AI需求能否持續，以及龐大投資能否轉化為實際收益。若觀察美股第二季財報，已陸續將投資轉化為業績與收益，AI產業前景仍正向。

輝達宣布攜手阿波羅、貝萊德、黑石等六大金融機構，成立獨立運算融資平台，目標引入逾5000億美元第三方資金投入AI基礎設施。透過新的融資模式，輝達目標透過將AI基礎設施轉化為可投資資產，擴大AI工廠建置，並帶動硬體銷售及軟體生態系成長。

輝達執行長黃仁勳透過新聞稿指出，輝達正從晶片供應商，進一步協助打造具生產力、可投資的「AI工廠」基礎設施。透過與全球主要長期資本供應商合作，將協助客戶大規模取得運算資源、建置DSX AI工廠，為各產業及國家的AI發展提供運算能力。

分析師蔡明翰表示，建立融資平台延續輝達的營運策略。隨著市場看好AI發展前景，各方積極擴大投資，但不同業者的資金與融資能力存在明顯差距，對於融資成本較高的企業，可望透過輝達引入金融機構資金，降低AI基礎設施的融資門檻與資金成本。他說：『(原音)大型的他不用去考量，四大雲端業者自己有錢，而且以他們的地位可以拿到非常低成本的資金。要籌這些大資金讓人家借，主要就是一些借錢不是這麼容易，或是相對成本比較高的。由他幫忙出面相對來講比較容易，成本相對比較低。』

他認為，市場對這類融資模式仍有疑慮，擔心形成「AI永動機」，透過提供給客戶資金，再用於採購AI設備，若槓桿過高，可能增加未來泡沫化風險。不過，關鍵仍在於「AI需求能否穩健成長」，以及相關投資是否能轉化為「實際收益」。

蔡明翰進一步分析，從美股第二季財報來看，許多企業的AI投資已逐步轉化為營收與獲利，顯示AI發展並非僅停留在題材炒作。若企業投入的資本能持續創造回報，相關投資仍具支撐，當企業願意擴大投入，也反映對未來AI業務成長抱持正面看法。

他認為，只要AI需求持續存在，且資金能轉化為收益，就不必過度悲觀看待AI資本支出擴張。過去市場多次因擔憂AI資本支出過高而出現短線修正，但隨後基本面持續成長，反而成為較佳的投資布局時點。(編輯：鍾錦隆)

news.Title: Nvidia's $500 Billion Financing Plan Is 20 Times What the Telecom Bubble Ran On
news.Content: Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) signed memorandums of understanding Monday with six of Wall Street's largest investment firms to establish independent financing platforms -- vehicles meant to mobilize more than $500 billion of third-party capital for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure. The six are Apollo Global Management , BlackRock , Blackstone , Brookfield Asset Management , Goldman Sachs , and KKR . The idea is to let lenders treat computing hardware the way they treat buildings or toll roads (an asset that produces revenue and can therefore ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Nvidia is establishing independent financing platforms to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure.
• This initiative allows lenders to treat computing hardware as an asset class that can secure debt, similar to buildings or toll roads.
• The scale of Nvidia's financing target is approximately 20 times that of the telecom bubble's vendor lending.
• Unlike the telecom bubble where suppliers bore the loan risk, Nvidia's platforms are independent, but the ultimate loss absorption mechanism remains unclear.
• Nvidia's revenue and net income have shown strong growth, with Q1 fiscal 2027 revenue up 85% year-over-year.
news.Keywords: AI infrastructure, third-party financing, asset-backed lending, telecom bubble precedent, capital mobilization

news.Title: 記憶體看南亞科、載板挑景碩！股海名家開出17檔「台股災後重建清單」：年底看5萬點先上車
news.Content:
台股在歷經震撼大跌過後，指數出現反彈契機，投資贏家們在此分享，如何在汰弱換強、掌握獲利勝算的同時，又能避開風險誤區的操作策略。

台股經歷「去槓桿」大幅修正之後逐漸回魂，雖然第三季預料仍以整理格局居多，但部分投資贏家已開始盤點此際值得先行鎖定、伺機布局的私房標的。

「一個月的大跌（7月）、兩個月整理（8至9月）、三個月的多頭。」有產業隊長之稱的張捷，以此定調後續盤勢。他認為，在市場籌碼趨於沉澱後，9月底中秋節後有機會轉折向上，即使屆時出現美國聯準會升息干擾，短線不排除再次探底，但預料仍是大盤重啟多頭的前奏。籌碼贏家郭勝亦認為，第三季台股指數預料約在3萬8千點至4萬6千點箱型整理，但第四季後大盤有望重拾氣勢，年底前挑戰5萬點的看法不變。

記憶體看南亞科 載板挑景碩

認定台股仍有好戲，在大盤進入「災後重建」階段，兩人也已各自擬妥布局清單，「第三季，就是汰弱換強的好機會。」張捷強調，現階段，他首先是從ASIC與谷歌TPU概念股當中尋找機會，包括聯發科 （2454）、創意 （3443）等領頭羊，而鴻勁 （7769）、雍智科技（6683）為其後端測試供應商，料將同步受惠；近來鴻勁股價已相對抗跌，雍智在深度修正後也浮現搶短機會。

不過，半導體設備供應鏈家登（3680）以及記憶體廠南亞科（2408），更是他的布局首選。其中，南亞科七月營收優於市場預期，年增逾七倍，第三季營收可望季增約60％，高於先前預估的季增25％到30％，且南亞科在DDR4議價能力強，並有機會列入MSCI成分股，後市看好。張捷認為，雖然近期股價震盪，但屬短線清洗浮額的籌碼調整所致，公司基本面依舊強勁，凱基投顧現階段給予該股的目標價為720元。

至於家登，張捷主要看好其晶圓傳送盒與EUV光罩盒客戶涵蓋四大領域：台積電先進製程、英特爾重啟擴產專案、聯電等成熟製程大廠，最後則是中國的半導體在地化需求。就財務數字看，毛利率近5成，今、明兩年EPS預估為17元與23元，已有法人報告目標價上看5百元以上，值得留意。

此外，載板產業進入超級循環，隨著GPU與CPU升級、HBM堆疊普及，載板需求在面積與用量上暴增，但受限於T-Glass等關鍵材料與製程難度，供給擴張緩慢，形成結構性供需缺口。在此領域中，ABF的欣興（3037）、景碩（3189）、南電（8046）、臻鼎-KY（4958）都已被張捷列為口袋名單，其中景碩更是他在ABF產業中的首選。

至於新藥股仁新（6696），張捷表示，其黃斑部病變用藥已完成三期臨床試驗，市場需求龐大且尚無有效藥物，股價長線有千元的實力，尤其轉投資的Belite公司於那斯達克掛牌且表現優異，法人推估，若依仁新持有 Belite的股權價值回推，Belite 市值約60億美元，仁新持股48.4％，市值871.2億新台幣，除以仁新8.29億元的股本，合理股價為1050元，值得逢低布局。

郭勝同樣聚焦AI題材，其中，他已鎖定逢低買進宏致（3605）、先進光（3362）、凌嘉科（3644）、匯鑽科（8431）以及緯創（3231）。

先進光、大立光 矽光子互補

其中，宏致受惠於高速連接線產品出貨暢旺，帶動伺服器相關營收比重維持高檔，且在ASIC及GPU各平台產品滲透率擴增，AWS和輝達GB系列的高速連接器單價均較傳統高出近20％，機櫃內的高速傳輸線單價也較傳統產品大幅提升。整體而言，宏致的AI產品營收占比今年預估約20％，明年估計可達

news.Title: 大盤「彎弓射箭」瞄準4萬6！多空對決3劇本曝光　專家警告：黑天鵝來了恐殺到這裡
news.Content:
台股昨（11日）站上45,000點大關，今日開盤續彈，資深分析師李永年指出，昨日三大法人同步買超，顯示力道強勁，市場風向已從「資金行情」轉入「景氣行情」，面對這種「利多即漲」的現象，選股應該回歸基本面。觀察盤面結構，原本強勢的矽光子、記憶體族群，與被動元件、PCB良性輪動支撐大盤。不過，李永年提醒，未來大盤有3劇本，除了V型反轉、頭肩底型態之外，也要提防黑天鵝重大利空，一旦大盤回測40,000點，指數可能下探34,000點。

三大法人齊加碼 多頭信心回穩

李永年表示，近期美股多空因素交織，導致走勢震盪，加上伊朗局勢及荷姆茲海峽混沌未明，美國戰備儲油降至1983年以來的新低，油價走高帶動美債殖利率與美金攀升，都對全球股市形成短期壓抑。

不過，台股持續漲勢，昨日站上45,000大關，三大法人也集體站在買方，外資買超達223億元，顯示多頭信心初步回溫，今日不畏美股跌多漲少的衝擊，繼續開出高盤，盤中一度大漲300多點。

健鼎、台達電公布營收 利多即漲

李永年指出，市場的投資邏輯已發生根本性轉變，由「資金行情」進入「景氣行情」，從個股表現就可以得知，例如電源管理龍頭台達電(2308)、PCB大廠健鼎(3044)公布營收後，股價隨即強勢漲停，這種「利多即漲」就是反映多頭思維，此時選股邏輯應回歸基本面，鎖定財報亮眼的標的。

至於盤面結構方面，原本強勢的矽光子、記憶體族群，近期因獲利了結出現回檔，資金轉進被動元件、PCB及大型權值股，良性的輪動支撐大盤穩步攻堅。

未來走勢3劇本 指數點位曝光

李永年指出，大盤未來有3種可能走勢，如果短線再拉出長紅，將形成「彎弓射箭」，直接挑戰46,000至46,500點，甚至續創新高；但如果量能持續不到1兆元，走頭肩底型態，指數會在42,000點至43,000點整理，構築右肩再往上突破套牢區。

最壞的劇本是不慎出現「黑天鵝打擊」，一旦重大利空導致回測40,000點，恐引發信心崩潰，指數可能進一步下探至34,000點附近。

量增才能走得遠 突破需台積電回神

展望後市，李永年認為，短線仍有高點可期，但「量增方能致遠」，要有效突破46,000點以上的巨大套牢量，成交量要緩步增至1.1兆至1.2兆元左右。目前還要觀察的是，當沖已顯著減少，但站穩45,000點大關後，大咖資金是否進場才是關鍵中的關鍵。

另一方面，本土投顧分析，大盤成交量持續低於兆元，盤面漲停題材的強勢股也愈來愈少，甚至不少個股財報不如預期出現重挫，顯示大盤持續在小區間震盪，觀望美國本周將公布的通膨數據。投顧提到，目前趨勢向上還沒有遭到破壞，但要突破成功，需要權王台積電(2330)真回神，投資人要逢高調節走空股，對於題材強勢股，採取紀律操作。

news.Title: 美股觀望CPI　台股權值股發威　開盤續漲逾300點拚站穩45K
news.Content:
【緯來新聞網】美伊和平協議進展有限，加上市場靜待美國通膨數據，美股昨夜震盪偏弱，僅費半指數受惠記憶體股走強逆勢上漲0.87％；台股ADR則全面收高，台積電（2330）ADR上漲0.86％，帶動台指期夜盤上漲194點、收45,279點。台股12日開高，隨後在台積電開高至2,405元，攜手鴻海（2317）、華邦電（2344）、南亞科（2408）及廣達（2382）等電子要角走強助攻下，漲點一度擴大至近380點，指數直逼45,500點大關。

台股12日開高，隨後在台積電開高至2,405元（圖／證交所）

台積電最新動作備受矚目，董事會通過2026年第2季每股現金股利7元，並核准逾9500億元資本預算，聚焦先進製程及封裝產能擴充。此外，台積電與索尼半導體解決方案公司簽署最終合作協議，將在日本熊本合資設立Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation，計畫2029年量產智慧手機影像感測器。索尼與台積電分別投資約4650億及2820億日圓。

國內其他重量級企業也展現強勁成長動能。鴻海旗下工業富聯上半年營收達人民幣5578.6億元，年增54.6％，淨利更飆升96％創同期新高。PCB廠臻鼎-KY持續擴大伺服器及光模組業務，業績倍增，並鎖定2027年成為全球最大高階光模組供應商目標。封測廠矽品精密啟動耗資千億元的斗六新廠建設，計劃導入CoWoS先進封裝技術。仁寶則積極擴展AI伺服器產能，美國德州及越南新廠陸續投產，力拼AI市場布局。

美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）將於台灣時間週三晚間揭曉，市場關注這份數據將如何影響聯準會（Fed）9月利率決策。市場預期7月CPI年增率約3.4％、月增0.1％，核心CPI年增2.5％、月增0.2％。芝加哥商品交易所FedWatch工具顯示，Fed下月升息機率約50％，反映市場對下一步政策走向尚無共識。雖然Fed偏重核心個人消費支出物價指數（Core PCE），但CPI因較早公布，仍影響短期市場預期。

法人指出，台股短線雖維持震盪反彈格局，但量能未能同步有效放大，多頭若要再戰前高，仍需成交量補足、買盤進一步回籠。隨著營收與季報公布進入尾聲，市場短期缺乏明確基本面利多接棒，指數波動料將加劇。展望後市，季線將成為多方重要防線，若能守穩，有利維持震盪偏多格局。

news.Title: 美股光通訊巨頭報喜！光聖華星光亮燈 分析師曝操作關鍵
news.Content:
美股光通訊巨頭 Lumentum（LITE.US）昨日繳出優於預期的財報表現，因此大漲 7%，今日台股光通訊概念股也開出紅花，華星光（4979）率先亮燈，族群股王聯亞（3081）、上詮（3163）等個股也同步漲逾半根。分析師認為光通訊雖然看起來本益比偏高，但目前來說仍可以沿著五日線介入短線操作，但應做好若跌破短期均線就要出場的準備。

Lumentum 11日美股盤後公布會計年度第四季度財報：營收年增109.3%；經調整的每股盈餘為3.23美元，遠高於去年同期的0.88美元，整體財報表現優於預期，不僅盤中已有7%漲幅，盤後更續漲2%，表現亮眼。

在美股巨頭領漲下，台股包含光聖、華星光漲停，波若威、聯亞、光環、穩懋等個股全數拉出半根以上的漲幅，族群開出一片紅花。

啟發投顧分析師白易弘就指出，Lumentum的財報表現佳對光通訊族群是利多，雖然整體本益比偏高，不過近期一路都是沿著5日均線上漲，可以待股價回測5日均線，適度追價以短線方式操作，若跌破短期均線則迅速停利離場。

news.Title: 記憶體掌兵符！力積電重返70元大關躍居成交量王 南亞科衝上511元創新高
news.Content:
記憶體族群今（12）日再度強勢發動，力積電（6770）開盤後買盤大舉湧入，早盤一度急拉8%，股價重返70元大關，開盤半小時，成交量快速突破13萬張，躍居台股成交量王。南亞科（2408）一度衝上511元，刷新歷史新高。華邦電（2344）、群聯（8299）等記憶體股也同步走揚。

截至上午9時30分，族群指標股南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）雙雙漲逾2%，分別報在499.5元、184.5元；南亞科早盤一度衝上511元，不但重返500元大關，更創下歷史新高價。另外，力積電一度急拉8%至73元，成交量高達13.6萬張，高局台股成交量之冠。

另外，群聯（8299）漲5%，報2,200元。旺宏（2337）、晶豪科（3006）也漲約3%。模組廠部分，宜鼎（5289）以及宇瞻（8271）同樣表現強勢，漲幅逾4%。

回顧近期記憶體走勢，先前市場受到花旗證券分析師看空記憶體價格的報告壓抑，花旗證券分析師Atif Malik報告指出，雖維持美光科技「買進」評等，卻將目標價從 1400 美元大砍至 1150 美元。報告說明，經與記憶體供應鏈上下游業者交叉查證後研判，DRAM 與 NAND 價格漲勢將在未來四季逐步收斂，並可能於明年 5 月見頂。

花旗進一步認為，這波記憶體價格漲勢降溫，主要與中國記憶體廠長鑫科技與長江存儲持續擴產有關，供給增加可能對市場價格行程壓力。

不過，摩根大通策略師 Jay Kwon本周釋出相對樂觀看法，他指出，在價格與出貨量同步推升下，記憶體潛在市場規模（TAM）將持續擴大，供需短缺未來兩年仍將延續。此外，記憶體需求正從 GPU 擴散至 CPU，但這項趨勢可能仍遭投資人低估，意味著未來記憶體需求預估仍存在進一步上修空間。

王詩婷／財經特派記者，主跑勞動部、半導體、生技等

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】台股續揚漲逾370點 分析師萬相和：追價意願有限
news.Content:
美股四大指數跌多漲少，台股今（12）日加權指數開盤上漲54.98點、以45175.7點開出，隨後在電子、金融及傳產股齊力助攻下，漲幅迅速擴大至逾370點，指數一度攻上45,498.05點，穩守4萬5千點大關。啟發投顧分析師萬相和表示，由於市場正等待美國今晚公布7月消費者物價指數（CPI）數據，追價買盤意願有限，預期今日大盤漲點落在300點至500點。

今日值班分析師：啟發投顧分析師萬相和

萬相和表示，儘管美股主要指數收黑，但AI雲端服務商CoreWeave第二季營收翻倍，帶動AI產業氣氛回溫，加上台積電股價維持穩健，成為支撐台股今日走高的主要力量。

萬相和指出，台積電近期大致在2350元至2400元區間整理，即使前幾日台股回檔，股價跌幅仍相對有限，說明下檔具有支撐。不過，市場正等待美國7月消費者物價指數（CPI）公布，觀望氣氛仍濃，加上台股上方較大壓力落在45,900點附近，台積電、鴻海等大型權值股今日僅小幅上漲，預期今日指數漲點可能落在300點至500點之間，若無重大消息干擾，尾盤翻黑機率不高。

盤面焦點集中在記憶體族群，受美股相關個股逆勢走強激勵，南亞科早盤突破500元、再創歷史新高，華邦電大漲逾5%，旺宏也上揚超過3%；矽晶圓、低軌衛星、矽智財及AI概念股同步獲得資金青睞。

另外，萬相和指出，櫃買指數盤中逼近400點，表現優於集中市場，若能成功站上整數關卡，中小型題材股有機會接棒大型權值股，成為盤面多方主力。

至於AI伺服器組裝廠近期陸續召開法說會，萬相和認為，鴻海近期經過整理後逐步墊高，走勢相對強勢；緯創先前已創新高，仍是大型代工廠中表現較突出的個股，廣達上方則面臨較多壓力。隨著相關業者將陸續召開法說會，AI伺服器展望仍可關注，但不宜提前追高押寶。受CPI公布前觀望氣氛影響，預估今日成交量約落在8000億元至9000億元。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 台股「風電國家隊」爆下市危機！獨董跑光又欠一屁股債
news.Content:
上市公司暴雷，風電鑄件大廠永冠-KY財報難產，三席獨立董事全數辭任，且未能在期限內完成補選，證交所昨（11日）公告，永冠-KY自13日起併案列為變更交易辦法，全額交割維持停止買賣狀態，目前4.3萬名股東欲哭無淚。

股東欲哭無淚 爆下市危機

永冠-KY財務狀況持續惡化，且公司治理爆發重大危機，無法繳交2025年及2026年第一季財務報告，同時無法如期償還境內第四次無擔保轉換公司債，也未能在期限內償還債務或與債權人完成協商。

早在4月7日起，其上市股票與無擔保轉換公司債就已遭到停止買賣。如今，狀況持續惡化，永冠-KY的三席獨立董事均已辭任，且未能於規定內完成補選，如果狀況遲遲無法改善，最快可能在11月18日下市。

曾是風電國家隊成員 重大營運危機

永冠-KY在4月1日是暫停交易前的最後交易日，當天股價收在5.54元。截至上周，永冠-KY總股東人數為43,147人，持有超過千張的大股東佔比達21%，其次是持有1至5張的小股東，比例為次高的14.37%，每位股東平均持有3.55張。

永冠-KY過去是全球金屬鑄件製造大廠，專注在再生能源、產業機械及工具機等領域，過去曾被視為風電國家隊成員，具備一條龍式大型客製化鑄造能力，股價一度衝上百元。

然而，近年出現嚴重經營問題，年初也傳出無法償還銀行借款，短期借款總規模超過10億元，將於今年內陸續到期，短期不見任何好轉跡象，下市危機拉警報。

news.Title: 台積電配息7元！ 開放外資「領美元股息」將與Sony合資新公司
news.Content:
晶圓代工龍頭台積電11日召開董事會，拍板2026年第2季財務報表及多項重大決議。台積電第2季合併營收達新台幣1兆2703.8億元，稅後純益7065.6億元，每股純益（EPS）27.25元，董事會並核准每股配發7元現金股利，預計2027年1月7日發放。

台積電表示，本次除息交易日訂於2026年12月10日，配息基準日為12月16日，配合金管會法規修訂，外資股東自本次股利分派起，可選擇以美元收取現金股利，美國存託憑證（ADR）除息日及配息基準日同樣為12月10日。

資本支出方面，董事會核准約294億4250萬美元資本預算，主要用於先進製程、先進封裝、成熟及特殊製程產能，以及廠房與廠務設施建置，持續因應AI、高效能運算等長期需求。

此外，台積電也拍板與索尼半導體解決方案公司（Sony Semiconductor Solutions）合資成立新公司，雙方將在日本熊本布局下一世代影像感測器的研發與製造。依規劃，Sony預計投入約4650億日圓，台積電則投資約2820億日圓，合資公司預計2029年開始量產，瞄準智慧型手機等市場。

在先進封裝方面，台積電表示，今年已成功量產5.5倍光罩尺寸的CoWoS封裝，良率穩定維持98%以上，預計2029年進一步推進至14倍光罩尺寸以上，持續強化AI晶片封裝能力。

（封面圖／台積電提供）

news.Title: 「瑤池金母」為何狠心砍光南亞科？專家曝背後隱情：大家都猜錯了
news.Content:
記憶體大廠南亞科昨（11日）下跌2.5%，收在489元，引發市場疑慮是否與被股民封為「瑤池金母」的明星經理人陳釧瑤操盤主動統一台股增長「00981A」清空持股有關。對此專家表示，00981A出清南亞科是因經理人高檔獲利了結以維持績效，加上連動度高的美光遭外資下修目標價，並非南亞科基本面轉壞，投資人無須過度擔憂。

00981A於7月22日才進場買進南亞科，當時股價約落在430至440元區間；才持股半個多月時間，在8月10日趁股價強勢攻上漲停之際，一口氣拋售939張持股，套現約4.71億元，僅保留1張。

從最新持股變化來看，00981A在南亞科獲利落袋後迅速調整資產配置，將資金轉進其他標的，包含加碼日月光約 13.2 億元、台達電約6.6億元，並進場布局欣銓與富世達，合計買超金額達21.4億元。

永誠國際投顧分析師李蜀芳指出，00981A出清南亞科並非看壞基本面，而是經理人為維持基金績效或應對贖回，選擇在股價逼近前波高點時獲利了結。此外，花旗銀行近期調降美光目標價，由於南亞科與美光在台股具備高度連動與指標意義，因而同步面臨短線壓抑。

花旗最新發布報告指出，預估DRAM與NAND快閃記憶體價格，未來四個季度將逐季趨緩，並於2027年第2季攀頂後，於同年下半年可能面臨季減3%與5%的幅度。考量記憶體報價成長動能漸失，花旗將美光目標價自1400美元調降至1150美元，但仍給予「買進」評等。

news.Title: 台股狂衝證交稅亮眼　前7月年增1.9倍刷新高
news.Content:
股市起伏牽動國家稅收。財政部今(11)日發布稅收統計，7月全國賦稅收入2,891億元，年降67％，主因去(2025)年所得稅結算申報及繳納期限延長，稅款遞延至7月，以致基期偏高；累計1至7月稅收2兆8,767億元，年增25％。7月台股巨幅回檔，成交量萎縮，但證交稅收651億元，仍較去年同期大增1.7倍；總計前7月證交稅收3,987億元，創史上同期新高。

7月實徵淨額與去年同月比較，以營所稅減少3,464億元、綜所稅縮減3,123億元最多，證交稅則增加412億之多。累計前7月稅收以證交稅飆升2,593億元、營所稅上揚1,533億元、營業稅成長838億元最多，稅收達成率72.9％。

7月增幅最大的莫過於證交稅收，7月上市櫃股票平均每日成交值為1兆1,532億元，前7月每日成交值為1兆1,706億元，分別較去年同期暴增1.8倍及1.9倍。7月單月證交稅收651億元，年飆1.7倍，連續12個月正成長，但與6月相比下滑23.3％。累計1至7月證交稅收3,987億元，年增2,593億元，雙雙刷新高，增幅1.9倍，則是1998年以來同期最高。

營所稅7月實徵86億元，年墜97.6％，主因去年為了因應美國對等關稅衝擊，所得稅申報及繳納期限延長，稅款延至7月入帳，基期較高所致。統計前7月營所稅實徵淨額為7,889億，年升1,533億元，升幅24.1％。綜所稅實徵191億元，年降94.2％，同樣因為去年結算申報延期至7月，基期較高。累計1至7月綜所稅實徵淨額為6,899億元，年增695億元，成長11.2％。

營業稅7月實徵淨額為1,376億元，年增251億元，增加22.3％，累計1至7月實徵4,872億元，年揚838億，上升20.8％，因內需增加，資通與視聽產品、電子零組件等進口代徵稅額提高；但出口暢旺，適用外銷零稅率申請退稅也升高，抵銷部分增幅。

7月貨物稅實徵116億元，小升4％，主要是進口車稅額增加、汽柴油貨物稅減幅擴大，油氣類稅額減少互抵所致。累計1至7月，貨物稅實徵淨額694億元，衰退18.1％，與汽柴油降稅、新購汽機車及電動車減免徵退稅有關。

財政部指出，1至7月營所稅、綜所稅、營業稅、證交稅、期交稅、關稅、房屋稅、遺產稅、娛樂稅、印花稅均攀上歷年同期高點。至於前7月稅收已超過今(2026)年全年預算目標的稅目，包含有證交稅、期交稅及房屋稅。

台股近幾周經歷重大的慘烈回檔，近日雖終於回彈，但仍有不少受重傷的投資人未能恢復元氣。（資料照，中央社）

台股近幾周經歷重大的慘烈回檔，雖近日終於開始強勢反攻，看似最底部已經過去，但仍有不少受重傷的投資人未能恢復元氣，也對空頭可能尚未結束抱持警戒。對此，財經專家 阮慕驊 分析，這波股災其實台美股有個「高度共通點」，也證明許多投資人受的傷，遠比大盤重挫幅度還要更深。

阮慕驊在節目《聽，阮大哥的！》指出，這一波的底部應是暫時確立了，但問題是高點還能不能繼續突破？他對此進行研究，從美股費半指數與台股上市櫃來分析，這一波修正的結構到底是什麼、低點是否還可信，以及未來可能的回檔空間。

​美股重挫情況如何？費半1個月殺掉28%​​​

阮慕驊提到，美股方面，費城半導體指數僅1個月的時間就殺掉28.7%，下殺幅度相當大，從6月22日的高點14655、跌到7月29日的低點10445，「可以看到跟台股櫃買、加權指數幾乎是同步的。」

阮慕驊指出，台股上市櫃指數也分別在7月29日跟30日落底，單點集中非常明顯，代表台美股那時是爆發典型「全面性恐慌賣壓」，且不同股票的情況可說是兩個世界，跌最深的中小型股票股價直接腰斬，但輝達等權值股相對抗跌。

​台股大盤跌的其實不重？阮慕驊揭護國神山撐住​

阮慕驊表示，而台股加權指數本波段的跌幅是18.3%，但其實多數股票都跌得更深，他統計前100大上市櫃權值股，「有74檔跌幅都超過指數」，但占大盤42%權重的台積電股價僅跌14%，可說是由台積電撐住，是指數跌幅遠遠小於個股的主要原因。

阮慕驊分析，對照台美股市這波修正的共通點，就是都由權值股在抗跌護盤，費半就是輝達跟台積電ADR、台股就是台積電，但重災區股價就是幾乎腰斬，跌幅大於指數非常明顯，「結論是指數溫和，但個股波動非常劇烈，只看指數並不能描述這次下跌的慘烈。」

​中小型股恐更慘烈？阮慕驊曝熱錢回不來原因​

阮慕驊直言，所以台股大盤只跌18%，但為何這麼多人受傷，就是因為很多股票的跌幅都一口氣砍到5成，這才是真正的破滅，「而且我只統計百大權值股，如果把所有股票都統計進來的，情況會更慘烈，中小型股回檔幅度可能更深。」

阮慕驊提到，而股市現在為何量能不出，他觀察是因為很多人受傷太重而直接退出市場，另一群人則是即使反彈回升也不敢進場，最後是仍有非常多人可能至今還被套牢在高點，也沒有再進場的資金，因此形成了資金被卡死的狀況，使得成交量出不來。

news.Title: 7月台股劇烈震盪  證交稅大減23％  降至651億元
news.Content:
財政部今日公布賦稅收入，7月台股大幅震盪，使得證交稅也受到影響，日均交易量雖仍有1兆5232億元，但是月減約25％，使得證交稅單月稅收降至651億元，不過累計證交稅已經達到3987億元，。

財政部公布的數據顯示，今年前7月稅收已經達到2兆8767億元，較去年增加5746億元。

7月台股震盪劇烈，7月17日下跌2954點，創下歷史最大跌點，月底指數收在43119.75點，較6月大跌約3006點，為史上第2大月跌點，僅次於今年3月，跌幅6.5％。台股震盪也導致量縮，7月日均交易量縮至1兆5232億元，月減25％，因此單月證交稅收651億元，雖仍是歷史第3高，不過相較6月，減幅也達到23％。

前7月的證交稅收累計有3987億元，為民國87年以來同期最高，而且已經超越去年全年的證交稅收。

至於房地相關的稅收，受惠於新建案交屋與部分縣市調整房屋標準單價所貢獻，契稅單月、累計都呈現雙增的情況，契稅7月稅收17億元，年增率19.4％，累計前7月97億元，年增7.7％。

但是土增稅7月59億元，年減10.9％；累計前7月392億元，年減8.5％；另外，個人房地合一稅50億元，年減14.1％、累計前7月僅只有275億元，年減6.8％，房市景氣尚未完全回神。

財政部表示，7月創單月新高有營業稅，稅收1376億元，年增22.3％，主要是台灣貿易活絡，海關代徵營業稅所貢獻；另外印花稅7月稅收32億元，也創歷史新高，年增19.7％，主要是銀行放款應稅憑證增加所致。

news.Title: 台積電：Sony計畫透過現金投入及公司分割之資產轉移方式，挹注合資公司共約4650億日圓
news.Content:
公開資訊觀測站重大訊息公告

(2330)台積電-Sony與台積公司同意成立合資公司支援下一世代影像感測器

1.事實發生日:115/08/11

2.公司名稱:台灣積體電路製造股份有限公司

3.與公司關係(請輸入本公司或子公司):本公司

4.相互持股比例:不適用

5.發生緣由:不適用

6.因應措施:不適用

7.其他應敘明事項(若事件發生或決議之主體係屬公開發行以上公司，本則重大訊息同時符合證券交易法施行細則第7條第9款所定對股東權益或證券價格有重大影響之事項):

索尼半導體解決方案公司（Sony）與台積公司今（11）日宣布雙方簽署具法律效力之最終合作協議，於日本熊本縣合志市成立合資公司Advanced Vision

Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation。此合資公司將採用先進製程技術，作為量產智慧型手機影像感測器所需之研發及製造的核心樞紐，並預計於2029年開始量產。

此合資公司將由Sony作為單一控制股東，並計畫以索尼集團（Sony Group）公司之合併子公司營運。此合資公司之代表董事將由Sony指派。

依據最終協議，Sony計畫透過現金投入及公司分割之資產轉移(註)方式，挹注合資公司共約4,650億日圓；台積公司則計畫投資現金約2,820億日圓。這些資金的投入將基於市場需求及其他相關業務條件分階段進行。除了Sony與台積公司所投入的資金，有關實現此合資公司產能規畫所需要的投資，其考量前提是必須能夠獲得來自日本政府的支持。

在此策略合作夥伴關係下，Sony將在核心影像感測器技術的研發、產品規劃與設計中擔任領導角色，而此合資公司計畫利用台積公司的先進製程技術與製造專業來推動量產所需的生產研發與製造。透過此次合作，雙方將加速推動受客戶需求驅動的影像感測器產品進入市場，同時促進技術創新與強化製造能力。

此合資公司的設立與交易完成條件皆須取得必要的主管機關核准，並遵循交易常規。

有關此策略合作夥伴關係的其他事宜，請依Sony與台積公司於今年5月8日發布之「Sony與台積公司初步達成下一世代影像感測器策略合作協議」新聞稿為準。

註：Sony在日本熊本縣合志市已投資之新建廠房。

台積電董事會核准於日本投資設立合資公司、持股37.8%，上限2820億日圓

台積電董事會核准160.35億美元先進製程、47.91億美元先進封裝與成熟/特殊製程等設備案

資料來源- MoneyDJ理財網

台積公司今（11）日召開董事會，會中重要決議如下：

一、核准2026年第二季營業報告書及財務報表，其中第二季合併營收約新台幣1兆2,703億8千萬元，稅後純益約新台幣7,065億6千萬元，每股盈餘為新台幣27.25元。

二、核准配發2026年第二季之每股現金股利7.0元，其普通股配息基準日訂定為2026年12月16日，除息交易日則為2026年12月10日。依公司法第一六五條規定，在公司決定分派股息之基準日前五日內，亦即自2026年12月12日起至12月16日止，停止普通股股票過戶，並於2027年1月7日發放。此外，因應台灣金管會法規修訂，台積公司將自本次股利分派開始提供依「華僑及外國人投資證券管理辦法」投資之外資股東以美元收受現金股利之選擇權利。台積公司在美國紐約證券交易所上市之美國存託憑證之除息交易日及配息基準日皆為2026年12月10日。

三、為了因應基於市場需求預測及技術開發藍圖所制定的長期產能規劃，核准資本預算約美金294億4,250萬元，內容主要包括：1. 建置及升級先進製程產能；2. 建置及升級先進封裝、成熟及/或特殊製程產能；3. 廠房興建及廠務設施工程。

四、核准與索尼半導體解決方案公司（Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation）合資成立新公司，以研發與製造下一世代影像感測器，以及於不超過日幣2,820億元之額度內認購該合資公司之股份。

news.Title: 三大法人連2天同步買超　外資加碼223億元華邦電居冠
news.Content:
（中央社記者何秀玲台北2026年8月11日電）台股今天漲191.96點，收在45120.72點，成交值新台幣8690.16億元。三大法人連2日同步站在買方，今天合計買超281.78億元；外資加碼華邦電 (2344) 、至上 (8112) 、中鋼 (2002) 等個股，其中買超華邦電3萬7872張居冠。

三大法人今天合計買超281.78億元，其中自營商買超24.6億元，投信買超33.9億元，外資及陸資買超223.28億元。

外資買超前5名，華邦電3萬7872張居冠、至上3萬3079張居次，其餘依序為中鋼、第一金 (2892) 、主動統一台股增長（00981A）。

外資賣超前5名，友達 (2409) 5萬6259張居首、華航 (2610) 2萬6706張居次，其餘依序為合庫金 (5880) 、主動復華未來50（00991A）、台企銀 (2834) 。

萬寶投顧執行長王榮旭對中央社記者表示，台股7月拉回修正，一度拉回至39000多點，近期已反彈近6000點並站上45000點，但量能並未明顯放大，因部分投資人認為漲幅已大不敢追價，反而形成軋空走勢；外資昨天大幅回補，今天再買超逾200億元，顯示外資操作心態與先前台股下跌階段已有所轉變。

王榮旭指出，目前國際主要股市表現仍佳，加上企業財報具有獲利支撐，對台股大盤後市不悲觀；台積電 (2330) 7月營收再創歷史新高，也為大盤提供基本面支撐，現階段行情重點反而漸轉向個股表現。

他表示，由於市場量能不足以支撐所有股票上漲，預期個股將呈現分化及族群輪動格局。隨著半年報、7月營收陸續公布，法人與市場大戶將從財報數字尋找下半年業績成長股，8月中下旬至9月行情重點可能不在大盤，而在個股表現。

news.Title: 16 Wall Street Analysts Couldn't Disagree More on Sandisk's Price Target
news.Content: Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) stock has rocketed 2,800% higher over the past year as demand for the company's memory processors has spiked, with tech companies snatching up swaths of memory for artificial intelligence data centers. Analysts differ greatly on their price targets for the stock, with some setting it as low as $1,300 and others as high as $3,000 -- with the average about $2,220. But they overwhelmingly agree ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Sandisk (SNDK) stock has seen significant appreciation (2,800% over the past year) driven by demand for memory processors for AI data centers.
• Analysts have a wide range of price targets ($1,300 to $3,000, average $2,220) but overwhelmingly recommend it as a buy.
• The company's Q4 fiscal 2026 gross margin was nearly 85% (up from 26.4% year-over-year), and non-GAAP earnings surged to $39.25 per share (from $0.29).
• The NAND memory shortage is a key factor, with some analysts expecting it to last several years, driving sustained earnings growth.
• Despite a Q1 revenue guidance slightly below consensus, 13 out of 16 analysts rate Sandisk as a buy, anticipating elevated memory demand.
news.Keywords: memory processors, AI data centers, NAND shortage, gross margin expansion, analyst consensus

news.Title: 財女Jenny揭投資美股「大、穩、賺錢」三大心法 善用009820掌握AI成長紅利
news.Content: 《鉅亨網》今 (11) 日舉辦「布局核心投資機會 掌握美股科技成長浪潮」論壇，邀請納斯達克首席經濟學家 Phil Mackintosh 與「JC 財經觀點」創辦人財女 Jenny 剖析全球經濟與美股投資趨勢。財女 Jenny 從實戰投資角度分析，指出當前美股已進入「大者恆大、強者恆強」的時代，投資人應透過「大、穩、賺錢」三大指標，精準捕捉 AI 科技革命帶來的財富重組契機。投資人可善用定期定額與 5 至 10 年的長期布局策略，藉由元大納斯達克精選 (009820-TW) 等美股 ETF，穩健卡位 AI 科技的未來成長紅利。 Jenny 一開場就詢問觀眾是否僅把 AI 工具當成「高級 Google」詢問簡單生活資訊，她直言，AI 真正威力在於將重複性、複雜的工作流程自動化及系統化。從輝達黃仁勳提出的「五層蛋糕理論」到台積電的「三層蛋糕理論」，管理層已明確畫出未來的獲利藍圖。 Jenny 指出，台美股市在 AI 供應鏈上高度緊密相連，投資人可透過科技巨頭財報、供應鏈訂單與台灣海關出口數據，精準掌握 AI 產業輪動。針對當前市場環境，她提出「不只買大，更要買強」的美股投資顯學。 Jenny 分析，自 2011 年以來，美股獲利高度集中於少數科技巨頭。在 AI 時代，基礎設施動輒需要數千億美元的資本投入，中小企業根本無力參戰，使得大型科技股具備無可替代的壟斷與規模優勢。相較於高波動的小型股，美股大型科技股兼具高年化報酬與較低波動度，更適合長期持有。 Jenny 歸納出選股的 「大、穩、賺錢」 三大關鍵指標，首先要看規模與地位，觀察市值規模、營收規模與指數權重。規模大代表市場認同度高、產業護城河深，短期內絕難被競爭對手取代。 其次要穩，投資人可關注「營收是否高速成長」、「毛利率」與「營業利潤率」。營收成長代表公司身處高擴張市場；高毛利與營業利潤則展現公司的產品定價權與經營效率，確保獲利品質無虞。 最後是要賺錢，投資股票看的是「未來的獲利潛力」而非僅是過去的紀錄。企業是否具備「第二成長曲線」，是決定長期估值能否持續墊高的關鍵，例如蘋果結合 AI 的潛在換機潮與訂閱生態。 Jenny 強調，隨著科技不斷突破、全球經濟在 AI 浪潮下持續成長，投資人應把握每一次技術創新所帶來的「財富重分配」歷史機遇，透過佈局具備強大護城河與獲利變現能力的美股科技巨頭，穩健掌握核心資產的長期成長紅利。 專家傳授美股科技戰略 善用 009820 掌握 AI 成長紅利 元大投信研究團隊指出，美國第二季企業獲利成長率估達 47%，且預期獲利呈現難得的上修，反映企業具備優異且持續的賺錢能力；同時 CPI 與核心 PCE 年增率持續放緩，失業率與 GDP 數據穩健，市場對聯準會繼續升息的預期已大幅冷卻。歷史數據顯示，升息循環若有強勁獲利或科技趨勢支撐，股市依然能維持亮眼漲幅。 針對投資人關心的下半年美股兩大影響因子，元大投信表示，選前 3 個月波動雖大，但選後不確定性消除將迎來反彈，且歷史上總統任期第 3 年多為大牛市。更重要的是 AI 科技創新，目前大型科技股具備強勁現金流與實質盈餘 (本益比約 21.5 倍，非 2000 年網路泡沫)，未來基建資本支出仍有擴充空間，將持續帶動半導體與軟硬體需求。 面對市場波動，元大投信建議採取定期定額與長期持有 5-10 年，為最佳投資策略，利用時間複利平攤成本並提高正報酬確定性。009820 追蹤「Nasdaq 100 增強指數」，透過研發費用率、營運穩定度、營收與 EPS 成長率四大指標，精選出 30 檔核心龍頭，兼具低費用率、軟硬體均衡配置與強勁的反彈爆發力，是參與未來十年 AI 成長脈動的優質工具。

news.Title: 兆豐投信2台股ETF大啖AI供應鏈商機
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】美國雲端服務供應商（CSP）最新2026年第2季財報與法說會釋出重磅利多！因AI需求強勁與零組件成本攀升，多數科技巨頭上修資本支出展望。根據市場預估，美國5大CSP業者2026年整體資本支出將大幅上修至7951億美元（年增率達77%），2027 年更將進一步突破1.06兆美元（年增率33%）。這波龐大的結構性上升週期，將直接為台灣AI半導體及藍籌大廠注入長期的營運成長動能。

兆豐投信旗下2大台股指標ETF—兆豐台灣晶圓製造（00913）與兆豐藍籌30（00690），恰逢8月除息旺季，2檔ETF的除息交易日皆訂於8月18日，投資人只要在8月17日前買進或持有，即可參與本次除息。各大CSP管理層看法高度一致，重申AI運算、雲端基礎設施與電源零組件產能為當前最關鍵的瓶頸，印證AI基礎建設投資週期仍處於早期階段，未來數年將維持結構性上升趨勢，為台灣相關供應鏈提供強勁的成長動能。

在此產業趨勢下，專注鎖定台灣半導體的兆豐台灣晶圓製造 ETF展現驚人的「黑馬之姿」。由於CSP積極擴建資料中心，對於先進晶圓代工、高頻寬記憶體（HBM）及網通設備的需求呈現強勁增長，其核心持股精準布局晶圓代工龍頭與半導體關鍵供應鏈，成功吸引市場關注，帶動基金受益人數持續刷新成立後新高。除此之外，今年以來受益人數增幅達到315%，位居台股半導體 ETF成長之冠，成為投資人參與AI半導體長線行情的核心配置首選。

採季配息機制的兆豐藍籌30 ETF，則全面配置財務結構健全、具備產業代表性且獲利能力高的大型藍籌股。隨著AI商機落地，台股供應鏈中的AI電源基礎設施、伺服器、液冷散熱及光通訊等權值大廠營運持續獲得上修。兼顧抗震韌性與隨大盤進攻的特性，成為投資人在高波動市場中，攻守兼備的台股市值型布局選項。（自立電子報2026/8/11）

news.Title: 台股開低走高站上4萬5大關　台積電收漲15元
news.Content:
【記者許麗珍／台北報導】荷莫茲海峽重新開放的談判再陷僵局，美股10日收跌。台股今開低走高但盤中上下震盪，終場上漲191.96點或0.43%，收在45,120.72點，站上4萬5大關，成交金額8690.16億元。權值股台積電今早先開平盤，隨後小漲5元，終場上漲15元收2395元。

荷莫茲海峽重新開放的談判再陷僵局，美股受賣壓籠罩，4大指數今（10）日全面走低，費半重挫近3%，台積電ADR收黑。

道瓊工業指數小挫60.95點或0.11%，收53975.98點，標準普爾500指數微跌4.53點或0.06%，收7753.11點；那斯達克指數下滑85.26點或0.32%，收26605.36點，費城半導體指數重挫362.93點或2.94%，收11993.86點。

市場對聯準會升息預期降低，資金重回高估值的科技股，台股10日盤中大漲近千點，終場上漲702.85點，收在44928.76點。根據台灣證券交易所統計，三大法人合計買超新台幣731.67億元。

此外，台積電公布7月營收新台幣4675.8億元，再創歷史新高，較6月增加5.6%，較去年同期增加44.7%。法人指出，2奈米等先進製程需求強勁，是推升7月營收創高的主要動力。

news.Title: 台股法說行情開跑 高含積ETF吹反攻號角
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】AI基建泡沫疑慮淡化，市場信心逐步回溫，台股也從39384.85低點急彈、盤勢守穩在季線之上，法人表示，台股受惠台積電7月營收發燙，創連3個月創單月歷史新高，成台股定心丸；各家法說會行情持續上演，預估企業獲利、營運前景有助提振市場信心，預估未來大盤站穩季線後，有利於波段行情發展，建議投資人現階段可鎖定高含積量台股ETF、半導體ETF分批布局，未來股價有機會隨8/26輝達財報題材發酵，中長線則看好2027年科技股作夢題材加持，帶旺ETF股價吹反攻號角，重啟新一波攻勢。

台新臺灣半導體30 ETF（00904）經理人張意聆表示，今年美股企業盈利強勁，且有跡象表明大型雲端科技業者(Hyperscaler)的AI投資，將推動營收實現更快增長，帶動美股上周主要指數回血，費半及那指紛紛大漲。台積電最新公布7月營收再創新高，也顯示晶圓代工龍頭受惠於先進製程與先進封裝供不應求，尤其是2奈米量產、加上3奈米產出增加，帶動台積電7月營收再創單月歷史新高，也二度上修全年美元營收展望。表示企業財報利多，正帶動市場風險偏好回升，有助於現階段台股行情雖仍震盪，中長線並不看淡。

張意聆強調，近來美國就業數據疲弱，降低聯準會近期再升息壓力，加上科技與AI大型股重新領漲，成為推動美股再創新高的主力部隊，一旦美股多頭攻勢再起，有利連動台股，尤其在近期輝達市值飆升、美4大CSP持續擴大AI相關資本支出，加上本周台積電7月營收創新高、其他科技大廠法說會可望釋出正向展望，有助強化台股AI、半導體供應鏈後市信心，建議看好台股反彈行情，可以鎖定高含積的台股ETF或半導體ETF，股價將隨代理AI、實體AI題材繼續發威，是掌握波段行情的最佳主攻手，值得投資人現階段分批卡位布局。（自立電子報2026/8/11）

台積電規劃70%至80%的資本支出將用於先進製程技術，約10%的資本支出用於特殊製程技術，10%至20%的資本支出用於先進封裝、測試、光罩製作及其他項目。

news.Title: 台股ETF 10猛將 近1年績效翻倍
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】美伊戰爭再現曙光，加上道瓊與標普500指數創新高，費城半導體指數大漲等利多帶動，激勵加權指數強攻重返4萬4000點關卡之上，在AI股強攻下，加權指數近一年大漲逾87%，而台股ETF 10猛將近1年更是績效翻倍，漲贏大盤40%以上，其中，國內唯一同時聚焦IC設計與記憶體的的台股ETF台新臺灣IC設計（00947）受惠多檔成份股漲停的帶動，近1年唯一大漲逾170%，高居台股主被動ETF第1，較大盤超額報酬高達85%，實力驚人。

近1年漲幅第1的台新臺灣IC設計成份股為兩大熱門族群高價IP/IC類股及記憶體類股合計占比超過8成，10大成份股包括：聯發科、華邦電、南亞科、群聯、創意、台達電、世芯、信驊、旺宏、矽力，皆是今年來飆漲的熱門股，因此推升00947股價頻創新高。

台新臺灣IC設計研究團隊指出，AI發展日新月異並光速推進，算力需求跟著大噴發，高盛預估2030年全球每月token處理量將達120千兆個，是2026年現有算力水平的24倍。台股AI股競爭地位在全球首屈一指，受惠程度大，分析師預估台股AI股2026獲利成長率上看5成以上，IC設計及記憶體成長動能相對看好，建議布局聚焦「IC設計+記憶體」雙組合的台股ETF，對於買不起高價股的小資族而言，布局00947可參與高價股大漲的榮景。

今年來大漲144%的台新臺灣半導體30 ETF（00904）經理人張意聆表示，7月半導體股大跌後急彈，反映AI進入獲利驗證期，引發資金流出高資本支出的科技股，半導體股價也陷入修正，不過，觀察美科技巨頭最新公布的財報，像CSP雲端龍頭企業，仍維持新增AI資本支出計劃；同時，CSP財報內容中，AI投資也有反映公司獲利成長跡象，顯示科技大廠新增AI投資，有助於持續創造高於資金成本的價值。

張意聆強調，目前科技大廠的AI建置處於技術投資初期，2026年算是爬坡期，對於預估未來AI收入及生產效益將於2027年滯後顯現，預估半導體股價短期內，仍將受高利率、AI商業化驗證壓抑評價，但進入8月起至今年底，只要美國利率緊縮預期降溫，資金壓力緩解，半導體股估值有望快速修復，7月股價下殺應屬正常牛市整理，整體科技股估值修復時點，可能落在今年第4季。（自立電子報2026/8/11）

news.Title: 國巨飆回6字頭能追？專家急喊「別跳進去」 看看這2檔記憶體
news.Content:
被動元件龍頭國巨7月營收再創歷史新高，帶動今（11日）股價強勢大漲逾 7%、收在617元並站上月線。專家提醒，國巨股價自456元低點強彈近200 元，目前市場仍處於籌碼清洗與資金輪動階段，如前兩天強勢的華邦電、南亞科今日即出現回檔；投資人切莫因短線大漲就誤以為主升段啟動而貿然追高。

國巨7月合併營收達 161.31 億元，月增 5%、年增 51.5%，連五個月刷新歷史新高紀錄；累計前七月營收987.53億元，年增32.5%。

資深分析師周代運在臉書發文指出，國巨這一波下殺至456元低點，引發原本樂觀的投資人陷入恐慌，在市場看空情緒籠罩下紛紛急著砍在底部。隨著恐慌賣壓釋放完畢、籌碼清洗乾淨，市場資金重新回流，推升股價一路強勢反彈重回600元大關。

周代運表示，盤面上前兩天強勢的華邦電、南亞科今天出現回檔，而經歷深度震盪、浮額清理到位的國巨則率先反彈，這並非單一族群的拉扯，而是多頭中段常見的資金調節。強勢股累積大量獲利盤後面臨主力調節，跌深且籌碼安定的個股自然吸引承接買盤。

他指出，被動元件過往幾輪週期走勢，幾乎都在重演人性循環：高點過度樂觀追價、低點全盤悲觀不敢布局，待股價拉回一大段後情緒又再次躁動，迫不及待想進場追高。說真的，這也是現在最擔心大家的地方。

周代運提醒，投資人切莫一看到盤面走強就急於追高，誤以為新一波主升段已全面啟動。他強調，自己對後市依然看多，先前建議在低點布局國巨，至今已累積大漲近200元，反彈到600元之上也不宜再追，至於大盤短線在45120點附近面臨壓力，波段布局可靜待中秋變盤，後續仍有機會挑戰53000點高點。

news.Title: 台股站上4萬5卻千檔下跌！法人揭「假熱鬧真輪動」：2大低基期族群接棒
news.Content:
台股11日上演典型「開低走高」行情，加權指數終場上漲191.96點、收45,120點，成交量縮至約8,700億元。不過，指數收紅背後卻出現明顯分歧，上市櫃下跌家數超過1,000家，市場再度陷入「指數有感、個股無感」的拉積盤格局。摩爾投顧分析師盤後指出，台積電與聯發科等權值股撐住大盤，但中小型股賣壓仍重，投資人普遍觀望美國即將公布的7月CPI數據。

6兆營收撐盤

上市櫃公司7月營收合計達5.79兆元，創單月歷史新高，連續5個月突破5兆元；營收創新高家數更首度突破200家，達206家。若加計較晚公布的大型金控，市場估計7月營收可望首度突破6兆元。

其中，鴻海(2317)7月營收9,465.1億元、台積電(2330)4,675.8億元，均創下亮眼成績，AI伺服器、先進製程與相關零組件需求仍是主要推力。

被動元件、ASIC接棒記憶體

相較於前期強勢的記憶體與CPO族群，11日資金明顯轉向被動元件，國巨*(2327)、華新科(2492)、禾伸堂(3026)領軍走強，信昌電(6173)等也同步表現。

市場關注的是AI伺服器需求持續推升MLCC等被動元件訂單，法人資料顯示，台廠訂單出貨比維持在相對高檔，反映供需結構改善。這波行情因此不只是跌深反彈，也有資金尋找低基期AI受惠股的意味。

AI主線並未熄火，而是出現族群輪動。創意(3443)11日亮燈漲停，市場聚焦Google TPU及CPU設計服務題材；相較之下，前期漲幅較大的記憶體族群出現整理，顯示資金開始從高位階題材轉向具訂單能見度的ASIC與設計服務。

分析師認為，現階段台股並非全面多頭，而是進入「權值股撐指數、資金做輪動」階段。基本面強勁提供大盤下檔支撐，但個股表現將更加分化，投資人應避免追逐短線急漲股，轉向營收、獲利與產業需求同步改善的標的。

CPI前觀望 震盪中汰弱留強

市場接下來仍將聚焦美國7月CPI，以及其對聯準會9月降息預期的影響。在數據公布前，台股量能收斂、震盪加劇並不意外。

news.Title: 台積電第2季股利維持每股7元　12/10除息
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中新竹2026年08月11日電）晶圓代工廠台積電 (2330) 董事會今天核准2026年第2季現金股利每股新台幣7元，維持與第1季相同水準，除息交易日為2026年12月10日。

在高效能運算、物聯網、車用及消費電子平台業績成長推升下，台積電2026年第2季營收與獲利續創歷史新高，季營收達402億美元，約新台幣1兆2703.8億元，歸屬母公司淨利7065.6億元，每股純益27.25元。

台積電董事會核准配發2026年第2季每股現金股利7元，配息基準日定為2026年12月16日，除息交易日為12月10日，自12月12日起至12月16日止停止普通股股票過戶，並於2027年1月7日發放。

台積電董事長魏哲家2026年7月持有台積電745萬2349股，將有5216萬元入袋。行政院國家發展基金管理會持有台積電16.537億股，估計有115.759億元入帳。

台積電創辦人張忠謀2018年6月退休前持有台積電1.25億股，他在退休後若未處分手中持股，估計將有約8.75億元入袋。

news.Title: 7月台股價量齊走弱　證交稅收斂至651億元
news.Content:
（中央社記者呂晏慈台北2026年8月11日電）財政部今天公布7月全國賦稅收入初步統計，受台股震盪劇烈影響，價量同步走弱，使得證券交易稅實徵淨額降至新台幣651億元，不過相較去年仍年增1.7倍；累計前7月證交稅實徵淨額3987億元，創同期新高。

財政部公布7月全國賦稅收入初步統計概況，7月實徵淨額2891億元，年減67%，主因去年所得稅結算申報及繳納期限延長，稅款遞延至7月，基期偏高所致。

財政部統計處副處長劉訓蓉表示，7月台股震盪劇烈，價量同步走弱，單日指數的漲跌點均創下歷史新高，月底指數收在43119.75點，較6月大跌3006點，為史上第2大月跌點，僅次於今年3月，跌幅6.5%。

劉訓蓉表示，7月台股呈現劇烈震盪格局，市場量能隨著指數大幅波動而明顯降溫，日均成交值為1兆1532億元，相較6月減少25.2%，但數值仍是歷年單月第3高，年增幅1.8倍。

她指出，由於股市成交值下滑，7月證交稅實徵淨額降至651億元，月減23.3%，年增1.7倍，為連續12個月正成長。

此外，今年前7月證交稅實徵淨額3987億元，年增2593億元，劉訓蓉說明，兩者均刷新歷年同期新高紀錄，年增幅為1.9倍，為87年以來同期新高。

劉訓蓉補充，截至今天為止，8月台股日均成交值為1兆784億元，較7月平均值稍微下滑。

其他呈現年增的稅目部分，7月包括營業稅、印花稅均創歷年單月新高，關稅、證交稅、期交稅、契稅則創同月新高。

營業稅7月實徵淨額1376億元，年增22.3%，主因內需穩定，加以資通與視聽產品、電子零組件等進口代徵稅額增加，惟出口暢旺，適用外銷零稅率營業人申請退稅亦增，抵銷部分增幅。

印花稅7月實徵淨額32億元，年增19.7%，主因銀行放款應稅憑證增加。

今年前7月總稅收實徵淨額2兆8767億元，為歷年同期新高，年增25%，其中包括關稅、營所稅、綜所稅、遺產稅、證交稅、期交稅、營業稅、房屋稅、印花稅、娛樂稅均創同期新高。

劉訓蓉說明，去年全年總稅收實徵淨額為3兆7879億元，預估後續若股市狀況沒有太大變化，今年全年總稅收實徵淨額將較去年稍微成長。

觀察各級政府賦稅收入概況，前7月中央政府賦稅收入實徵淨額1兆9177億元，占分配預算數122.1%，較去年同期增加13.5%。

劉訓蓉表示，雖然新版財政收支劃分法開始施行，營業稅劃歸中央政府比率大幅調降，減少2202億元、占比90.9%，惟證交稅、營所稅增加2593億元、1301億元，互抵後呈現上升。

news.Title: 外資連2買狂掃740億！ 網見第一名傻眼：買成這樣還綠的
news.Content:
台股今（11）日開低震盪，盤中買盤回籠，加權指數終場上漲191.96點，收在45120.72點，漲幅0.43%，成交值8690.16億元。三大法人同步站在買方，合計買超281.78億元，其中外資買超223.29億元，連續第2個交易日買超，本週2個交易日合計狂買740.70億元。

外資今日持續回補台股，買超金額達223.29億元，繼前一交易日買超517.41億元後，連續第2個交易日站在買方，短短兩個交易日累計買超達740.70億元，資金回流態勢相當明顯。

從外資買超個股來看，華邦電（2344）今日成為買超冠軍，單日大買3萬7871張；至上（8112）買超3萬3079張居次，中鋼（2002）買超2萬9246張，第一金（2892）也獲買超2萬3747張。此外，主動統一台股增長（00981A）買超1萬9816張、元大台灣50（0050）買超1萬8569張，南亞科（2408）買超1萬5172張，華新（1605）及台橡（2103）則分別買超1萬2065張、1萬1591張，群益台灣精選高息（00919）也買超1萬246張。

值得注意的是，華邦電雖然獲得外資大舉買進，股價表現卻與籌碼形成強烈反差，成為盤後網友熱議焦點。有網友看到華邦電登上外資買超第一名後直呼「買成這樣還綠的」，也有人留言「華邦電榜首，結果是綠色」，對於外資大買、股價卻未能同步上漲感到疑惑。

記憶體族群也成為討論焦點，南亞科同樣名列外資買超前10名，不過盤面上相關個股走勢分歧，網友接連發問「記憶體誰在賣？」、「大買的記憶體跌，大賣的被動元件漲」，顯示市場對記憶體族群短線籌碼仍有不同解讀。

另一方面，外資今日也大幅調節部分個股，其中友達（2409）遭賣超5萬6259張居冠，華航（2610）賣超2萬6705張，合庫金（5880）賣超2萬5723張，主動復華未來50（00991A）賣超2萬90張。金融股同樣出現調節，臺企銀（2834）遭賣超1萬8305張、兆豐金（2886）賣超1萬7172張、玉山金（2884）賣超9675張；群創（3481）、主動群益台灣強棒（00982A）及友訊（2332）也遭外資賣超。

盤面另一個有趣現象是，被動元件族群今日股價走強，但外資卻出現調節，網友因此討論外資是否正在進行族群輪動，有人甚至留言「小兒國巨賣成這樣還能漲7.68%」，認為外資籌碼動向與股價表現並非完全同步。

news.Title: Why Is the U.S. Army Buying $54 Billion Worth of Patriot Missiles From Lockheed Martin?
news.Content: The Iran war has done a number on U.S. weapons stockpiles -- and finances. Fewer than 800 Patriots remain in U.S. ...
news.AI_Summary:
• The U.S. Army is planning a significant purchase of $53.9 billion worth of new Patriot Advanced Capability-3 Missile Segment Enhancement (PAC-3 MSE) air defense missiles from Lockheed Martin.
• This order aims to replenish depleted U.S. stockpiles following the Iran war, where an estimated 65% of existing Patriot missiles were used.
• The purchase covers production over seven years, implying a roughly nine-fold increase in the annual production rate of Patriot missiles.
• Lockheed Martin is also introducing a new, cheaper missile, the PAC-3 ACE, designed for mass production and handling less severe threats, complementing the MSEs.
• The significant MSE order suggests that the introduction of ACE will not cannibalize MSE sales but rather add to Lockheed Martin's revenue and profits.

Although the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady at 3.5%-3.75%, three members favoring a ...
news.AI_Summary:

• These actions aim to stabilize prices and manage inflation without directly adjusting the federal funds target rate.

This quarter it lost about ...
news.AI_Summary:

news.Title: 台股強彈702點！面板雙虎、電源雙雄爆量漲停 記憶體全面點火｜Yahoo財經掃描
news.Content:
買盤強勢回流！台股今(10)日開高走高，盤中最高衝至45,219.40點，終場上漲702.85點、漲幅1.59%，收在44,928.76點，4萬5千點得而復失，成交金額達8,485.79億元。權王 台積電(2330) 盤中最高漲至2,410元，尾盤漲幅收斂，終場上漲10元、收2,380元。電源雙雄成為撐盤主力， 台達電(2308) 、 光寶科(2301) 雙雙攻上漲停，助攻大盤強彈；第三檔萬金股 川湖(2059) 盤中一度亮燈、衝上12,220元，隨後漲停打開，仍收漲逾7%。記憶體族群延續強彈， 華邦電(2344) 、 南亞科(2408) 漲停領軍， 旺宏(2337) 、 力積電(6770) 同步走揚；被動元件波動依舊劇烈， 禾伸堂(3026) 配合處置新制提前解禁，盤中直奔漲停， 國巨*(2327) 、 華新科(2492) 、 信昌電(6173) 、 日電貿(3090) 也同步收紅。面板股 友達(2409) 、 群創(3481) 則受惠市場購廠傳聞，雙雙亮燈漲停；航空股則逆勢承壓， 華航(2610) 受第二季獲利衰退、油價高檔震盪等利空夾擊，盤中重挫逾9%， 長榮航(2618) 、 星宇航空(2646) 也同步走弱。

亞股同樣全面收漲，其中日經指數勁揚2.08%，表現最為強勢，韓國綜合指數則小漲0.65%；香港恆生指數上漲1.12%，上海綜合指數走高0.67%。

📝盤點熱門股：群益臺灣加權正2、力積電、群創

熱門成交股方面，前五檔全數收紅。 群益臺灣加權正2(00685L) 以26.21萬張登上成交王，顯示短線資金積極追捧；而 元大台灣50正2(00631L) 也同步放量上漲，正2商品近期成為資金放大反彈行情的熱門選擇。

記憶體股今日群情激昂， 力積電(6770) 跟隨盤勢走高， 南亞科(2408) 更是爆量衝上502元的漲停價，成交金額超越台積電，而 華邦電(2344) 同步放量漲停，成交金額排行第三。

而面板雙虎則受惠於美股SpaceX暴力反彈而雙雙爆量漲停，其中 友達(2409) 更受惠台積電洽購友達中科兩座廠房、擴充先進封裝產能的市場傳聞，題材引爆追價買盤。

news.Title: Arm Stock Is Off 39% From Its High. Why This Could Be the Best Time to Buy.
news.Content:
After an impressive rally, Arm Holdings (ARM) has experienced a sharp correction, with its stock price falling 36.3% from its 52-week high. The decline has largely been driven by profit-taking following the stock's strong run, along with concerns about sluggish smartphone demand, which remains an important end market for the company.

However, a closer look at Arm's latest financial performance and long-term growth drivers suggests that the recent weakness represents an entry point. Arm Holdings continues to benefit from accelerating adoption of artificial intelligence (AI), expanding demand for its chip architecture across data centers, automotive applications, edge devices, and cloud infrastructure.

More News from Barchart

Don't Assume Micron Will Share SanDisk's Fate. Here's Why.

The Nvidia-SpaceX Deal Is Sending a Clear Signal on AI Dominance

A $72 Billion Reason to Buy Caterpillar Stock Now

Stop Missing Market Moves: Get the FREE Barchart Brief – your midday dose of stock movers, trending sectors, and actionable trade ideas, delivered right to your inbox. Sign Up Now!

In addition, Arm's growing technology portfolio and strengthening relationships with major global customers position it well for sustained long-term growth.

Arm's Strong Performance Shows the Business Remains Strong

Arm began fiscal 2027 with impressive momentum. First-quarter revenue increased 22% year-over-year (YOY) to $1.29 billion, reflecting broad-based demand across its business.

Royalty revenue climbed 22% to a record $715 million for a first quarter, led by AI-related demand. Cloud AI remained the largest contributor, while data-center royalty revenue more than doubled from a year ago as hyperscale cloud providers expanded deployments of Arm-based processors.

The company is also benefiting from growing adoption of networking chips such as DPUs and SmartNICs, both of which are increasingly used in AI infrastructure.

Although smartphone shipments remain under pressure due to weaker consumer demand and higher memory prices, Arm has successfully offset this weakness through higher-value technologies. Adoption of its latest Armv9 architecture and Compute Subsystems continues to rise across smartphones, tablets, and other connected devices. Because these products generate higher royalty rates, Arm can grow revenue even in a sluggish handset market.

Beyond consumer electronics, Arm is expanding into Physical AI, with its architecture gaining traction in advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), autonomous vehicles, robotics, and industrial automation. This diversification reduces reliance on smartphones and strengthens the company's long-term growth profile.

Story Continues

Meanwhile, license and other revenue rose 23% to $574 million, driven by renewed long-term licensing agreements and new customer wins across multiple industries.

AGI CPU and Neoverse to Support Solid Growth Ahead

Arm has several new growth drivers that could significantly expand its addressable market over the next few years. One of the most important catalysts is the company's newly introduced Arm AGI CPU, which extends the Arm Compute Platform into AI infrastructure.

Initial shipments have already begun, and management has secured sufficient manufacturing capacity to support approximately $1 billion in revenue across fiscal 2027 and fiscal 2028. Further, customer demand has already exceeded $2 billion, suggesting the initial revenue outlook could prove conservative if production continues to scale as planned.

To support this demand, Arm is working closely with manufacturing and supply-chain partners to expand production capacity, positioning the company to capitalize on the rapidly growing AI infrastructure market.

Another major growth engine is Neoverse, Arm's server CPU platform. The company has shipped more than 1.5 billion Neoverse CPU cores, with shipments accelerating in recent quarters. As enterprises and cloud providers continue investing heavily in AI infrastructure, demand for energy-efficient server processors is expected to rise significantly.

Neoverse's growing adoption indicates that Arm's architecture is becoming deeply embedded in next-generation AI data centers, a market that could drive royalty growth for many years.

The Bottom Line

Arm continues to post strong revenue growth, expand royalty streams, and deepen its position across several of the fastest-growing areas of computing.

While smartphone demand remains a near-term headwind, AI is becoming a much larger growth driver. From cloud data centers and networking to autonomous vehicles, robotics, and edge devices, Arm's architecture is at the center of multiple secular trends. With AI driving solid demand, the pullback in Arm stock presents a buying opportunity.

Wall Street currently maintains a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating on Arm stock.

news.Title: AI股不是只有美韓台 陸股「光模組全球壟斷8成」 帶旺這檔ETF噴2.5倍 最近回檔3成超香
news.Content:
美中打架，仍圍堵不住中國大陸日漸崛起的AI競爭力，除了美韓台AI股發燒，陸股也有許多明星股，分析師股添樂表示，光模組就是陸股天下，全球壟斷8成；PCB、CCL也很強，還有台灣子公司；最能代表中國最純AI硬體股就是00877，近1年股價噴2.5倍，近來也跟著全球去槓桿跌3成，未來AI就美中一分為二，若想要兩邊押寶，陸股現在是很香的。

股添樂在臉書「股添樂股市新觀點」表示，今年美股、台股、韓股受AI浪潮，股市表現跟著水漲船高，尤其是硬體相關族群。但同樣是硬體，很多人都忽略中國這波其實也養出不少明星科技股。

尤其中國在特定領域的競爭力不會輸給歐美，像是光模組市場，全球市占可以到8成，是整條AI供應鏈裡面壟斷程度最高的，指標公司包含中際旭創(光模組龍頭)、新易盛(光模組二哥)等。

再來是PCB(印刷電路板)、CCL(銅箔基板)領域，全球技術最好的公司都集中在兩岸，中國指標公司包含勝宏科技、滬市電子(楠梓電持股12%)、深南電路、鵬鼎控股(臻鼎子公司)等，而且從股東結構觀察，部分公司還能看到台灣的影子。

這些公司過去幾年股價至少翻2倍起跳，可惜在台灣沒有太多人關注，部分原因跟多數人對中國市場的印象，還停留在白酒、銀行類股有關。

如果擔心中系有一天要卷翻全世界，這檔其實是可以投的

但這批科技股的崛起，現在已經慢慢改寫中國市場的結構，例如以市值排名，現在前10名除了既有的毛台、大型銀行之外，可以看到工業富聯(鴻海子公司)、中際旭創、甚至第1名是前陣子剛上市的長鑫存儲(全球第4大DRAM廠)。

去年8月曾經提過，在台灣要參與中國這批最純的AI硬體概念股，最符合這項需求的就是復華中國5G(00877)。

這檔前10大幾乎就是過去一兩年中國最強的AI硬體股，雖然沒有IC設計的寒武紀、或是剛上來的長鑫存儲。不過幾個核心像工業富聯、中際旭創、新易盛、立訊(代工巨頭)都有了。

去年8月講完到今年6月，股價翻了2.5倍；最近一波半導體去槓桿引發的修正當然也沒缺席，跟著全球科技股一樣跌3成，現在香氣又飄出來了。

未來AI發展趨勢，世界就是一分為二，一邊美系、一邊中系，看好美系技術持續領先，買美股買台股；如果擔心中系有一天要卷翻全世界，這檔其實是可以投的。

而看好它的另一個理由是，代碼想忘記都難。

The company operates through two primary business segments—Mobile Products and Infrastructure and Defense Products—generating revenue by supplying critical semiconductor components to original equipment manufacturers and system integrators.

Qorvo serves a diverse customer base, including smartphone manufacturers, telecommunications infrastructure providers, automotive suppliers, and defense contractors, with significant exposure to 5G deployment and mobile device proliferation globally.

Qorvo is a global semiconductor specialist with approximately 5,000 employees headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, commanding an $8.4 billion market capitalization. The company maintains a diversified revenue base across consumer mobile devices and infrastructure markets, generating $3.6 billion in TTM revenue with net income of $399.2 million, reflecting its position as a critical supplier of RF and analog components in the semiconductor value chain. Qorvo's competitive advantage derives from its integrated design and manufacturing capabilities, extensive intellectual property portfolio, and established relationships with leading OEMs in high-growth wireless and defense sectors.

Story Continues

What this transaction means for investors

The finance chief of a company being sold has less say over the share price than almost anyone, since the terms are set and the regulators decide what happens next, which is the context that drains any meaning from Brown having a slice of vested stock held back for taxes this week. He was one of seven Qorvo insiders whose awards vested on the same date and seemingly triggered the same routine withholding. He kept 54,447 shares.

Meanwhile, Qorvo is being bought by Skyworks Solutions, and while that deal works through regulatory review, the company has stopped holding earnings calls and issuing forward guidance. Its most recently reported quarter before that change showed revenue slipping 7% to $808 million as smartphone demand softened, though cost discipline still lifted non-GAAP earnings to $1.69 per share, past the $1.21 analysts expected. CEO Bob Bruggeworth tied the result to "operational excellence and the strategic optimization of business mix." Right now, Qorvo shares mostly track the odds of the Skyworks deal closing, so a CFO's tax-driven vesting sale sits about as far from the action as an insider filing can get. Investos should just keep an eye on deal dynamics.

news.Title: Dear Analog Devices Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for August 19
news.Content:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping the semiconductor landscape, fueling heavy investment in data center infrastructure while reviving demand for industrial automation. Defense spending tied to domestic chip capabilities adds another layer of support. These forces have created favorable conditions for analog and mixed-signal semiconductor companies.

Analog Devices (ADI) has steadily strengthened its competitive position within this environment. A hybrid manufacturing strategy combining internal production with outsourced capacity has given the company greater operational flexibility. Broad exposure across industries, alongside the Empower Semiconductor acquisition focused on AI power delivery, further reinforces the company's long-term growth ambitions.

More News from Barchart

Stop Missing Market Moves: Get the FREE Barchart Brief – your midday dose of stock movers, trending sectors, and actionable trade ideas, delivered right to your inbox. Sign Up Now!

The latest quarterly performance reflected that strategy in action. CEO and Chair Vincent Roche described Q2 FY2026 as one marked by record demand and disciplined execution. He pointed to investments in supply chain resilience, research, software capabilities, and AI initiatives while acknowledging continuing geopolitical uncertainty and broader macroeconomic challenges worldwide.

Attention has now shifted toward Wednesday, August 19, when Analog Devices will report Q3 FY2026 earnings before the market opens. Industry trends remain supportive, the business continues operating from a diversified base, and earnings have consistently outperformed expectations. But do these positives still leave meaningful room for upside?

About Analog Devices Stock

Based in Wilmington, Massachusetts, Analog Devices develops, manufactures, tests, and markets integrated circuits, software, and subsystem solutions. Its technologies connect analog and digital signals while supporting power management, sensing, and data processing applications.

With a market cap brushing $184 billion, the company's product lineup spans data converters, amplifiers, power management integrated circuits (PMICs), radio frequency (RF) components, microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) sensors, and digital signal processing (DSP) solutions.

Shareholders have enjoyed an impressive run over the past year. Analog Devices' shares climbed 75.45% during the last 52 weeks, including a 44.34% year-to-date (YTD) gain. Although the shares briefly softened over the previous month, they regained momentum by advancing 6.55% in the last five trading sessions.

Story Continues

On the valuation front, ADI stock is trading at 30.34 times forward adjusted price-to-earnings and 12.41 times forward sales. Both figures exceed industry averages and their own five-year average multiples, suggesting the market assigns the stock a rich premium over its peers.

Investors have also benefited from consistent shareholder returns. The company has raised its dividend for 22 consecutive years and currently distributes $4.40 per share annually, producing a 1.16% yield. Its latest quarterly dividend of $1.10 per share was paid on June 16 to shareholders on record as of June 2.

Analog Devices Surpasses Q2 Earnings

On May 20, Analog Devices posted a strong set of Q2 FY2026 results that exceeded both management's guidance and Wall Street expectations. Total revenue grew 37.2% year-over-year (YOY) to $3.62 billion, beating analysts' estimate of $3.52 billion as broad-based demand remained healthy.

Industrial led the way, accounting for 50% of Q2 revenue and rising 56% YOY, fueled by strength in aerospace and defense, automated test equipment (ATE), electronic test and measurement (ETM), and the broad market. Automotive contributed 24% of revenue, increasing 2%, while Communications represented 15% and surged 79% from a year earlier.

Within Communications, data center revenue, which now makes up more than 75% of the segment, jumped over 90% YOY on robust demand for the company's optical and power solutions. Wireless demand also remained strong, growing more than 35%, while Consumer generated 11% of quarterly revenue and climbed 23%.

Profitability improved alongside revenue growth. Adjusted gross margin expanded to 73%, up 360 basis points YOY. Meanwhile, adjusted operating expenses totaled $871.5 million, helping operating margin reach 49%, an increase of 780 basis points. Adjusted EPS rose 67% to $3.09, topping the Street's estimate of $2.91.

Further, the company ended the quarter with $3.4 billion in cash and short-term investments and a net leverage ratio of 0.8. Looking ahead, management projects Q3 FY2026 revenue of $3.9 billion, plus or minus $100 million, and adjusted EPS of $3.30, plus or minus $0.15.

On the other hand, analysts expect Q3 FY2026 EPS to rise 62.4% YOY to $3.33. Full-year FY2026 EPS is projected to grow 59.4% YOY to $12.42, before increasing 17.8% from the previous year to $14.63 in FY2027.

What Do Analysts Expect for Analog Devices Stock?

Wall Street's outlook on Analog Devices remains positive, with analysts highlighting the company's resilient business model, expanding AI opportunities, and steady earnings trajectory.

Wells Fargo analyst Joseph Quatrochi reiterated an "Overweight" rating and left his price target unchanged at $515. Meanwhile, KeyBanc analyst John Vinh also maintained an "Overweight" rating while raising his price target to $525 from $500, reflecting continued confidence in the company's growth prospects.

The broader analyst community shares a similarly upbeat view, assigning the stock an overall rating of "Strong Buy." Among 31 analysts covering the stock, 23 recommend a "Strong Buy," four assign a "Moderate Buy," and the remaining four suggest investors "Hold."

To that end, the average price target of $452.96 implies potential upside of 15.7%. Meanwhile, the Street-High target of $550 points to a possible gain of 40.5% from current levels.

news.Title: Silicon Motion’s (SIMO) Next Chapter: Can Diversification Outrun the NAND Cycle?
news.Content:
Following its latest earnings report, Silicon Motion Technology Corporation (NASDAQ: SIMO ) jumped nearly 22%, a rally signaling that investors may be accepting a narrative Wall Street has questioned for years. The company is no longer seen as just a commoditized NAND controller supplier but as a business evolving into something fundamentally different. The key question is whether the recent results truly confirm a genuine long-term transformation, or whether investors are overvaluing a cyclical business because of its AI exposure.

The Bull Case Gets Real Data Behind It

According to Wedbush Securities, the company's stronger-than-expected results and outlook provide clear evidence that it is executing on all fronts. Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson highlighted that the earnings beat was broader than anticipated, noting that even the gross margin expansion came in well above his forecasts. He also noted that Silicon Motion is no longer relying solely on its early DPU and automotive programs for growth. The company has expanded its opportunity by winning businesses across NPUs, TPUs, NVLink switches, PCIe switches, and Ethernet switches for boot drives.

Wedbush Securities analyst Matt Bryson remarked:

SIMO cited wins across TPUs, NPUs, PCIe switches, NVLink switches, and Ethernet switches for boot drives. The Ferri opportunity could also expand greatly with the advent of physical AI, as robots require multiple storage controllers. We see this segment as the most likely near-term point of upside vs. our current model, given our 3Q26 expectations assume Q/Q growth below likely NAND price appreciation, to say nothing of likely unit increases.

Moreover, MonTitan business also exceeded expectations with management revealing that it entered commercial production with two tier-one customers this quarter, and expects five more to ramp in the second half of 2026.

The Case For Caution

The bear case focuses on valuation and the pace of the ramp. Bears argue that the market may have become too optimistic about Silicon Motion Technology Corporation's (NASDAQ:SIMO) prospects. The company's forward Price-to-Sales ratio now stands at 4.58x, roughly 51% above its five-year average of  3.03x. That suggests investors are already pricing in much stronger long-term growth, which leaves little room for error if the second-half customer additions slip or NAND pricing turns. Bears also point out that strong gross margins did not translate into stronger cash generation, as cash declined from $210.9 million to $181.8 million in the second quarter due to high inventory levels.

Story Continues

Hedge Funds Are Leaning In

Silicon Motion Technology Corporation (NASDAQ:SIMO) was held by 40 hedge funds as of the March quarter closing. Three months earlier, 37 hedge funds held the stock in their portfolios. Total hedge fund holdings also increased from $642.81 million to $754.96 million over the same period. A short interest of just 2.42% suggests limited bets against the company, adding further weight to the bullish case.

While we acknowledge the risk and potential of SIMO as an investment, our conviction lies in the belief that some AI stocks hold greater promise for delivering higher returns and doing so within a shorter time frame. news.Title: This Analyst On Wall Street Thinks The CPU Trade Is Overdone, Should You Sell ARM (ARM) Stock?
news.Content:
ARM Holdings Plc (NASDAQ: ARM ) has become one of the key beneficiaries of the AI boom. It has expanded beyond its traditional smartphone business into the fastest-growing cloud and data center markets. The company's energy-efficient CPU designs are increasingly being adopted by major cloud providers building AI data centers. As ARM continues to grow its presence in the server CPU market, investors are closely watching whether it can continue delivering the growth needed to meet the market's high expectations.

Photo from Arm Holdings

Analysts Are Cautious Despite Long-Term Server CPU Potential

Those rising expectations are one reason HSBC has become more cautious on the stock. While the firm acknowledged that ARM Holding's expansion into merchant server CPUs and the potential for higher server CPU royalties could create significant long-term growth, it believes the market has become overly optimistic about that opportunity. Since the company's "Arm Everywhere" event in March, the stock has significantly outperformed the broader semiconductor market.

According to HSBC, the stock already reflects much of the company's long-term growth potential. ARM Holdings has historically traded at a premium, and the stock's current forward P/E of roughly 128 indicates investors are already pricing in a lot of future success, which justifies HSBC's view.

TSMC Capacity Constraints Add to Near-Term Headwinds

The firm also pointed to foundry capacity constraints at Taiwan Semiconductor Co. as a factor that could limit short-term earnings growth. As a result, HSBC analyst Frank Lee reiterated his Hold rating on ARM Holdings Plc (NASDAQ:ARM) stock on July 30. He also lowered his price target from $315 to $230.

Not everyone on Wall Street is as cautious about ARM Holdings' outlook. UBS believes the company is well-positioned to benefit from rising demand for standalone CPUs as agentic AI adoption continues to increase. The firm expects ARM's energy-efficient architecture to become more widely used among hyperscalers, while higher royalty rates could support stronger long-term revenue growth. The firm also raised its outlook for the company's standalone CPU opportunity, which reflects growing confidence in ARM's long-term growth potential.

Hedge Fund Interest Rises, But Intel Still Leads in Ownership

At the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2026, 46 hedge funds in our database held positions in ARM Holdings, up from 33 at the end of the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025. Although hedge fund ownership of ARM increased during the quarter, it is still held by fewer funds than Intel, with 112 funds holding INTC stock in their portfolios. Despite UBS's bullishness on ARM Holdings, institutional investors still prefer Intel over ARM.

While we acknowledge the potential of ARM as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: The Numbers Behind ON Semiconductor’s (ON) Higher Target and Unchanged Hold Rating
news.Content:
ON Semiconductor Corp (NASDAQ: ON ) gave investors plenty of reasons for optimism after delivering stronger-than-expected second-quarter earnings, issuing third-quarter guidance above Wall Street's expectations, and reaffirming that its AI data center revenue is on track to more than double in 2026. Robert W. Baird analyst Tristan Gerra grew more constructive on the fundamentals, raising his price target while keeping a Neutral rating. The question is what kept him from upgrading his rating.

Margin Tailwinds Meet Share-Loss Worries

Baird analyst Tristan Gerra acknowledged several reasons for optimism on the company, raising his price target to $108 from $100 on August 3. The analyst cited improving momentum across AI data centers, industrial markets, electric vehicles, and China, along with higher factory utilization and a more favorable product mix. He believes those trends could push gross margins above 50% during this cycle.

Management's guidance also reinforced that view, with third-quarter non-GAAP gross margin expected to be between 40% and 42%, up from 39.3% in the second quarter. In addition, CEO Hassane El-Khoury reaffirmed that AI data center revenue is expected to more than double in 2026. However, analyst Tristan Gerra argued that market share losses in industrial, automotive, and analog remain an important concern, where he believes peers like ST and Texas Instruments are growing faster. He also pointed out that the company's relatively limited internal manufacturing capacity could become a competitive disadvantage if supply conditions tighten further.

The Growth Gap is Real

Recent industry results provide additional support to analyst Tristan Gerra's market-share concerns. In the second quarter of fiscal 2026, Texas Instruments Incorporated (NASDAQ:TXN) reported revenue of $5.46 billion, up 23% year over year, while STMicroelectronics grew net revenue 26% to $3.49 billion. By comparison, ON Semiconductor's (NASDAQ:ON) revenue rose just 9%. That means both competitors expanded at roughly three times the company's growth rate. Texas Instruments Incorporated (NASDAQ:TXN)' analog segment alone posted 26% growth, directly competing with one of ON Semiconductor's core businesses. Those comparisons reinforce Gerra's argument that rivals are gaining market share in key markets.

Hedge Fund Sentiment

ON Semiconductor's hedge fund ownership declined from 63 at the end of the fourth quarter of 2025 to 58 at the end of the first quarter of 2026. However, the total hedge fund holdings still increased marginally, going from $1.61 billion to $1.64 billion. This could suggest that while some funds headed for a total exit from the stock, others increased their existing position. A short interest of 11.05% shows that plenty of investors are still betting against the company at the same time. So the overall picture looks mixed.

Story Continues

While we acknowledge the risk and potential of ON as an investment, our conviction lies in the belief that some AI stocks hold greater promise for delivering higher returns and doing so within a shorter time frame. news.Title: MSCI換股倒數！不只南亞科 還有「3檔大黑馬」搶成分股門票
news.Content:
MSCI（明晟）最新一季度指數調整結果，將於台北時間8月13 日凌晨正式公布，並於8月31日收盤後生效。本土投顧預估，記憶體族群的南亞科、華邦電、群聯，以及ABF載板廠景碩等4檔個股，有機會獲選納入成分股。

兩檔市值落後恐遭剔除

投顧指出，台股加權指數7月下跌6.5%，MSCI台灣指數也下滑4.4%，在亞太主要市場中，僅優於大陸A股與南韓股市。6月下旬台積電股價突破2500元，帶動台股一度攀上48218點歷史新高，權重也升至27.34%，但7月市場表現明顯轉弱，加上外資連續兩個月賣超台股，預估本次MSCI季度調整，台股權重可能小幅下修。

雖然台股權重可能下調，但個股仍有機會受到MSCI調整帶動。投顧根據市值排名與自由流通率等條件評估，南亞科、華邦電、群聯及景碩4檔個股，具備較高機率在本季度調整中獲納入MSCI成分股。

另一方面，投顧提醒，部分現有成分股因市值排名下滑，面臨被剔除的壓力。康霈與臺企銀目前市值排名分別落至97名及93名，且外資持股比率均低於20%，因此被列為本季度調整的潛在刪除名單。陽明、力旺等個股也處於市值排名後段，需留意指數調整帶來的籌碼變化。

納入與剔除牽動籌碼 長期價值仍回歸基本面

市場通常認為，個股一旦被MSCI納入，可能吸引追蹤指數的國際資金進場，股價短線有機會受到推升；反之，遭剔除則可能面臨被動型資金調節，引發股價賣壓。

不過，永豐金證券指出，過去經驗顯示，MSCI指數調整對個股造成的價格波動多屬短期現象，投資人可以留意調整前後進行短線操作，但若從長期投資角度觀察，股價最終仍會回歸公司基本面，包括產業地位、競爭優勢及訂價能力等因素。

換言之，MSCI權重或成分股調整確實可能影響個股短線走勢，但對企業長期投資價值的影響相對有限，基本面仍是決定股價中長期表現的關鍵。

Qualcomm (QCOM) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
news.Content:
Image source: The Motley Fool.

DATE

Wednesday, July 29, 2026 at 2 p.m. ET

CALL PARTICIPANTS

President and Chief Executive Officer - Cristiano Amon

Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer - Akash Palkhiwala

Senior Vice President of Investor Relations - Brett Simpson

President, Qualcomm Technology Licensing - Alex Rogers

Full Conference Call Transcript

Operator: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for standing by. Welcome to the QUALCOMM Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Earnings Conference Call. As a reminder, this conference is being recorded, July 29, 2026. The playback number for today's call is (877) 660-6853. International callers, please dial (201) 612-7415. The playback reservation number is 13761080. I would now like to turn the call over to Brett Simpson, Senior Vice President of Investor Relations. Mr. Simpson, please go ahead.

Brett Simpson: Thank you, and good afternoon, everyone. Today's call will include prepared remarks by Cristiano Amon and Akash Palkhiwala. In addition, Alex Rogers will join the question-and-answer session. You can access our earnings release and a slide presentation that accompany this call on our Investor Relations website. In addition, this call is being webcast on qualcomm.com, and a replay will be available on our website later today. During the call today, we will use non-GAAP financial measures as defined in Regulation G, and you can find the related reconciliations to GAAP on our website. We will also make forward-looking statements, including projections and estimates of future events, business or industry trends or business or financial results.

Actual events or results could differ materially from those projected in our forward-looking statements. Please refer to our SEC filings, including our most recent 10-Q, which contain important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from the forward-looking statements. And now to comments from Qualcomm's President and Chief Executive Officer, Cristiano Amon.

Cristiano Amon: Thank you, Brett, and good afternoon, everyone. Thanks for joining us today. In fiscal Q3, we delivered revenues of $9.9 billion, coming in at the high end of our guidance and non-GAAP earnings per share of $2.21. QCT revenues were $8.5 billion, with another quarter of record automotive revenues as well as growth in IoT. Licensing business revenues were $1.3 billion. At our recent Investor Day, we lay out the next chapter of Qualcomm built across 3 dimensions: one, expanding into the data center with 4 unique product lines; two, driving agentic and physical AI compute everywhere; and three, expanding beyond silicon to full stack software and platform solutions.

Story Continues

We also updated our fiscal 2029 financial targets, which now include more than $24 billion in revenue across automotive and IoT plus more than $15 billion in data center, bringing our total non-handset revenue outlook to $40 billion by fiscal 2029, up from our previous target of $22 billion. This reflects our conviction in the opportunities throughout the end of the decade and the scale of our business diversification. In the short term, the entire industry continues to be impacted by unprecedented memory prices, higher manufacturing and input costs as well as supply chain shortages driven by overall data center demand.

In addition to the resulting revenue decline in mobile and consumer electronics, this is creating short-term pressure on QCT gross margins which will be slightly below our historical range. We're implementing price increases and as they take effect, we expect to see gross margins realign to our operating model. Despite these headwinds, we expect top line growth for QUALCOMM in fiscal '27, driven by an inflection in non-handset revenues throughout the fiscal year. We're incredibly excited about the next chapter of Qualcomm, our relevance in the next phase of AI and distributed intelligence from edge to cloud, and we remain firmly focused on the execution phase of our strategy. I will now share some key highlights on the business.

Let me start with data center. This is the ideal and logical time for Qualcomm to enter the market as agentic workloads are reshaping the economics of AI. Efficient token generation and total cost of ownership are fundamental to scaling AI. And as a result, inference is becoming disaggregated in the data center and will be increasingly distributed. This means hybrid inference will evolve across the entire compute continuum from data center to on-premise network edge and edge devices. Given Qualcomm's assets, it's a natural evolution of our growth story. We are developing a differentiated set of product lines, including connectivity in fiscal '26, custom silicon and AI accelerators in fiscal '27 and server-class CPUs in fiscal '28.

Our portfolio is rolling out in phases over the next 2 years, leveraging decades of leadership in power-efficient compute and strong ecosystem presence and relationships. Our 2 near-term custom silicon wins will be revenue generating in the December quarter, and we have begun wafer production. Both projects are in the first phase of strategic multiyear customer relationships that we expect to expand over time. Our innovative high-bandwidth compute solution is designed to address one of the industry's most difficult bottlenecks by integrating compute directly with high-density memory, improving performance per watt, memory efficiency and total cost of ownership.

I'm pleased to report that we have completed the tape-out of HBC Gen 1, an engineering milestone that moves us into the next phase of customer engagements. We expect to demonstrate HBC performance on silicon in the coming quarters ahead of the launch of our first HBC solution in mid-2027. Across our merchant platforms, including HBC based AI accelerators, SerDes connectivity and CPUs, we are in active conversations with nearly every leading data center player about building long-term partnerships. We're pleased with the activity and interest across these opportunities and expect to share more as they advance. As announced earlier today, we have closed our acquisition of Modular Inc., and integration is now underway.

Modular strengthens our ability to deliver an end-to-end software stack for data center and Edge AI deployments. It will also be hardware-agnostic helping simplify AI software complexity across multiple platforms and giving developers a modern and open environment for heterogeneous compute. This is an important step in how we see AI infrastructure evolving with software and hardware coming together to deliver better performance, flexibility and efficiency. Our vision and objective with Modular goes far beyond augmenting our AI software capabilities. We have the ambition to change the current industry approach to AI software from closed to open systems to promote enhanced competition, innovation and resilience.

Modular will host ModCon in August with some incredible announcements from industry partners, and we look forward to further engaging with developers and ecosystem partners at this event. In automotive, customer momentum continues to drive exceptional revenue growth. This quarter, we signed a landmark expanded agreement with BMW, winning a highly competitive selection process to become the lead compute silicon provider for their next-generation ADAS as well as digital cockpit. This agreement represents a material expansion of our automotive pipeline and establishes Qualcomm as the lead compute silicon partner for BMW extending across model programs well into the next decade. We look forward to building on our existing cooperation with BMW in the years ahead.

Additionally, our recently announced collaboration with Stellantis supports our automotive pipeline well into the 2030s. These agreements reflect the broad interest we're seeing for digital cockpit and ADAS. Customers are shifting from socket-by-socket design awards to multi-generation strategic engagements as they increasingly recognize the value of our broad technology portfolio, platform approach and long-term commitment to partnerships, the automotive industry and open ecosystems. Further, with our fifth-generation Snapdragon digital chassis ramping in September, we're delivering a significant increase in content per vehicle, and we are on track to become the #1 automotive semiconductor player by revenue. Last quarter, we said we were targeting an annualized revenue run rate of $6 billion as we exit fiscal 2026.

Today, we're raising that outlook and now expect annualized sales of approximately $7 billion exiting fiscal '26. Within Industrial, we're strengthening our position across many verticals as they embrace AI at the edge and open weight models. At our Investor Day, we introduced a fiscal '29 projection of $8 billion in revenue for industrial networking and robotics. We're happy to report that our industrial design win pipeline exceeds $7 billion with over $3.5 billion in design wins secured this fiscal year. This reflects strong customer demand and a meaningful increase in new businesses. We have a very broad portfolio of purpose-built silicon and full stack software solutions for this category.

Our channel presence exceeds 38,000 customers supported by a deep partner ecosystem that is already yielding results. And with Arduino and Edge Impulse, our reach now extends to more than 30 million users. Moving on to handsets. Despite overall industry contraction caused by the current memory environment, we're seeing early signs of an agentic smartphone cycle that will grow over time. In China, major OEMs are preparing to bring new on-device agents and orchestrators to market, and we believe agentic experiences will play a larger role in premium tier demand as adoption grows. Our share position at Samsung remains strong, with Snapdragon powering approximately 70% of their flagship devices as announced at Samsung Unpacked.

Our collaboration is now expanding across the wider Galaxy ecosystem from the latest foldable phones and Galaxy watches to intelligent eyewear developed with Google, bringing new agentic experiences to more devices. This reflects a broader potential to reimagine mobile for the age of agentic AI. Beyond smartphones, PCs, smart glasses and other new personal AI form factors are all becoming endpoint for agents that create a significant multiyear upgrade opportunity for Qualcomm as today's installed base needs to evolve to enable more personal, contextual and autonomous AI experience. In PCs, we're growing our leading share of design wins in Google Books, bringing Snapdragon together with Gemini Intelligence for a new generation of AI first laptops.

With Microsoft, we're collaborating on Project Solara, a chip-to-cloud platform designed for agent-first enterprise devices. And through our Snapdragon Start program for smart glasses, we're delivering a complete reference platform that enables eyewear brands to develop their own devices. With roughly 600 million global eyewear units shipped every year, this program will help expand the ecosystem and accelerate the transition of this category to smart glasses. You will hear more about this as Snapdragon Summit in September. At Investor Day, we lay out our vision for Qualcomm's next chapter and our path toward our fiscal 2029 targets.

We're already seeing an inflection in our non-handset businesses, which underscores the success of our diversification strategy, and there's a lot more to come. Our data center business is just at the beginning of its journey, and we recognize that investors want to see more proof points that we can successfully execute on our plans as a new entrant. We welcome the challenge ahead and are confident we will prove as we have many times before, that Qualcomm can execute and win in new growth areas, including data center. With that, I will turn the call over to Akash.

Akash Palkhiwala: Thank you, Cristiano, and good afternoon, everyone. Let me begin with our results for the third fiscal quarter. We delivered revenues of $9.9 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $2.21, with revenue at the high end of our guidance. QTL revenues of $1.3 billion and EBT margin of 69% were in line with our expectations. QCT revenues of $8.5 billion were at the high end of our guidance, and EBT margin of 26% was in line with guidance. QCT handset revenues of $5.1 billion reflect the impact of industry-wide memory dynamics on the global smartphone market. QCT IoT revenues of $1.8 billion were up 9% versus the prior year driven by growth within the industrial networking and robotics category of products.

In QCT Automotive, we delivered another record quarter with revenues of $1.6 billion, with 61% year-over-year growth driven by accelerating demand and increasing compute content per vehicle. Total non-handset revenues in QCT, including automotive and IoT, grew 28% year-over-year, underscoring the continued execution of our diversification strategy. Lastly, we returned $2.3 billion to stockholders, including $1.4 billion in share repurchases and $937 million in dividends. Before turning to guidance, I'd like to provide an update on a couple of factors reflected in our financial performance. First, consistent with our expectations, we estimate that QCT handset revenues from Chinese OEMs reached a bottom in the third fiscal quarter and will return to double-digit sequential growth in the fourth quarter.

Second, the semiconductor industry is experiencing broad-based increase in input costs across wafer fabrication, assembly, test, advanced packaging, memory and other materials. We are taking concrete actions to reflect the higher input costs in our product pricing. These actions will benefit our gross margins over time as the pricing changes gradually come into effect. Finally, as a result of our supply constraints, we now expect an acceleration in the step-down of Apple product revenues starting in the fourth fiscal quarter as our share for upcoming iPhone launch is expected to be materially lower than our prior estimate of 20%. All these factors are contemplated both in our third quarter performance and fourth quarter outlook.

Against this backdrop, I'll now provide our guidance for the fourth fiscal quarter. We are forecasting revenues of $9.7 billion to $10.5 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $2.05 to $2.25. In QTL, we estimate revenues of $1.2 billion to $1.4 billion, and EBT margin of 68% to 72%, reflecting normal seasonal trends. In QCT, we expect revenues of $8.4 billion to $9 billion and EBT margins of 23% to 25%. We forecast QCT handset revenues to be approximately $5.2 billion, driven by sequential growth in Android, offset by lower Apple product revenues.

We expect QCT IoT revenues to remain approximately flat versus the year ago period, with double-digit growth across our industrial networking and robotics category of products, offset primarily by the impact of memory constraints on tablets and other consumer products. In QCT Automotive, we expect another record quarter with approximately 60% year-over-year revenue growth. Lastly, we anticipate non-GAAP operating expenses to be approximately $2.7 billion in the quarter, reflecting the acquisition of Modular and continued investment in our data center product road map ahead of revenue ramp. Before I conclude my prepared remarks, let me summarize the key drivers of QCT's growth trajectory going forward.

We are well positioned to execute on the vision we outlined at our recent Investor Day with QCT non-handset revenues expected to grow to $40 billion by fiscal '29, nearly double the target we had previously provided. This forecast includes data center revenue growth to $5 billion in fiscal '27 and $15 billion in fiscal '29. As a result of our diversification execution, we now estimate non-handsets at more than 50% of QCT revenues in fiscal '27 and grow to approximately 2/3 in fiscal '29.

In the short term, we anticipate growth in non-handset revenues relative to prior year to accelerate from 24% in fiscal '26 to greater than 60% in fiscal '27, a significant inflection point in the execution of our growth strategy. We expect this growth from non-handset revenues in fiscal '27 to replace total Apple product revenues in '26.
